modules.title: Sentence foundations
modules.goal: Gapdagi ega, fe’l va boshqa qismlarni ajratib, sodda gap tartibini tushuntiraman.
items: I, you, he, she, it, we, they
She is a teacher. She is kind.
I am happy. / I work. (I am work emas.)
I am Ali. Are you ready?

modules.title: TO BE · present
modules.goal: Kim? Qanday? Qayerda? ma’nolarida tasdiq, inkor va savol gap tuzaman.
items: I am; he/she/it is; you/we/they are
She is not a kind teacher.
Who is he? Where are you? How are you?
Yes, I am. / No, she isn’t.
at home; in class; She is here.

modules.title: Nouns & articles
modules.goal: Otning soni va ma’nosiga qarab a/an, the yoki artiklsiz shaklni tanlayman.
items: A / an — birinchi marta tilga olish
a piece of advice; a glass of water

modules.title: Pronouns & determiners
modules.goal: Kimga yoki nimaga ishora qilayotganimni aniq ifodalayman.
items: me, you, him, her, it, us, them
She knows him. He knows her.
This is my pen. That is your bag.
These are books. Those are pens.
The blue one. / The small ones.
Somebody is here. Nobody is outside.
I need something. I don’t need anything.

modules.title: Existence & possession
modules.goal: Bor-yo‘qlik va egalikni aytaman, sodda ko‘rsatma beraman.
items: There isn’t a lift. There aren’t any chairs.
Is there a bank? Are there any shops?
There is / are — how many questions
Yes, there is. / No, there aren’t.
There vs it — borlik va ishora
There is a park. It is large.
I have a bike. She has a car.
I don’t have a car. He doesn’t have a bike.
Do you have a pen? Does she have a car?
I’ve got a bag. She’s got a phone.
Have got — questions and short answers
Have you got a pen? Yes, I have.

modules.title: Present Simple
modules.goal: Kundalik faoliyat haqida tasdiq, inkor, savol va qisqa javoblar tuzaman.
items: Present Simple — positive: I / you / we / they
Present Simple — positive: he / she / it
Where do you live? When does she work?
Yes, I do. / No, he doesn’t.
What do you do? When do you start?
We visit our grandmother every week.
Water freezes at zero degrees Celsius.
She often reads. She is always busy.
Be vs do / does — savol va inkor
Are you tired? / Do you work?

modules.title: Present Continuous
modules.goal: Hozirgi harakatni odatdan ajrataman va mos zamonni tanlayman.
items: I am reading. She is working.
Yes, I am. / No, they aren’t.
He is talking on the phone now.
I am staying with my aunt this week.
I walk to school. / I’m taking a taxi today.
I know the answer. (I am knowing emas.)

modules.title: Questions, place & time
modules.goal: Kerakli ma’lumotni so‘rayman va harakatning qayerda/qachonligini aytaman.
items: What / which — ochiq va cheklangan tanlov
What music do you like? Which bag is yours?
Who is she? Whose phone is this?
Why do you study? How do you travel?
How old / how long / how far
How old are you? How far is the station?
How much water? How many books?
in the room; on the table; at the station
The bag is under the chair.
Movement — to / into / out of / across
in May; on Monday; at six
before class; after lunch; until Friday
from nine to five; during class; for an hour
She worked quietly at home yesterday.

modules.title: Past Simple & past BE
modules.goal: O‘tgan voqeani hikoya qilaman va was/were bilan didni farqlayman.
items: I was tired. They were at home.
Yes, I was. / No, they weren’t.
There was a concert. There were many people.
There wasn’t a bus. There weren’t any taxis.
Was there a problem? Were there any seats?
She went home. We saw a film.
Yes, I did. / No, she didn’t.
yesterday; last week; two days ago
Were you late? / Did you arrive late?

modules.title: Past Continuous & habits
modules.goal: Hikoyada davom etayotgan voqea bilan uni bo‘lgan hodisani bog‘layman.
items: Yes, I was. / No, we weren’t.
I was reading when she called.
While I was cooking, he was reading.
I used to live in Samarkand.
I didn’t use to drink coffee.
Did you use to walk to school?
Every summer, we would visit our aunt.
Used to vs would vs Past Simple
I used to be shy. / I met her yesterday.

modules.title: Future plans & decisions
modules.goal: Reja, kelishuv, tezkor qaror va taxminni mos shaklda ifodalayman.
items: Yes, I will. / No, she won’t.
I’ll be ready. She’ll be a doctor. We’ll be home.
I am going to study tonight.
What are you going to do?
Yes, I am. / No, he isn’t.
I’m meeting my teacher at ten tomorrow.
The train leaves at seven tomorrow.
Will vs going to — qaror / reja / dalil
I’ll answer it. / Look! It’s going to rain.
Future time clauses — when / as soon as
I’ll call you when I arrive.
Shall I / shall we — taklif va yordam

modules.title: Present Perfect Simple
modules.goal: Tajriba, hozirgi natija va tugamagan davrni ifodalayman.
items: Yes, I have. / No, she hasn’t.
Have you ever flown? I’ve never flown.
He hasn’t arrived yet. He still hasn’t called.
I have lived here for two years / since 2024.
I’ve read two books this week.
She’s been to Bukhara. / She’s gone to Bukhara.
I’ve seen it. / I saw it yesterday.
How long have you known her?

modules.title: Perfect & continuous
modules.goal: Natija, davomiy faoliyat va oldinroq bo‘lgan voqeani farqlayman.
items: I have been studying for two hours.
How long have you been learning English?
Yes, I have. / No, she hasn’t.
I’ve written three pages. / I’ve been writing.
She had left before I arrived.
Had they finished before you came?
What had she done before you arrived?
Yes, she had. / No, they hadn’t.
When I arrived, the lesson had started.
It had been raining, so the road was wet.
How long had she been working there?
Yes, I had. / No, she hadn’t.
She had cooked dinner. / She had been cooking.

modules.title: Comparison & quantity
modules.goal: Odam, narsa va vaziyatlarni daraja hamda miqdor bo‘yicha taqqoslayman.
items: This room is as large as that one.
She works more carefully than I do.
some rice; not any rice; Have you got any rice?
much time; many books; a lot of work
too hot; warm enough; enough money
Both are good. Neither answer is correct.
Most of the students are here.

modules.title: Ability & permission
modules.goal: Nima qila olishimni aytaman, ruxsat so‘rayman va muloyim iltimos qilaman.
items: Yes, I can. / No, she can’t.
I could read when I was five.
I couldn’t swim as a child.
Could you read at that age?
I’ll be able to join you tomorrow.
Was able to / managed to — aniq muvaffaqiyat
We managed to open the door.
May I come in? Could I use your pen?
Could you help me? Would you open the door?
We are allowed to use a dictionary.
I’d like some tea. Would you like to sit down?

modules.title: Obligation & advice
modules.goal: Majburiy, taqiqlangan va ixtiyoriy ishni farqlab tushuntiraman.
items: You must wear a seat belt.
Don’t / doesn’t have to — zarur emas
You don’t have to bring food.
Do we have to book? Does she have to pay?
I didn’t have to wait. Did you have to pay?
We will have to leave early.
What should I do? Should I call her?
You ought to rest. We’d better leave.
Need to / don’t need to / needn’t
Needn’t have vs didn’t need to
I needn’t have bought bread; we already had some.

modules.title: Possibility & deduction
modules.goal: Taxminim qanchalik ishonchli ekanini hozirgi va o‘tgan vaziyatda ifodalayman.
items: May not / might not — ehtimoliy inkor
He might not know the answer.
The lights are on. They must be home.
He can’t be at school; it’s closed.
Could this be the right address?
Must have + V3 — o‘tgan kuchli taxmin
They must have missed the bus.
She might have forgotten the date.
Should have + V3 — bajarilmagan yaxshi ish
We could have taken a taxi, but we walked.
She will probably come. He probably won’t.

modules.title: Conditionals · 0 / 1 / 2
modules.goal: Fakt, real kelajak va faraziy vaziyatga mos shart gap tuzaman.
items: If you heat ice, it melts.
If plants don’t get water, they die.
What happens if you heat ice?
If I finish early, I’ll call you.
If it rains, we won’t go out.
Will you come if you are free?
What will you do if it rains?
If you’re tired, rest. If you finish, you can leave.
Unless you hurry, you’ll miss the bus.
If I had more time, I would travel.
If I didn’t work, I wouldn’t earn money.
Would you move if you found a better job?
What would you do if you won?
If I were you, I would ask for help.
If I have time… / If I had more time…
If it rains, we’ll stay. / We’ll stay if it rains.

modules.title: Past conditions & wishes
modules.goal: O‘tgan qarorning boshqa natijasini va hozirgi afsusni ifodalayman.
items: If I had studied, I would have passed.
If we hadn’t left late, we wouldn’t have missed it.
Would you have come if I had invited you?
What would you have done if you had known?
If I had saved more, I could have bought it.
If I had slept well, I wouldn’t be tired now.
If I spoke French, I would have understood her.
Would you be here if you hadn’t met her?
I wish I had more time.
I wish the neighbours would be quieter.
I hope she comes. / I wish she were here.
Provided / as long as / even if
You can borrow it as long as you return it.

modules.title: Passive voice
modules.goal: Kim bajarganidan ko‘ra nima bo‘lganiga urg‘u beraman.
items: Active vs passive — ega va fokus
People use this room. / This room is used.
The office isn’t cleaned on Sundays.
Is it made here? Where is it made?
Was it repaired? When was it repaired?

modules.title: Passive · extended
modules.goal: Kelajak, modal va oldingi voqealarni passivda ifodalayman.
items: The results will be published tomorrow.
The results won’t be published today.
When will the results be published?
The car was being repaired when I called.
The work had been completed before I arrived.
The book was written by a local author.

modules.title: Reported speech
modules.goal: Aytilgan gap, savol va iltimosni ma’nosini saqlab yetkazaman.
items: She said she was busy. / She told me she was busy.
“I am tired.” → She said she was tired.
“I don’t know.” → He said he didn’t know.
“I work here.” → She said she worked there.
“I lost it.” → He said he had lost it.
“I will help.” → She said she would help.
“My bag…” → He said his bag was missing.
She asked if I was ready.
He told us not to leave.
She asked me to help her.
He offered to help. She refused to leave.

modules.title: Relative clauses
modules.uz: Ot haqida qo‘shimcha yoki aniqlovchi ma’lumot
modules.goal: Ikki fikrni birlashtirib, kim yoki qaysi narsa haqida gapirayotganimni aniqlayman.
items: The woman who teaches us is kind.
The book that I bought is useful.
The girl whose bag is red is my sister.
This is the school where I studied.
I remember the day when we met.
The man who called is here.
The book I bought is useful.
Ali, who lives nearby, is a teacher.
Bukhara, where my aunt lives, is beautiful.
Defining vs non-defining — ma’no va vergul
My brother who lives abroad… / My brother, who…
the person I spoke to / to whom I spoke
Which referring to a whole clause
He helped us, which was kind.
The students waiting outside are in my class.
The books written by her are popular.

modules.title: Verb patterns
modules.goal: Fe’ldan keyin -ing, to-infinitive yoki bare infinitiveni to‘g‘ri tanlayman.
items: I enjoy reading. She avoids driving at night.
I decided to study. They hope to win.
Let me help. The joke made us laugh.
She can swim. (can to swim emas.)
I went out to buy bread.
too tired to work; old enough to drive
Stop doing vs stop to do
He stopped smoking. / He stopped to rest.
Remember / forget doing vs to do
Remember to call. / I remember calling.
Try doing vs try to do
Try restarting it. / I tried to open it.
Used to vs be used to
I used to walk. / I’m used to walking.
I’m getting used to waking up early.
Turn it off. / Look after her.
depend on; listen to; interested in; good at
I had my hair cut. I’ll get my phone repaired.

modules.title: Clauses & connections
modules.goal: Sabab, natija, qarama-qarshilik va maqsadni bog‘langan gaplarda ifodalayman.
items: And / but / or — teng fikrlarni ulash
We stayed in because it was raining.
Because of / due to + noun phrase
The match stopped because of the rain.
So / therefore / as a result — natija
It was late, so we left.
Although it was cold, we went out.
Despite the rain, we went out.
It was cold. However, we went out.
I prefer tea, whereas she prefers coffee.
It was so cold that we stayed inside.
It was such a good book that I read it twice.
To / in order to / so as to — maqsad
I study to improve my English.
I spoke slowly so that everyone could follow.
Before / after / until / as soon as
In case vs if — ehtiyot va shart
Take a coat in case it gets cold.
You can either walk or take a bus.
She is not only kind but also patient.
It was raining; however, we continued.

modules.title: Precision & complex forms
modules.goal: Gaplarimni aniqroq, tabiiyroq va grammatik jihatdan izchil qilaman.
items: Subject–verb agreement — oddiy va murakkab ega
The list of names is on the desk.
Life is difficult. / The life of this artist…
at school; in the school; the Nile; Uzbekistan
some chicken / a chicken; some paper / a paper
I’m interested. / The topic is interesting.
She almost finished. / Only she finished.
Could you tell me if the bank is open?
Do you know where she lives?
So do I. / Neither have I.
I think it’s good. / I’m thinking about it.

modules.title: Future · extended
modules.goal: Kelajakdagi bir paytda davom etadigan va shu paytgacha tugaydigan ishni ajrataman.
items: I’ll be studying at eight tomorrow.
I won’t be working tomorrow morning.
What will you be doing at eight?
I won’t have finished by then.
Will you have finished by noon?
Yes, I will. / No, she won’t.
What will you have finished by Friday?
Yes, I will. / No, they won’t.
At six, I’ll be working. / By six, I’ll have finished.
By / by the time — yakun muddati
I’ll have left by the time you arrive.
Future in the past — was going to / would
I was going to call, but I forgot.

words.translation: Men turganidan boshqa har bir zina pog‘onasida gultuvak bor.

words.example: The door handle is sticky after our jam party.
words.translation: Murabbo ziyofatimizdan keyin eshik tutqichi yopishqoq bo‘lib qolgan.

words.example: This lock protects a cupboard full of boring towels.
words.translation: Bu qulf zerikarli sochiqlar bilan to‘la javonni qo‘riqlaydi.

words.example: My key was in the pocket I checked three times.
words.translation: Kalitim uch marta tekshirgan cho‘ntagimda ekan.

words.example: The doorbell rang just as I put on a face mask.
words.translation: Yuzimga niqob surtganim zahoti eshik qo‘ng‘irog‘i chalindi.

words.example: Our doormat says welcome, but the cat looks doubtful.
words.translation: Eshik gilamchamizda xush kelibsiz deb yozilgan, lekin mushuk shubha bilan qaraydi.

words.example: The only free socket is behind a very heavy sofa.
words.translation: Yagona bo‘sh rozetka juda og‘ir divan ortida.

words.example: I checked the plug before blaming the kettle.
words.translation: Choynakni ayblashdan oldin elektr vilkasini tekshirdim.

words.example: This switch turns on the hall light, not the moon.
words.translation: Bu o‘chirgich oyni emas, dahliz chirog‘ini yoqadi.

words.example: We changed the bulb and discovered more dust.
words.translation: Lampochkani almashtirib, yana ko‘proq changni ko‘rdik.

words.example: The tap drips like a very slow drummer.
words.translation: Jo‘mrak juda sekin barabanchi kabi tomchilaydi.

words.example: That pipe makes strange noises after my shower.
words.translation: Dush qabul qilganimdan keyin o‘sha quvur g‘alati ovoz chiqaradi.

words.example: The heating is on, and the cat has melted onto the rug.
words.translation: Isitish tizimi yoqilgan, mushuk esa gilamchaga yoyilib yotibdi.

words.example: The air conditioning makes our bedroom feel like a fridge.
words.translation: Havoni sovitish tizimi yotoqxonamizni muzlatkichdek qiladi.

words.example: My pillow knows all my weekend plans: sleep.
words.translation: Yostig‘im dam olish kunidagi barcha rejalarimni biladi: uxlash.

words.example: This pillowcase has little dancing carrots on it.
words.translation: Bu yostiq jildida raqsga tushayotgan mitti sabzilar tasviri bor.

words.example: The sheet is clean until the dog says hello.
words.translation: It salom berguncha choyshab toza turadi.

words.example: We share a blanket, but my brother takes the warm half.
words.translation: Biz bitta adyolni bo‘lishamiz, ammo ukam issiq yarmini oladi.

words.example: Getting out from under this duvet is my hardest job.
words.translation: Bu ko‘rpa tagidan chiqish mening eng qiyin ishim.

words.example: Our new mattress arrived in a box smaller than Dad.
words.translation: Yangi matrasimiz dadamdan kichikroq qutida keldi.

words.example: The fancy bedspread hides my untidy sheets.
words.translation: Bezakli yopinchiq tartibsiz choyshablarimni yashiradi.

words.example: Fresh bedding makes Monday feel slightly kinder.
words.translation: Yangi yuvilgan ko‘rpa-to‘shak anjomlari dushanbani biroz yoqimliroq qiladi.

words.example: My brother calls the top of the bunk bed his castle.
words.translation: Ukam ikki qavatli karavotning yuqorisini o‘z qal’asi deydi.

words.example: The baby sleeps in a cot surrounded by toy bears.
words.translation: Chaqaloq o‘yinchoq ayiqlar qurshovidagi karavotida uxlaydi.

words.example: My bedside table holds water and seven unfinished books.
words.translation: Karavotim yonidagi tumbada suv va yettita tugatilmagan kitob bor.

words.example: My alarm clock is the loudest member of the family.
words.translation: Budilnigim oilamizning eng shovqinli a’zosi.

words.example: I have ten hangers and eleven coats; one coat is sad.
words.translation: Menda o‘nta ilgich va o‘n bitta palto bor; bitta palto xafa.

words.example: The hook behind the door holds my entire winter.
words.translation: Eshik ortidagi ilgakda qishki kiyimlarimning hammasi osilib turibdi.

words.example: The chest of drawers is full of socks without partners.
words.translation: Tortmali kiyim javoni jufti yo‘q paypoqlarga to‘la.

words.example: The bath is ready, and so is my rubber duck.
words.translation: Vanna tayyor, rezina o‘rdagim ham tayyor.

words.example: My brother sings in the shower; the pipes complain.
words.translation: Akam dushda qo‘shiq aytadi; quvurlar shikoyat qiladi.

words.example: Our toilet has a warmer seat than my office chair.
words.translation: Unitazimizning o‘rindig‘i idoradagi kursimnikidan issiqroq.

words.example: The bathroom basin is too small for our dramatic cat.
words.translation: Hammomdagi yuz-qo‘l yuvgich o‘zini ko‘z-ko‘z qiladigan mushugimiz uchun juda kichik.

words.example: Someone used my best towel to dry the dog.
words.translation: Kimdir eng yaxshi sochig‘im bilan itni quritibdi.

words.example: The wet bathmat feels like a cold pancake.
words.translation: Ho‘l hammom gilamchasi sovuq quymoqqa o‘xshaydi.

words.example: This yellow sponge works harder than anyone in the bathroom.
words.translation: Bu sariq gubka hammomdagi hammadan ko‘proq ishlaydi.

words.example: My ring nearly went down the drain during its bath.
words.translation: Uzugimni yuvayotganda u suv teshigiga tushib ketay dedi.

words.example: One bathroom tile has a duck on it for company.
words.translation: Hammomdagi bir kafelda hamroh bo‘lsin deb o‘rdak rasmi tushirilgan.

words.example: Buying toilet paper is less exciting than buying cake.
words.translation: Hojatxona qog‘ozi sotib olish tort olishdek qiziq emas.

words.example: This bowl is large enough for my breakfast dreams.
words.translation: Bu kosa nonushta haqidagi orzularim uchun yetarlicha katta.

words.example: My mug says boss, but Mum gives the orders.
words.translation: Krujkamda boshliq deb yozilgan, lekin buyruqni onam beradi.

words.example: The biscuit on my saucer disappeared during one phone call.
words.translation: Bitta telefon suhbati davomida likopchamdagi pechenye yo‘qoldi.

words.example: He poured juice into a glass bigger than his breakfast.
words.translation: U sharbatni nonushtasidan kattaroq stakanga quydi.

words.example: The jug is full of lemonade and ambitious lemon slices.
words.translation: Ko‘za limonad va juda katta limon bo‘laklariga to‘la.

words.example: Our teapot wears a little woolly hat.
words.translation: Choy damlaydigan choynagimiz kichik jun qalpoq kiygan.

words.example: I ate the ice cream with a teaspoon to make it last.
words.translation: Muzqaymoq uzoqroqqa yetsin deb uni choy qoshiqda yedim.

words.example: Use one tablespoon of honey, not the whole jar.
words.translation: Butun bankani emas, bir osh qoshiq asal ishlating.

words.example: My chopsticks keep dropping noodles onto my shirt.
words.translation: Tayoqchalarim ugra bo‘laklarini ko‘ylagimga tushiraveradi.

words.example: We packed the picnic but forgot all the cutlery.
words.translation: Sayr ovqatini joyladik, lekin barcha qoshiq, sanchqi va pichoqlarni unutdik.

words.example: The serving dish is empty, so dinner was a success.
words.translation: Ovqat tortilgan idish bo‘sh, demak kechki ovqat yaxshi chiqibdi.

words.example: I carried breakfast on a tray like a nervous waiter.
words.translation: Nonushtani hayajonlangan ofitsiantdek patnisda olib keldim.

words.example: The pan is hot, but my cooking ideas are not.
words.translation: Tova issiq, ammo ovqat pishirish g‘oyalarim unchalik zo‘r emas.

words.example: Our smallest saucepan makes exactly one lonely portion.
words.translation: Eng kichik kastryulkamizda rosa bir kishilik ovqat pishadi.

words.example: This frying pan has seen more eggs than a farm.
words.translation: Bu qovurish tovasi fermadan ham ko‘proq tuxum ko‘rgan.

words.example: The lid fits every pot except the right one.
words.translation: Qopqoq o‘z qozonidan boshqa hamma qozonga tushadi.

words.example: Dad uses a ladle because his idea of a spoon is big.
words.translation: Dadamning qoshiq haqidagi tasavvuri katta bo‘lgani uchun u cho‘mich ishlatadi.

words.example: The spatula rescued my pancake from a sticky end.
words.translation: Kurakcha quymog‘imni yopishib qolishdan qutqardi.

words.example: The whisk left cream on my nose and nowhere useful.
words.translation: Ko‘pirtirgich qaymoqni kerakli joyga emas, burnimga sachratdi.

words.example: The grater turned a large cheese block into a tiny mountain.
words.translation: Qirg‘ich katta pishloq bo‘lagini kichik tog‘chaga aylantirdi.

words.example: This peeler gives every potato a quick haircut.
words.translation: Bu po‘st archgich har bir kartoshkaning sochini tezda olib qo‘yadi.

words.example: Flour went through the sieve and onto my black trousers.
words.translation: Un elakdan o‘tib, qora shimimga tushdi.

words.example: The colander lets the water escape but keeps dinner safe.
words.translation: Suzgich suvni chiqarib yuboradi, ammo ovqatni saqlab qoladi.

words.example: My chopping board smells of garlic, whatever I cut.
words.translation: Nima kesishimdan qat’i nazar, taxtamdan sarimsoq hidi keladi.

words.example: Grandma uses a rolling pin; I just watch and eat.
words.translation: Buvim o‘qlov ishlatadi, men esa faqat kuzataman va yeyman.

words.example: The oven is ready, but the cake is still an idea.
words.translation: Duxovka tayyor, ammo tort hali faqat g‘oya.

words.example: The microwave finished lunch before I found a fork.
words.translation: Sanchqi topgunimcha mikroto‘lqinli pech tushlikni isitib bo‘ldi.

words.example: Our kettle works harder when Grandma visits.
words.translation: Buvim kelganida suv choynagimiz ko‘proq ishlaydi.

words.example: The toaster frightened me by throwing up my breakfast.
words.translation: Non qizartirgich nonushtamni yuqoriga otib meni qo‘rqitdi.

words.example: The blender turned my fruit into a pink breakfast.
words.translation: Blender mevalarimni pushti nonushtaga aylantirdi.

words.example: Our mixer is loud enough to announce cake to the neighbours.
words.translation: Mikserimizning ovozi qo‘shnilarga tort pishayotganini bildirishga yetadi.

words.example: The freezer contains peas and my emergency ice cream.
words.translation: Muzlatish kamerasida no‘xat va zarurat uchun saqlagan muzqaymog‘im bor.

words.example: I thanked the dishwasher after our twelve-person dinner.
words.translation: O‘n ikki kishilik kechki ovqatdan so‘ng idish yuvish mashinasiga rahmat aytdim.

words.example: The sink is full of dishes having a long bath.
words.translation: Oshxona chig‘anog‘i uzoq cho‘milayotgan idishlarga to‘la.

words.example: Flour covers the worktop like very expensive snow.
words.translation: Oshxona ish yuzasini juda qimmat qordek un qoplagan.

words.example: The kitchen scales say my small snack weighs half a kilo.
words.translation: Oshxona tarozisi kichik gazagim yarim kilo kelishini ko‘rsatmoqda.

words.example: Set the timer before the biscuits become little rocks.
words.translation: Pechenyelar mayda toshlarga aylanishidan oldin taymerni qo‘ying.

words.example: We brought beans on holiday but no tin opener.
words.translation: Ta’tilga loviya konservasini oldik, ammo konserva ochgich olmabmiz.

words.example: The bottle opener is hiding whenever I want lemonade.
words.translation: Limonad ichmoqchi bo‘lganimda shisha ochgich yashirinib oladi.

words.example: This bottle holds water, despite its fancy label.
words.translation: Chiroyli yorlig‘iga qaramay, bu shishada oddiy suv bor.

words.example: Grandma keeps buttons in an old jam jar.
words.translation: Buvim tugmalarni eski murabbo bankasida saqlaydi.

words.example: The biscuit tin contains sewing things again.
words.translation: Pechenye qutisida yana tikuv buyumlari turibdi.

words.example: Every container has a lid, just never the one I find.
words.translation: Har bir idishning qopqog‘i bor, faqat men topgan qopqoq unga tushmaydi.

words.example: My lunchbox is so full that the sandwich needs a seat belt.
words.translation: Tushlik qutim shunchalik to‘laki, sendvichga xavfsizlik kamari kerak.

words.example: The bread basket is empty, and Dad looks innocent.
words.translation: Non savati bo‘sh, dadam esa o‘zini aybsizdek tutyapti.

words.example: I wrapped the potato in foil like a tiny present.
words.translation: Kartoshkani mitti sovg‘adek zarqog‘ozga o‘radim.

words.example: The cling film sticks to me better than to the bowl.
words.translation: O‘rash plyonkasi kosadan ko‘ra menga yaxshiroq yopishadi.

words.example: He tucked a napkin into his shirt before the tomato soup.
words.translation: U pomidor sho‘rvasini ichishdan oldin yoqasiga salfetka qistirdi.

words.example: Our white tablecloth remembers every family dinner.
words.translation: Oq dasturxonimiz har bir oilaviy kechki ovqatni eslaydi.

words.example: Dad wears an apron to protect his shirt from his cooking.
words.translation: Dadam ko‘ylagini o‘zining pazandaligidan himoya qilish uchun fartuk kiyadi.

words.example: The broom is for the floor, not for flying to the shops.
words.translation: Supurgi do‘konga uchish uchun emas, pol uchun.

words.example: This stiff brush can finally clean my muddy boots.
words.translation: Bu qattiq cho‘tka nihoyat loy etiklarimni tozalay oladi.

words.example: The last crumb refuses to enter the dustpan.
words.translation: Oxirgi ushoq xokandozga kirishni istamayapti.

words.example: The mop has wetter hair than I do after a shower.
words.translation: Pol artgichning sochi dushdan keyingi sochimdan ham ho‘lroq.

words.example: I filled the bucket and immediately wished it had wheels.
words.translation: Chelakni to‘ldirib, darhol uning g‘ildiraklari bo‘lishini istadim.

words.example: The vacuum cleaner eats crumbs and frightens the cat.
words.translation: Changyutkich ushoqlarni yeydi va mushukni qo‘rqitadi.

words.example: My duster has discovered a grey world behind the television.
words.translation: Chang lattam televizor ortidan kulrang dunyo topdi.

words.example: Use a damp cloth; your sleeve is not a cleaning tool.
words.translation: Nam latta ishlating, yengingiz tozalash asbobi emas.

words.example: Dad's old shirt is now a very proud cleaning rag.
words.translation: Dadamning eski ko‘ylagi endi juda mag‘rur tozalash lattasi.

words.example: This detergent smells of flowers I have never met.
words.translation: Bu yuvish vositasidan men hech uchratmagan gullarning hidi keladi.

words.example: A little washing-up liquid makes a mountain of bubbles.
words.translation: Ozgina idish yuvish suyuqligi bir tog‘ ko‘pik hosil qiladi.

words.example: Mum keeps the bleach high up, far from curious hands.
words.translation: Onam oqartiruvchi vositani qiziquvchan qo‘llardan uzoqda, yuqorida saqlaydi.

words.example: The furniture polish makes our old table look important.
words.translation: Mebelga jilo beruvchi vosita eski stolimizni salobatli ko‘rsatadi.

words.example: The bin is full, but nobody wants to be the first to notice.
words.translation: Axlat chelagi to‘la, ammo hech kim buni birinchi bo‘lib payqashni istamaydi.

words.example: This bin bag is carrying the remains of our party.
words.translation: Bu axlat paketida ziyofatimizdan qolgan chiqindilar bor.

words.example: Please take the rubbish out before it starts a new life.
words.translation: Axlat yangi hayot boshlamasidan oldin uni tashqariga olib chiqing.

words.example: There is enough dust on this shelf to write my name.
words.translation: Bu tokchada ismimni yozishga yetadigan chang bor.

words.example: The stain on my shirt looks exactly like Italy.
words.translation: Ko‘ylagimdagi dog‘ xuddi Italiyaga o‘xshaydi.

words.example: Our washing machine dances when it washes towels.
words.translation: Kir yuvish mashinamiz sochiq yuvganda raqsga tushadi.

words.example: The iron is ready for a battle with my shirt.
words.translation: Dazmol ko‘ylagim bilan jang qilishga tayyor.

words.example: The ironing board squeaks louder than our front gate.
words.translation: Dazmol taxtasi old darvozamizdan ham balandroq g‘ichirlaydi.

words.example: One brave peg is holding up Dad's enormous trousers.
words.translation: Bitta jasur kir qisqichi dadamning ulkan shimini ushlab turibdi.

words.example: Our clothesline displays the family's favourite colours.
words.translation: Kir arqonimiz oilamizning sevimli ranglarini namoyish qiladi.

words.example: The laundry pile grows while I am not looking.
words.translation: Men qaramaganimda kir uyumi kattalashadi.

words.example: The tumble dryer returned my jumper in a smaller size.
words.translation: Kir quritish mashinasi jemperimni kichikroq o‘lchamda qaytardi.

words.example: I sweep the kitchen while the dog supplies more crumbs.
words.translation: Men oshxonani supuraman, it esa yana ushoq yetkazib beradi.

words.example: Wipe the table before your elbows stick to it.
words.translation: Tirsaklaringiz yopishib qolmasidan oldin stolni arting.

words.example: We scrubbed the pan until it finally forgave us.
words.translation: Tova nihoyat bizni kechirguncha uni ishqalab tozaladik.

words.example: Rinse the mug unless you enjoy tea with soap.
words.translation: Sovunli choyni yoqtirmasangiz, krujkani chaying.

words.example: I soak dirty dishes while I gather the courage to wash them.
words.translation: Yuvishga jur’at yig‘gunimcha kir idishlarni ivitib qo‘yaman.

words.example: Dry the plates before they create a lake in the cupboard.
words.translation: Javonda ko‘l hosil qilmasidan oldin likopchalarni quriting.

words.example: I fold towels into squares; Dad makes mysterious shapes.
words.translation: Men sochiqlarni to‘rtburchak qilib taxlayman, dadam esa sirli shakllar yasaydi.

words.example: Hang your coat on the hook, not on your little brother.
words.translation: Paltoyingizni ukangizga emas, ilgakka osing.

words.example: We tidy up before guests discover our real lifestyle.
words.translation: Mehmonlar haqiqiy turmush tarzimizni bilib qolmasidan oldin yig‘ishtiramiz.

words.example: Put away the clean socks before the cat adopts them.
words.translation: Toza paypoqlarni mushuk o‘ziniki qilib olmasidan oldin joyiga qo‘ying.

words.example: Who will wash up after my famous three-pan breakfast?
words.translation: Mening mashhur uch tovalik nonushtamdan keyin idishlarni kim yuvadi?

words.example: Let's clear up before Mum sees our flour mountain.
words.translation: Onam un tog‘imizni ko‘rmasidan oldin yig‘ishtiraylik.

words.example: Don't throw away that box; the cat has moved in.
words.translation: U qutini tashlab yubormang, mushuk unga ko‘chib kirgan.

words.example: Please pick up your socks; the floor wants a rest.
words.translation: Iltimos, paypoqlaringizni terib oling, pol dam olmoqchi.

words.example: I sort the laundry while my brother sorts the snacks.
words.translation: Men kirlarni saralayman, akam esa gazaklarni saralaydi.

words.example: Separate white clothes from red ones unless you want pink socks.
words.translation: Pushti paypoq xohlamasangiz, oq kiyimlarni qizillaridan ajrating.

words.example: Empty the bin before the lid gives up.
words.translation: Qopqoq taslim bo‘lmasidan oldin axlat chelagini bo‘shating.

words.example: Fill the kettle, but leave some water for the rest of us.
words.translation: Choynakni to‘ldiring, lekin qolganlarimizga ham suv qoldiring.

words.example: Dad repaired the chair, and now it has one extra screw.
words.translation: Dadam kursini ta’mirladi, endi esa bitta vint ortib qoldi.

words.example: Grandma mended my sock with bright orange thread.
words.translation: Buvim paypog‘imni yorqin to‘q sariq ip bilan yamadi.

words.example: We replaced the broken lamp before another dark dinner.
words.translation: Yana qorong‘ida ovqatlanmaslik uchun singan chiroqni almashtirdik.

words.example: Unplug the iron before we go; it isn't coming with us.
words.translation: Ketishdan oldin dazmolni rozetkadan uzing, u biz bilan bormaydi.

words.example: Switch on the fan before we all turn into soup.
words.translation: Hammamiz sho‘rvaga aylanmasimizdan oldin ventilyatorni yoqing.

words.example: Switch off the light; the furniture can sleep in the dark.
words.translation: Chiroqni o‘chiring, mebel qorong‘ida ham uxlay oladi.

words.example: My favourite chore is testing whether the biscuits are fresh.
words.translation: Sevimli uy yumushim pechenyelar yangiligini tekshirish.

words.example: Boil the potatoes until they stop being little stones.
words.translation: Kartoshkalarni mayda tosh bo‘lmay qolguncha qaynating.

words.example: Dad fries eggs as if he is on a cooking show.
words.translation: Dadam tuxumni pazandalik ko‘rsatuvidagidek qovuradi.

words.example: We bake biscuits whenever the house needs a better smell.
words.translation: Uyga yoqimliroq hid kerak bo‘lsa, pechenye pishiramiz.

words.example: Roast the vegetables until they are brown, not until they look like coal.
words.translation: Sabzavotlarni ko‘mirga o‘xshaguncha emas, qizarguncha duxovkada pishiring.

words.example: I grill peppers while Dad gives expert advice from his chair.
words.translation: Men qalampirlarni grilda pishiraman, dadam esa kursidan mutaxassis maslahatlarini beradi.

words.example: We steam broccoli, but my brother still looks suspicious.
words.translation: Biz brokkolini bug‘da pishiramiz, ammo ukam baribir shubha bilan qaraydi.

words.example: Heat the soup before it forgets it is dinner.
words.translation: Sho‘rva kechki ovqat ekanini unutmasidan oldin uni isiting.

words.example: I peel apples in one long strip and feel very clever.
words.translation: Olmalarning po‘stini bitta uzun tasma qilib archib, o‘zimni juda aqlli his qilaman.

words.example: Chop the onion before it makes you tell a sad story.
words.translation: Piyoz sizga qayg‘uli hikoya ayttirmasidan oldin uni to‘g‘rang.

words.example: Slice the bread thinly; this sandwich is already a tower.
words.translation: Nonni yupqa tilimlang, bu sendvich allaqachon minoraga aylangan.

words.example: Cut the cake fairly; everyone is watching your knife.
words.translation: Tortni teng bo‘lib kesing, hamma pichog‘ingizni kuzatyapti.

words.example: I grate cheese until the pasta disappears underneath it.
words.translation: Makaron tagida ko‘rinmay qolguncha pishloqni qirg‘ichdan o‘tkazaman.

words.example: Mix the flour slowly unless you want a white kitchen.
words.translation: Oq oshxona xohlamasangiz, unni sekin aralashtiring.

words.example: Stir the sauce while I rescue the toast.
words.translation: Men qizargan nonni qutqargunimcha qaylani aralashtirib turing.

words.example: Pour the milk slowly; my breakfast does not need a flood.
words.translation: Sutni sekin quying, nonushtamga suv toshqini kerak emas.

words.example: Add a little chilli if dinner needs some excitement.
words.translation: Kechki ovqatga biroz hayajon kerak bo‘lsa, ozgina achchiq qalampir qo‘shing.

words.example: Weigh the flour, because your huge spoon is not a scale.
words.translation: Unni torting, chunki ulkan qoshig‘ingiz tarozi emas.

words.example: I measure the oil; Dad just hopes for the best.
words.translation: Men yog‘ni o‘lchayman, dadam esa yaxshi chiqishiga umid qiladi, xolos.

words.example: Beat the eggs; they need more exercise than I do today.
words.translation: Tuxumlarni ko‘pirtiring, bugun ularga mendan ko‘ra ko‘proq mashq kerak.

words.example: I knead the dough and imagine it is my Monday problem.
words.translation: Xamirni mushtlab, uni dushanbadagi muammom deb tasavvur qilaman.

words.example: Roll the dough into a circle, or something almost round.
words.translation: Xamirni doira yoki deyarli yumaloq shaklda yoying.

words.example: Spread the butter to the edges; the corners are hungry too.
words.translation: Sariyog‘ni chetlarigacha surting, burchaklar ham och.

words.example: Squeeze the lemon gently unless your shirt needs flavour.
words.translation: Ko‘ylagingizga ta’m kerak bo‘lmasa, limonni sekin siqing.

words.example: Serve the cake quickly before I improve it by eating the edge.
words.translation: Chetini yeb uni yaxshilamasimdan oldin tortni tezroq dasturxonga torting.

words.example: I burned the toast while admiring my perfect egg.
words.translation: Zo‘r chiqqan tuxumimga qoyil qolib, nonni kuydirib qo‘ydim.

words.example: There is flour on my nose, so I must be a baker now.
words.translation: Burnimda un bor, demak endi men novvoyman.

words.example: A little oil stops the eggs from becoming part of the pan.
words.translation: Ozgina yog‘ tuxumlarning tovaga qo‘shilib ketishiga yo‘l qo‘ymaydi.
