words.translation: Omadli ichki kiyimimda hech kim ko‘rmaydigan mitti yulduzlar bor.

words.example: Mum insists on a vest even when the sun is working hard.
words.translation: Quyosh qattiq qizdirganda ham onam ichki mayka kiyishimni talab qiladi.

words.example: My nightdress has pockets for midnight biscuit emergencies.
words.translation: Tungi ko‘ylagimda yarim tunda pechenye kerak bo‘lib qolishi uchun cho‘ntaklar bor.

words.example: These pyjamas are my official weekend uniform.
words.translation: Bu pijama mening rasmiy dam olish kuni formam.

words.example: Dad opened the door in a dressing gown and one sock.
words.translation: Dadam eshikni uy xalati va bitta paypoqda ochdi.

words.example: My yellow raincoat makes grey weather look less serious.
words.translation: Sariq yomg‘irpo‘shim tund ob-havoni kamroq jiddiy ko‘rsatadi.

words.example: I packed my swimsuit before checking whether the hotel had a pool.
words.translation: Mehmonxonada hovuz borligini tekshirmasdan cho‘milish kiyimimni joyladim.

words.example: The bikini takes up less room in my case than my book.
words.translation: Bikini chamadonimda kitobimdan kamroq joy oladi.

words.example: Dad's overalls have more paint than the wall.
words.translation: Dadamning ish kombinezonida devordagidan ko‘proq bo‘yoq bor.

words.example: My dungarees have a front pocket for very important snacks.
words.translation: Kombinezonimning oldida juda muhim gazaklar uchun cho‘ntak bor.

words.example: There is a pebble in my boot that wants to join our walk.
words.translation: Etigimda sayrimizga qo‘shilmoqchi bo‘lgan toshcha bor.

words.example: One sandal is under the bed, enjoying the shade.
words.translation: Bitta sandalim karavot tagida soyada maza qilib yotibdi.

words.example: The dog brought my slipper but charged me a biscuit.
words.translation: It shippagimni olib keldi, lekin xizmatiga pechenye oldi.

words.example: My left trainer squeaks louder than the right one.
words.translation: Chap krossovkam o‘ngidagidan balandroq g‘ichirlaydi.

words.example: This heel makes me taller and much less confident on stairs.
words.translation: Bu poshna meni balandroq qiladi, zinada esa ishonchimni ancha kamaytiradi.

words.example: My shoelace comes undone whenever I am already late.
words.translation: Allaqachon kechikayotganimda oyoq kiyim bog‘ichim yechiladi.

words.example: A new insole made my old boot feel young again.
words.translation: Yangi patak eski etigimni yana yoshartirdi.

words.example: Grandma knitted a scarf long enough for two winters.
words.translation: Buvim ikki qishga yetadigan darajada uzun sharf to‘qidi.

words.example: I found one glove, so half of me is ready for winter.
words.translation: Bitta qo‘lqop topdim, demak yarmim qishga tayyor.

words.example: This mitten keeps four fingers in one cosy room.
words.translation: Bu qo‘lqop to‘rtta barmoqni bitta shinam xonada saqlaydi.

words.example: My belt has a special hole for family dinners.
words.translation: Kamarimda oilaviy kechki ovqatlar uchun maxsus teshik bor.

words.example: Dad's tie is covered in tiny fish wearing hats.
words.translation: Dadamning galstugida qalpoq kiygan mitti baliqlar tasviri bor.

words.example: My cap keeps the sun out of my eyes and hides my hair.
words.translation: Kepkam ko‘zimni quyoshdan asraydi va sochimni yashiradi.

words.example: Her sunhat is wide enough to shade a small picnic.
words.translation: Uning shlyapasi kichik piknikka soya beradigan darajada keng.

words.example: My purse is full of receipts pretending to be money.
words.translation: Hamyonim o‘zini puldek tutayotgan cheklarga to‘la.

words.example: My wallet gets thinner whenever I visit the bakery.
words.translation: Novvoyxonaga borganimda hamyonim yupqalashadi.

words.example: Mum's handbag contains everything except the thing she wants.
words.translation: Onamning sumkasida u izlayotgan narsadan boshqa hamma narsa bor.

words.example: My backpack is mostly snacks with a little space for a book.
words.translation: Ryukzagimning ko‘pi gazak, kitobga esa ozgina joy bor.

words.example: One earring fell behind the sofa and started a treasure hunt.
words.translation: Bitta sirg‘a divan ortiga tushib, xazina qidiruvini boshlab berdi.

words.example: This necklace looks lovely, but my hair keeps getting caught in it.
words.translation: Bu marjon chiroyli ko‘rinadi, lekin sochim unga ilinaveradi.

words.example: My bracelet announces every move with a little rattle.
words.translation: Bilaguzugim har bir harakatimni kichik shiqirlash bilan e’lon qiladi.

words.example: The ring fits perfectly, but the box is bigger than my hand.
words.translation: Uzuk juda mos, lekin qutisi qo‘limdan katta.

words.example: Grandma's brooch is a frog with very serious eyes.
words.translation: Buvimning broshi ko‘zlari juda jiddiy qurbaqa shaklida.

words.example: I wore sunglasses indoors until I remembered they were on my face.
words.translation: Yuzimda ekanini eslagunimcha uyda quyosh ko‘zoynagida yurdim.

words.example: My umbrella turned inside out and became a bowl for rain.
words.translation: Soyabonim teskariga ag‘darilib, yomg‘ir uchun kosaga aylandi.

words.example: This cotton shirt lets me survive the summer politely.
words.translation: Bu paxtali ko‘ylak yozdan odob bilan omon chiqishimga yordam beradi.

words.example: The wool in this jumper remembers being on a warm sheep.
words.translation: Bu jemperning juni issiq qo‘y ustida bo‘lganini eslaydi.

words.example: The silk scarf slides off my chair whenever I look away.
words.translation: Men boshqa tomonga qaraganimda ipak sharf kursimdan sirg‘alib tushadi.

words.example: My leather boots make me feel ready for important puddles.
words.translation: Charm etiklarim o‘zimni muhim ko‘lmaklarga tayyordek his qildiradi.

words.example: This denim jacket has survived three owners and a puppy.
words.translation: Bu jinsi kurtka uchta egasi va bitta kuchukchadan omon qolgan.

words.example: My linen trousers are full of lines again, five minutes after ironing.
words.translation: Zig‘ir matoli shimim dazmollaganimdan besh daqiqa o‘tib yana g‘ijim bo‘ldi.

words.example: The fabric is covered in cherries, so I call it my fruit shirt.
words.translation: Mato gilos rasmlariga to‘la, shuning uchun uni mevali ko‘ylagim deyman.

words.example: One button left my shirt during a very large lunch.
words.translation: Juda katta tushlik paytida ko‘ylagimning bitta tugmasi uzilib ketdi.

words.example: The zip on my jacket refuses to cooperate before breakfast.
words.translation: Kurtkamning molniyasi nonushtagacha hamkorlik qilishni istamaydi.

words.example: This pocket contains a key, a coin, and an ancient sweet.
words.translation: Bu cho‘ntakda kalit, tanga va qadimiy konfet bor.

words.example: My sleeve reached the soup before my spoon did.
words.translation: Yengim sho‘rvaga qoshig‘imdan oldin yetib bordi.

words.example: Dad straightened his collar to answer a phone call.
words.translation: Dadam telefon qo‘ng‘irog‘iga javob berish uchun yoqasini to‘g‘riladi.

words.example: The cuff of my shirt has collected half my breakfast.
words.translation: Ko‘ylagimning manjeti nonushtamning yarmini yig‘ib olgan.

words.example: My hood keeps the rain out and my hairstyle secret.
words.translation: Kapyushonim yomg‘irni to‘sadi va soch turmagimni sir saqlaydi.

words.example: The coat has a bright pink lining that nobody expects.
words.translation: Paltoning hech kim kutmagan yorqin pushti astari bor.

words.example: The pattern on my shirt makes me hard to find near the curtains.
words.translation: Ko‘ylagimdagi naqsh meni pardalar yonida topishni qiyinlashtiradi.

words.example: One red stripe makes these socks look surprisingly sporty.
words.translation: Bitta qizil chiziq bu paypoqlarni kutilmaganda sportcha ko‘rsatadi.

words.example: My waterproof jacket works, but my trousers are having a bath.
words.translation: Suv o‘tkazmaydigan kurtkam ish beryapti, ammo shimim cho‘milyapti.

words.example: I bought a plain shirt to give my noisy trousers some peace.
words.translation: Ko‘zga tashlanadigan shimimga biroz osoyishtalik berish uchun gulsiz ko‘ylak oldim.

words.example: These loose trousers are prepared for Grandma's dinner.
words.translation: Bu keng shim buvimning kechki ovqatiga tayyor.

words.example: This jacket is too tight for both me and my lunch.
words.translation: Bu kurtka menga ham, tushligimga ham torlik qiladi.

words.example: These shoes fit perfectly, so my toes have stopped complaining.
words.translation: Bu oyoq kiyimning o‘lchami juda mos, shuning uchun oyoq barmoqlarim shikoyatni to‘xtatdi.

words.example: I asked for a larger size after meeting the changing-room mirror.
words.translation: Kiyinish xonasidagi oynani ko‘rgach, kattaroq o‘lcham so‘radim.

words.example: I can sew a button on, but it may point in a new direction.
words.translation: Tugma tika olaman, lekin u yangi tomonga qarab qolishi mumkin.

words.example: The thread is red because matching colours requires more patience.
words.translation: Ip qizil, chunki mos rang topish uchun ko‘proq sabr kerak.

words.example: The receipt is longer than the scarf I bought.
words.translation: Xarid cheki olgan sharfimdan ham uzunroq.

words.example: I got a refund for the kettle that refused to boil water.
words.translation: Suv qaynatishni istamagan choynak uchun pulimni qaytarib oldim.

words.example: Can I exchange these giant socks for a pair made for humans?
words.translation: Bu ulkan paypoqlarni odamlar uchun tikilgan juftiga almashtirsam bo‘ladimi?

words.example: The discount made me buy a hat I did not need.
words.translation: Chegirma menga kerak bo‘lmagan shlyapani sotib olishga undadi.

words.example: I went to the sale for one shirt and returned with five.
words.translation: Chegirmali savdoga bitta ko‘ylak uchun borib, beshtasi bilan qaytdim.

words.example: This coat was a bargain until I paid to fix all the buttons.
words.translation: Barcha tugmalarini tuzatishga pul bergunimcha bu palto yaxshi arzon xarid edi.

words.example: At the checkout, I remembered the milk I came for.
words.translation: Kassada aynan sut uchun kelganimni esladim.

words.example: The cashier smiled at my basket of emergency chocolate.
words.translation: Kassir zarurat uchun olgan shokoladlarimga to‘la savatimga qarab jilmaydi.

words.example: I was the only customer comparing six nearly identical mugs.
words.translation: Deyarli bir xil oltita krujkani solishtirayotgan yagona xaridor men edim.

words.example: I joined the shortest queue, and it immediately stopped moving.
words.translation: Eng qisqa navbatga turdim va u darhol yurmay qoldi.

words.example: My trolley has one wheel with its own shopping plans.
words.translation: Xarid aravachamning bitta g‘ildiragida o‘z xarid rejalari bor.

words.example: The fitting room is smaller than the coat I am trying on.
words.translation: Kiyib ko‘rish xonasi men sinayotgan paltodan ham kichikroq.

words.example: The label says wash by hand, so this jumper is demanding.
words.translation: Yorliqda qo‘lda yuving deyilgan, demak bu jemper talabchan.

words.example: I wore the new shirt with the tag still waving behind me.
words.translation: Yangi ko‘ylakni osma yorlig‘i orqamda hilpiragan holda kiyib yurdim.

words.example: I forgot the brand but remembered the biscuit flavour.
words.translation: Mahsulot markasini unutdim, ammo pechenye ta’mini eslab qoldim.

words.example: The parcel arrived, and the cat claimed the box first.
words.translation: Jo‘natma keldi va mushuk qutini birinchi bo‘lib egalladi.

words.example: The package is huge, but the earrings inside are tiny.
words.translation: Qadoq ulkan, ammo ichidagi sirg‘alar mitti.

words.example: My latest purchase is a spoon shaped like a little shovel.
words.translation: Eng so‘nggi xaridim kichkina belkurak shaklidagi qoshiq.

words.example: My order includes six towels because guests keep appearing.
words.translation: Mehmonlar kelaverayotgani uchun buyurtmamga oltita sochiq kiritdim.

words.example: The delivery came while I was wearing my least serious pyjamas.
words.translation: Buyurtma eng kulgili pijamamni kiyib turganimda yetkazib berildi.

words.example: The shop has plenty of stock, except for my size.
words.translation: Do‘konda mahsulot ko‘p, faqat mening o‘lchamim yo‘q.

words.example: The boots are available in every colour except the one I want.
words.translation: Etiklar men xohlaganidan boshqa barcha rangda mavjud.

words.example: The cheap mugs are sold out, so my wallet can relax.
words.translation: Arzon krujkalar sotilib bo‘lgan, demak hamyonim dam olishi mumkin.

words.example: I will try on the hat before giving it such a serious job.
words.translation: Shlyapaga shunday jiddiy vazifa berishdan oldin uni kiyib ko‘raman.

words.example: The shopkeeper knows I always return for more biscuits.
words.translation: Do‘kondor yana pechenye uchun qaytishimni biladi.

words.example: The soap slipped away as if it also disliked washing.
words.translation: Sovun ham yuvinishni yoqtirmagandek sirg‘alib ketdi.

words.example: This shampoo promises shiny hair, but mine remains independent.
words.translation: Bu shampun yaltiroq sochni va’da qiladi, ammo mening sochim o‘z bilganidan qolmaydi.

words.example: The conditioner helped my comb travel through my hair peacefully.
words.translation: Soch balzami tarog‘imning sochim orasidan tinchgina o‘tishiga yordam berdi.

words.example: I squeezed the toothpaste and decorated the basin by mistake.
words.translation: Tish pastasini siqib, bilmasdan yuz-qo‘l yuvgichni bezadim.

words.example: My electric toothbrush sounds more awake than I feel.
words.translation: Elektr tish cho‘tkam mendan ko‘ra uyg‘oqroq ovoz chiqaradi.

words.example: The floss found a popcorn piece that wanted to stay overnight.
words.translation: Tish ipi tunab qolmoqchi bo‘lgan bodroq bo‘lagini topdi.

words.example: Dad packed his razor but forgot his shirts.
words.translation: Dadam ustara joyladi, lekin ko‘ylaklarini unutdi.

words.example: This comb has a difficult meeting with my hair every morning.
words.translation: Bu taroq har tong sochim bilan qiyin uchrashuv o‘tkazadi.

words.example: My hairbrush is hiding because it knows how I slept.
words.translation: Soch cho‘tkam qanday uxlaganimni bilgani uchun yashirinib olgan.

words.example: The hairdryer gives me warm air and a very large hairstyle.
words.translation: Fen menga issiq havo va juda katta soch turmagi beradi.

words.example: I remembered my deodorant just before a very crowded bus ride.
words.translation: Juda gavjum avtobusga chiqish oldidan dezodorantimni esladim.

words.example: Her perfume entered the room a second before she did.
words.translation: Uning atiri xonaga o‘zidan bir soniya oldin kirdi.

words.example: This lotion smells like coconut, so my hands feel on holiday.
words.translation: Bu losondan kokos hidi keladi, shuning uchun qo‘llarim ta’tildagidek.

words.example: My hands are so dry that they seem to drink the moisturiser.
words.translation: Qo‘llarim shunchalik quruqki, go‘yo namlantiruvchi kremni ichayotgandek.

words.example: I put on sunscreen before my nose turns into a tomato.
words.translation: Burnim pomidorga aylanmasidan oldin quyoshdan himoya kremi surtaman.

words.example: A tissue in my pocket survived everything except the washing machine.
words.translation: Cho‘ntagimdagi salfetka kir yuvish mashinasidan boshqa hamma narsadan omon qoldi.

words.example: The cotton wool looks like a little cloud on the bathroom shelf.
words.translation: Gigiyenik paxta hammom tokchasidagi mitti bulutga o‘xshaydi.

words.example: The nail clippers are tiny, which makes losing them very easy.
words.translation: Tirnoq olgich mitti, shu sababli uni yo‘qotish juda oson.

words.example: My nail file keeps my nails from becoming tiny hooks.
words.translation: Tirnoq egovim tirnoqlarimning mitti ilgaklarga aylanishiga yo‘l qo‘ymaydi.

words.example: I found the tweezers after giving up on my stubborn eyebrow.
words.translation: Qaysar qoshimdan umidni uzgach, pinsetni topdim.

words.example: My lipstick left a red hello on the white cup.
words.translation: Lab bo‘yog‘im oq piyolada qizil salom qoldirdi.

words.example: I applied mascara and immediately felt a sneeze coming.
words.translation: Kiprigimga tush surtdim va darhol aksirgim keldi.

words.example: My make-up took twenty minutes, but washing it off took two.
words.translation: Pardozim yigirma daqiqa oldi, uni yuvish esa ikki daqiqa.

words.example: This shower gel smells of mangoes, so breakfast feels close.
words.translation: Bu dush gelidan mango hidi keladi, shuning uchun nonushta yaqindek tuyuladi.

words.example: I added too much bubble bath and lost sight of my knees.
words.translation: Juda ko‘p vanna ko‘pigi qo‘shib, tizzalarimni ko‘rmay qoldim.

words.example: Dad shaves one side, then checks whether he looks younger.
words.translation: Dadam bir tomonini qirib, yoshroq ko‘rinayotganini tekshiradi.

words.example: I bathe in the evening with a rubber duck for company.
words.translation: Kechqurun rezina o‘rdakni hamroh qilib vannada cho‘milaman.

words.example: We dress up for dinner even when the dinner is pizza.
words.translation: Kechki ovqat pitsa bo‘lsa ham, biz tantanali kiyinamiz.

words.example: I get dressed slowly while my alarm clock judges me.
words.translation: Budilnigim meni ayblab turganida sekin kiyinaman.

words.example: I undress for bed and find a biscuit crumb in my sleeve.
words.translation: Uxlash uchun kiyimimni yechib, yengimdan pechenye ushog‘ini topaman.

words.example: Put on your slippers; the floor is colder than your ice cream.
words.translation: Shippagingizni kiying, pol muzqaymog‘ingizdan ham sovuqroq.

words.example: Take off that heavy coat before you cook inside it.
words.translation: Ichida pishib qolmasdan o‘sha og‘ir paltoni yeching.

words.example: I can fasten this necklace only when nobody is watching.
words.translation: Bu marjonni faqat hech kim qaramayotganda taqa olaman.

words.example: I unfasten my collar as soon as the formal photos are done.
words.translation: Rasmiy suratlar olinishi bilan yoqamning tugmasini ochaman.

words.example: Tie up your hair before it decides to taste the soup.
words.translation: Sochingiz sho‘rvani tatib ko‘rishga qaror qilmasidan oldin uni yig‘ib bog‘lang.

words.example: I asked him to trim my hair, not change my identity.
words.translation: Undan sochimni uchidan olishni so‘radim, kimligimni o‘zgartirishni emas.

words.example: Rub the cream into your hands before touching my clean mirror.
words.translation: Toza oynamga tegishdan oldin kremni qo‘llaringizga ishqalab singdiring.

words.example: I massage my tired feet and thank them for the shopping trip.
words.translation: Charchagan oyoqlarimni uqalab, xarid sayri uchun ularga rahmat aytaman.

words.example: Apply a little cream; your face is not a birthday cake.
words.translation: Ozgina krem surting, yuzingiz tug‘ilgan kun torti emas.

words.example: Remove your make-up before your pillow starts wearing it.
words.translation: Yostig‘ingiz pardoz qila boshlamasidan oldin yuzingizdagi pardozni tozalang.

words.example: My new haircut makes my ears feel more famous.
words.translation: Yangi soch turmagim quloqlarimni mashhurroq his qildiradi.

words.example: The wind gave me a hairstyle I would never choose.
words.translation: Shamol menga hech qachon tanlamaydigan soch turmagini berdi.

words.example: My ponytail swings like a small clock when I walk.
words.translation: Yurganimda dum qilib bog‘langan sochim kichik soatdek tebranadi.

words.example: My fringe is long enough to read my book before I do.
words.translation: Kokilim kitobimni mendan oldin o‘qiydigan darajada uzun.

words.example: My parting is straight today, which feels like a small victory.
words.translation: Bugun sochimning ajratilgan chizig‘i tekis, bu kichik g‘alabadek tuyuladi.

words.example: His beard caught a crumb and saved it for later.
words.translation: Uning soqoli bir ushoqni tutib, keyinga saqlab qo‘ydi.

words.example: Grandpa's moustache gets a white tip whenever he drinks milk.
words.translation: Bobom sut ichganida mo‘ylovining uchi oqaradi.

words.example: One nail broke just after I finished painting the others.
words.translation: Boshqa tirnoqlarimni bo‘yab bo‘lishim bilan bittasi sindi.

words.example: One curl stands up every morning to greet the world.
words.translation: Bitta jingalak har tong dunyoga salom berish uchun tik turadi.

words.example: The fragrance of this soap turns our bathroom into a rose garden.
words.translation: Bu sovunning xushbo‘y hidi hammomimizni atirgul bog‘iga aylantiradi.

words.example: I travel with a very noisy suitcase.
words.translation: Men juda shovqinli chamadon bilan sayohat qilaman.

words.example: Our trip began with a missing shoe.
words.translation: Sayohatimiz yo‘qolgan tuflidan boshlandi.

words.example: Even my alarm clock needs a holiday.
words.translation: Hatto budilnigimga ham ta’til kerak.

words.example: The castle tour ended in the kitchen.
words.translation: Qal’a ekskursiyasi oshxonada tugadi.

words.example: A tourist photographed our ordinary dustbin.
words.translation: Bir sayyoh oddiy axlat qutimizni suratga oldi.

words.example: Our first visitor asked about lunch.
words.translation: Birinchi tashrif buyuruvchimiz tushlik haqida so‘radi.

words.example: The guide knew every sleeping cat.
words.translation: Gid uxlayotgan har bir mushukni tanirdi.

words.example: My passport photo frightens even me.
words.translation: Pasportdagi suratim hatto o‘zimni ham qo‘rqitadi.

words.example: My visa arrived before my suitcase.
words.translation: Vizam chamadonimdan oldin yetib keldi.

words.example: Abroad, Dad still searches for plov.
words.translation: Dadam chet elda ham osh izlaydi.

words.example: Our destination is somewhere without homework.
words.translation: Boradigan manzilimiz uy vazifasi bo‘lmaydigan bir joy.

words.example: This route passes three cake shops.
words.translation: Bu yo‘nalish uchta tort do‘koni yonidan o‘tadi.

words.example: You are holding the map upside down.
words.translation: Siz xaritani teskari ushlab turibsiz.

words.example: Our booking is for two, not twenty.
words.translation: Bandlovimiz yigirma emas, ikki kishi uchun.

words.example: The reservation includes a surprisingly tiny room.
words.translation: Bandlovga hayratlanarli darajada kichik xona kiradi.

words.example: Departure is at six; Dad wakes at seven.
words.translation: Jo‘nab ketish oltida; dadam yettida uyg‘onadi.

words.example: Our arrival woke the hotel dog.
words.translation: Yetib kelganimiz mehmonxona itini uyg‘otdi.

words.example: I bought a return because the cat expects me.
words.translation: Mushuk meni kutgani uchun borish-qaytish chiptasini oldim.

words.example: The bus fare costs less than my sandwich.
words.translation: Avtobus yo‘l haqi sendvichimdan arzon.

words.example: One passenger brought a very large cactus.
words.translation: Bir yo‘lovchi juda katta kaktus olib keldi.

words.example: The timetable is clearer than Dad's plan.
words.translation: Qatnov jadvali dadamning rejasidan tushunarliroq.

words.example: The delay gave us time for another cake.
words.translation: Kechikish bizga yana bir tort yeyishga vaqt berdi.

words.example: Please cancel the trip to the volcano.
words.translation: Iltimos, vulqonga sayohatni bekor qiling.

words.example: Let's explore before the pigeons find us.
words.translation: Kabutarlar bizni topmasidan oldin aylanib chiqaylik.

words.example: After sightseeing, even my shoes needed rest.
words.translation: Diqqatga sazovor joylarni tomosha qilgach, hatto tuflilarim ham damga muhtoj edi.

words.example: Our luggage took a different holiday.
words.translation: Yuklarimiz boshqa joyga ta’tilga ketibdi.

words.example: This suitcase contains more snacks than clothes.
words.translation: Bu chamadonda kiyimdan ko‘ra yegulik ko‘p.

words.example: My washbag contains enough soap for a month.
words.translation: Yuvinish sumkachamda bir oyga yetadigan sovun bor.

words.example: A squirrel inspected my rucksack for nuts.
words.translation: Bir olmaxon yong‘oq qidirib ryukzagimni tekshirdi.

words.example: Pack your socks, not the whole drawer.
words.translation: Paypoqlaringizni joylang, butun tortmani emas.

words.example: I unpack slowly to make holidays last.
words.translation: Ta’til uzoqroq tuyulishi uchun buyumlarni sekin chiqaraman.

words.example: Our baggage arrived before our sleepy uncle did.
words.translation: Yuklarimiz uyquchi amakimizdan oldin yetib keldi.

words.example: The padlock protects my emergency biscuits.
words.translation: Osma qulf favqulodda vaziyat uchun pechenyelarimni qo‘riqlaydi.

words.meaning: chodir tagiga yoziladigan suv o‘tkazmas to‘shama
words.example: Our groundsheet kept the tent dry all night.
words.translation: Chodir tagidagi to‘shama uni tun bo‘yi quruq saqladi.

words.example: My goggles help me find coins in the pool.
words.translation: Suzish ko‘zoynagim hovuzdagi tangalarni topishga yordam beradi.

words.example: The strap is longer than my little brother.
words.translation: Sumka tasmasi ukamdan uzunroq.

words.example: I packed an adapter but forgot my charger.
words.translation: Elektr vilkasi moslagichini oldim, lekin quvvatlagichimni unutdim.

words.example: Grandpa's walking stick reached the hilltop before I did.
words.translation: Bobomning hassasi tepalik cho‘qqisiga mendan oldin yetdi.

words.example: My earplugs make Dad's snoring almost musical.
words.translation: Quloq tiqinlarim dadamning xurragini deyarli musiqadek eshittiradi.

words.example: In flippers, I swim like a fish and walk like a duck.
words.translation: Suzish kurakchalarida baliqdek suzaman, o‘rdakdek yuraman.

words.example: We packed insect repellent to keep mosquitoes away.
words.translation: Chivinlarni uzoqlashtirish uchun hasharotga qarshi vosita oldik.

words.example: My bumbag holds my passport and emergency biscuits.
words.translation: Bel sumkamda pasportim va zarurat uchun pechenye bor.

words.example: The torch found my shoes and a frog.
words.translation: Fonar tuflimni va bir qurbaqani topdi.

words.example: The compass points north, not towards lunch.
words.translation: Kompas tushlik tomon emas, shimolni ko‘rsatadi.

words.example: Our guidebook forgot to mention the goats.
words.translation: Sayohat qo‘llanmamiz echkilarni tilga olishni unutibdi.

words.example: My souvenir is too large for the plane.
words.translation: Esdalik buyumim samolyot uchun juda katta.

words.example: The postcard arrived after we came home.
words.translation: Pochta kartochkasi uyga qaytganimizdan keyin keldi.

words.example: The camera caught Dad stealing a biscuit.
words.translation: Fotoapparat dadamning pechenye o‘g‘irlayotganini suratga oldi.

words.example: Through binoculars, that sheep looks enormous.
words.translation: Durbindan qaraganda anavi qo‘y ulkan ko‘rinadi.

words.example: My flask keeps tea warmer than my hands.
words.translation: Termosim choyni qo‘llarimdan issiqroq saqlaydi.

words.example: Our flight was shorter than Dad's story.
words.translation: Parvozimiz dadamning hikoyasidan qisqaroq bo‘ldi.

words.example: This airline gives children tiny pilot hats.
words.translation: Bu aviakompaniya bolalarga kichkina uchuvchi qalpoqlari beradi.

words.example: The toy aeroplane has more seats than our car.
words.translation: O‘yinchoq samolyotning o‘rindig‘i mashinamiznikidan ko‘p.

words.example: A helicopter blew away our picnic napkins.
words.translation: Vertolyot sayrdagi salfetkalarimizni uchirib yubordi.

words.example: The pilot waved, but not while landing.
words.translation: Uchuvchi qo‘l silkidi, lekin qo‘nish paytida emas.

words.example: The crew found my teddy before take-off.
words.translation: Ekipaj parvozdan oldin o‘yinchoq ayig‘imni topdi.

words.example: The cabin became quiet when snacks arrived.
words.translation: Yegulik kelganda salon jim bo‘lib qoldi.

words.example: The cockpit has more buttons than my coat.
words.translation: Uchuvchilar kabinasida paltomdagidan ko‘proq tugma bor.

words.example: A rabbit delayed us on the runway.
words.translation: Uchish-qo‘nish yo‘lagidagi quyon bizni kechiktirdi.

words.example: We walked around the terminal for exercise.
words.translation: Mashq uchun aeroport terminalini aylanib yurdik.

words.example: Our stopover gave Dad time for two breakfasts.
words.translation: Parvozlar orasidagi to‘xtash dadamga ikki marta nonushta qilishga vaqt berdi.

words.example: My long legs nearly filled the aisle.
words.translation: Uzun oyoqlarim deyarli butun yo‘lakni egalladi.

words.example: My seat is next to a snoring uncle.
words.translation: O‘rindig‘im xurrak otayotgan bir amaki yonida.

words.example: Fasten your seatbelt before your sandwich escapes.
words.translation: Sendvichingiz qochib ketmasidan xavfsizlik kamarini taqing.

words.example: I photographed the wing seventeen times.
words.translation: Qanotni o‘n yetti marta suratga oldim.

words.example: The engine is louder than my headphones.
words.translation: Dvigatel quloqchinimdan balandroq ovoz chiqaradi.

words.example: We board first because Grandma walks slowly.
words.translation: Buvim sekin yurgani uchun biz birinchi chiqamiz.

words.example: Our non-stop flight was shorter than Dad's story.
words.translation: Oraliq qo‘nishsiz parvozimiz dadamning hikoyasidan qisqaroq bo‘ldi.

words.example: We land just in time for breakfast.
words.translation: Biz aynan nonushtaga vaqtida qo‘namiz.

words.example: We check in with six identical suitcases.
words.translation: Biz oltita bir xil chamadon bilan ro‘yxatdan o‘tamiz.

words.example: At customs, Dad explained his enormous teapot.
words.translation: Bojxonada dadam ulkan choynagi haqida tushuntirdi.

words.example: At security, my boots got their own tray.
words.translation: Xavfsizlik tekshiruvida etiklarimga alohida patnis berildi.

words.example: Your boarding pass is under your muffin.
words.translation: Samolyotga chiqish taloningiz keksingizning tagida.

words.example: My hat is overhead with the luggage.
words.translation: Shlyapam boshim ustida, yuklar yonida.

words.example: The jet disappeared before I found my camera.
words.translation: Fotoapparatimni topgunimcha reaktiv samolyot ko‘zdan g‘oyib bo‘ldi.

words.example: The tram bell interrupted my terrible singing.
words.translation: Tramvay qo‘ng‘irog‘i yomon qo‘shiq aytishimni to‘xtatdi.

words.example: We took the underground to avoid wet hair.
words.translation: Sochimiz ho‘l bo‘lmasligi uchun metroda bordik.

words.example: The metro map looks like colourful spaghetti.
words.translation: Metro xaritasi rangli spagettiga o‘xshaydi.

words.example: Everyone on the coach heard Dad's joke.
words.translation: Shaharlararo avtobusdagilarning hammasi dadamning hazilini eshitdi.

words.example: Our minibus carried twelve people and a cake.
words.translation: Mikroavtobusimiz o‘n ikki kishi va bir tortni tashidi.

words.example: The van delivers bread before I wake up.
words.translation: Furgon nonni men uyg‘onishimdan oldin yetkazadi.

words.example: A lorry carried a mountain of onions.
words.translation: Yuk mashinasi bir tog‘ piyoz tashidi.

words.example: His motorbike is shinier than our mirror.
words.translation: Uning mototsikli ko‘zgumizdan yaltiroq.

words.example: She reached the bakery on her scooter.
words.translation: U nonvoyxonaga samokatida yetib bordi.

words.example: That vehicle has more wheels than seats.
words.translation: Anavi transport vositasining g‘ildiragi o‘rindig‘idan ko‘p.

words.example: We moved aside for the ambulance immediately.
words.translation: Tez yordam mashinasiga darhol yo‘l berdik.

words.example: The tractor pulled our car from the mud.
words.translation: Traktor mashinamizni loydan tortib chiqardi.

words.example: Our caravan has a kitchen for tiny cooks.
words.translation: Tirkama uyimizda kichkina oshpazlarga mos oshxona bor.

words.example: The railway runs behind Grandma's chickens.
words.translation: Temiryo‘l buvimning tovuqlari orqasidan o‘tadi.

words.example: A shiny rail reflected my bright socks.
words.translation: Yaltiroq relsda yorqin paypoqlarim aks etdi.

words.example: We waited on the platform with cold chips.
words.translation: Biz platformada sovib qolgan kartoshka bilan kutdik.

words.example: Our carriage smelled of oranges and adventure.
words.translation: Vagonimizdan apelsin va sarguzasht hidi kelardi.

words.example: The conductor smiled at my upside-down ticket.
words.translation: Chipta tekshiruvchi teskari turgan chiptamga qarab kulimsiradi.

words.example: The sleepy commuter nearly missed his stop.
words.translation: Uyquchi qatnovchi tushadigan bekatini deyarli o‘tkazib yubordi.

words.example: One pedestrian walked faster than our bus.
words.translation: Bir piyoda avtobusimizdan tezroq yurdi.

words.example: The cyclist waved with a banana in hand.
words.translation: Velosipedchi qo‘lida banan bilan salomlashdi.

words.example: I ride my bike to earn my breakfast.
words.translation: Nonushtamga munosib bo‘lish uchun velosiped minaman.

words.example: Get on the bus before Dad starts singing.
words.translation: Dadam qo‘shiq boshlamasidan avtobusga chiqing.

words.example: We get off near the giant doughnut sign.
words.translation: Biz ulkan ponchik belgisi yonida tushamiz.

words.example: Even bicycles overtake our old bus.
words.translation: Eski avtobusimizni hatto velosipedlar ham quvib o‘tadi.

words.example: The traffic gave Dad time for ten stories.
words.translation: Tirbandlik dadamga o‘nta hikoya uchun vaqt berdi.

words.example: We left the motorway to find proper tea.
words.translation: Yaxshi choy topish uchun avtomagistraldan chiqdik.

words.example: At the junction, Dad finally trusted the map.
words.translation: Yo‘llar tutashgan joyda dadam nihoyat xaritaga ishondi.

words.example: We passed the same roundabout three times.
words.translation: Bir xil aylanma chorrahadan uch marta o‘tdik.

words.example: At the crossroads, Dad chose the road towards cake.
words.translation: Chorrahada dadam tort tomon ketadigan yo‘lni tanladi.

words.example: Stay in this lane; lunch can wait.
words.translation: Shu qatorda qoling; tushlik kutib turadi.

words.example: A pigeon owned most of the pavement.
words.translation: Piyodalar yo‘lagining katta qismi bir kabutarga tegishli edi.

words.example: We used the crossing behind a slow duck.
words.translation: Sekin o‘rdak ortidan piyodalar o‘tish joyidan o‘tdik.

words.example: The traffic lights turned red at every junction.
words.translation: Har chorrahada svetofor qizilga o‘tdi.

words.example: The signpost promised cake in two kilometres.
words.translation: Yo‘l ko‘rsatkich ikki kilometrdan keyin tort va’da qildi.

words.example: The bridge shook when our whole class laughed.
words.translation: Butun sinfimiz kulganda ko‘prik silkindi.

words.example: Dad stopped singing when we left the tunnel.
words.translation: Tunneldan chiqqanimizda dadam kuylashdan to‘xtadi.

words.example: The car needs petrol; I need lunch.
words.translation: Mashinaga benzin kerak; menga tushlik.

words.example: This van uses diesel, not Dad's cooking oil.
words.translation: Bu furgon dadamning osh yog‘ida emas, dizelda yuradi.

words.example: Our fuel lasted longer than our snacks.
words.translation: Yoqilg‘imiz yeguliklarimizdan uzoqroqqa yetdi.

words.example: Test the brake before the hill tests you.
words.translation: Tepalik sizni sinashidan oldin tormozni tekshiring.

words.example: A flat tyre cancelled our race with lunch.
words.translation: Pachoq shina tushlikka shoshilishimizni to‘xtatdi.

words.example: One wheel made a noise like a duck.
words.translation: Bir g‘ildirak o‘rdakdek ovoz chiqardi.

words.example: Keep both hands on the steering wheel.
words.translation: Ikkala qo‘lingizni rulda tuting.

words.example: A leaf stuck to the windscreen like a sticker.
words.translation: Barg old oynaga yopishtirmadek yopishib qoldi.

words.example: A butterfly rested on our muddy bumper.
words.translation: Kapalak loy bamperimizga qo‘nib dam oldi.

words.example: A cat warmed itself on the bonnet.
words.translation: Bir mushuk kapotda isinib yotdi.

words.example: The horn sounded like an unhappy goose.
words.translation: Mashina signali norozi g‘ozdek yangradi.

words.example: One headlight lit up a surprised rabbit.
words.translation: Bir old fara hayron quyonni yoritdi.

words.example: Parking here requires more patience than driving.
words.translation: Bu yerda mashina qo‘yish haydashdan ko‘proq sabr talab qiladi.

words.example: Our ship was bigger than the village.
words.translation: Kemamiz qishloqdan kattaroq edi.

words.example: The ferry carried our car across the bay.
words.translation: Parom mashinamizni qo‘ltiqning narigi tomoniga olib o‘tdi.

words.example: His yacht has room for one jealous uncle.
words.translation: Uning yaxtasida bitta hasadgo‘y amakiga joy bor.

words.example: Our canoe turned round without asking us.
words.translation: Kanoemiz bizdan so‘ramay aylanib ketdi.

words.example: I entered the kayak with surprising difficulty.
words.translation: Kayakka chiqishim kutilmaganda qiyin bo‘ldi.

words.example: The raft carried us and our wet sandwiches.
words.translation: Sol bizni va ho‘l sendvichlarimizni olib o‘tdi.

words.example: The sail filled with wind before Dad sat down.
words.translation: Dadam o‘tirmasidan yelkan shamolga to‘ldi.

words.example: The sailor tied knots faster than I blinked.
words.translation: Dengizchi ko‘z yumib ochgunimcha tugun bog‘ladi.

words.example: The captain let Grandma ring the bell.
words.translation: Kapitan buvimga qo‘ng‘iroq chalishga ruxsat berdi.

words.example: We ate biscuits on the windy deck.
words.translation: Shamolli palubada pechenye yedik.

words.example: The anchor is heavier than our whole picnic.
words.translation: Langar butun sayr yeguliklarimizdan og‘irroq.

words.example: That rope holds the boat, not your trousers.
words.translation: Anavi arqon shimingizni emas, qayiqni ushlab turibdi.

words.example: I dropped an oar and gained a story.
words.translation: Eshkakni tushirib yuborib, aytadigan hikoyamni ko‘paytirdim.

words.example: We paddle slowly because the ducks are watching.
words.translation: O‘rdaklar kuzatayotgani uchun sekin eshkak eshamiz.

words.example: Can you row while I protect the cake?
words.translation: Men tortni asragunimcha eshkak esha olasizmi?

words.example: The harbour smelled of fish and breakfast.
words.translation: Bandargohdan baliq va nonushta hidi kelardi.

words.example: Our ship reached port before my tea cooled.
words.translation: Choyim sovimasidan kemamiz portga yetdi.

words.example: A sleepy seal waited beside the dock.
words.translation: Uyquchi tyulen kemalar turadigan joy yonida kutdi.

words.example: Grandpa lost his hat from the pier.
words.translation: Bobom suv ustidagi sayr yo‘lagida shlyapasini yo‘qotdi.

words.example: The lighthouse is a very tall night lamp.
words.translation: Mayoq juda baland tungi chiroqdir.

words.example: The cruise offered breakfast almost everywhere.
words.translation: Kema sayohatida deyarli hamma yerda nonushta taklif qilindi.

words.example: I felt seasick before we left the harbour.
words.translation: Bandargohdan chiqmasimizdan ko‘nglim aynidi.

words.example: My life jacket makes me look like an orange.
words.translation: Qutqaruv nimcham meni apelsinga o‘xshatadi.

words.example: We practised finding the lifeboat before lunch.
words.translation: Tushlikdan oldin qutqaruv qayig‘ini topishni mashq qildik.

words.example: The sailors rescue people, not floating biscuits.
words.translation: Dengizchilar suzib yurgan pechenyelarni emas, odamlarni qutqaradi.

words.example: The hostel had six beds and seven backpacks.
words.translation: Hostelda oltita karavot va yettita ryukzak bor edi.

words.example: Our guesthouse serves breakfast with local gossip.
words.translation: Mehmon uyimizda nonushta mahalliy gap-so‘zlar bilan beriladi.

words.example: The motel sign was brighter than the moon.
words.translation: Yo‘l bo‘yidagi mehmonxona yozuvi oydan yorqinroq edi.

words.example: Our campsite included some very curious sheep.
words.translation: Chodir tikkan joyimizda juda qiziquvchan qo‘ylar ham bor edi.

words.example: This resort has more pools than I have socks.
words.translation: Bu dam olish maskanining hovuzi paypoqlarimdan ko‘p.

words.example: Our accommodation includes a cat on the sofa.
words.translation: Vaqtincha turar joyimizga divandagi mushuk ham kiradi.

words.example: At reception, I asked for a quieter pillow.
words.translation: Qabulxonada ovozi pastroq yostiq so‘radim.

words.example: The receptionist remembered my enormous purple suitcase.
words.translation: Qabulxona xodimi ulkan binafsha chamadonimni esladi.

words.example: One guest brought slippers for his dog.
words.translation: Bir mehmon itiga shippak olib keldi.

words.example: Our host fed us like hungry footballers.
words.translation: Mehmon kutuvchimiz bizni och futbolchilardek to‘ydirdi.

words.example: A sleepy pianist played in the lobby.
words.translation: Kirish zalida uyquchi pianinochi kuy chaldi.

words.example: The lift arrived faster than our youngest cousin.
words.translation: Lift eng kichik amakivachchamizdan tezroq keldi.

words.example: Our chalet had a mountain view and a nosy goat.
words.translation: Tog‘dagi uyimizda tog‘ manzarasi va qiziquvchan echki bor edi.

words.example: Our corridor seems longer when I carry bags.
words.translation: Sumka ko‘targanimda yo‘lagimiz uzunroq tuyuladi.

words.example: The cottage was small, but its spiders were not.
words.translation: Qishloq uyi kichkina edi, lekin o‘rgimchaklari unday emasdi.

words.example: Our holiday apartment had three clocks, all wrong.
words.translation: Ta’tilga olgan kvartiramizda uchta soat bor edi, hammasi noto‘g‘ri.

words.example: The hostel dormitory had eight beds and one loud sleeper.
words.translation: Hostel yotoqxonasida sakkizta karavot va bitta shovqinli uxlovchi bor edi.

words.example: Our hotel suite was bigger than our flat.
words.translation: Mehmonxonadagi nomerimiz kvartiramizdan kattaroq edi.

words.example: The porter lifted my suitcase more easily than I did.
words.translation: Yuk tashuvchi chamadonimni mendan osonroq ko‘tardi.

words.example: Room service brought breakfast before I found my slippers.
words.translation: Xonaga taom yetkazish xizmati shippagimni topmasimdan nonushta olib keldi.

words.example: A single room leaves little space for dancing.
words.translation: Bir kishilik xonada raqsga kam joy qoladi.

words.example: Our double bed fits us and one small suitcase.
words.translation: Ikki kishilik karavotimizga biz va bitta kichik chamadon sig‘adi.

words.example: The only vacancy was above a singing club.
words.translation: Yagona bo‘sh xona qo‘shiqchilar klubi tepasida edi.

words.example: We check out at ten, after one last pancake.
words.translation: Oxirgi quymoqdan keyin soat o‘nda mehmonxonadan chiqamiz.

words.example: We stayed overnight beside a very loud river.
words.translation: Juda shovqinli daryo yonida bir kecha qoldik.

words.example: The picnic location pleased everyone except the ants.
words.translation: Sayr joyi chumolilardan boshqa hammaga yoqdi.

words.example: Our tent's position surprised the morning cows.
words.translation: Chodirimizning turgan joyi ertalab sigirlarni hayron qoldirdi.

words.example: We chose the direction with fewer hills.
words.translation: Tepaligi kamroq yo‘nalishni tanladik.

words.example: The distance felt longer without any biscuits.
words.translation: Pechenyesiz masofa uzoqroq tuyuldi.

words.example: We drove north until Dad wanted tea.
words.translation: Dadam choy xohlaguncha shimolga yurdik.

words.example: The birds flew south without buying tickets.
words.translation: Qushlar chipta sotib olmay janubga uchdi.

words.example: Our hotel faces east, so breakfast is bright.
words.translation: Mehmonxonamiz sharqqa qaragan, shuning uchun nonushta joyi yorug‘.

words.example: Head west and follow the smell of bread.
words.translation: G‘arbga yuring va non hidiga ergashing.

words.example: The beach is on your left, behind Dad.
words.translation: Sohil chap tomoningizda, dadamning orqasida.

words.example: Go right unless you want to meet the bull.
words.translation: Buqaga duch kelishni istamasangiz, o‘ngga yuring.

words.example: Walk straight until you see the smiling baker.
words.translation: Kulimsiragan novvoyni ko‘rguncha to‘g‘riga yuring.

words.example: There is a hill ahead and cake beyond it.
words.translation: Oldinda tepalik, uning narigi tomonida tort bor.

words.example: A nearby donkey answered our guide's whistle.
words.translation: Yaqin atrofdagi eshak gidimizning hushtagiga javob berdi.

words.example: The beach is too far for these slippers.
words.translation: Sohil bu shippaklarda borish uchun juda uzoq.

words.example: Our tent is safely away from Dad's snoring.
words.translation: Chodirimiz dadamning xurragidan yaxshigina narida.

words.example: The bakery is across the road from paradise.
words.translation: Nonvoyxona jannatning yo‘l narigi tomonida.

words.example: Follow the ducks along the canal.
words.translation: O‘rdaklarga ergashib kanal bo‘ylab yuring.

words.example: We walked through a tunnel of wet leaves.
words.translation: Ho‘l barglardan hosil bo‘lgan tunnel orqali yurdik.

words.example: My feet moved towards the ice cream van.
words.translation: Oyoqlarim muzqaymoq furgoni tomon yurdi.

words.example: We walked around the lake twice by mistake.
words.translation: Adashib ko‘lni ikki marta aylanib chiqdik.

words.example: Beyond the bridge, a goat guarded the path.
words.translation: Ko‘prikning narigi tomonida echki so‘qmoqni qo‘riqlardi.

words.example: Pitch your tent beside mine, not on it.
words.translation: Chodiringizni menikining ustiga emas, yoniga tiking.

words.example: Inside the cave, Dad's sneeze sounded enormous.
words.translation: G‘or ichida dadamning aksirgani juda baland eshitildi.

words.example: Going uphill made everyone suddenly very quiet.
words.translation: Tepalikka chiqish hammani birdan jim qildi.

words.example: The empty trolley rolled downhill without us.
words.translation: Bo‘sh aravacha bizsiz tepalikdan pastga dumaladi.

words.example: Our town has one clock and twelve bakeries.
words.translation: Shahrimizda bitta soat va o‘n ikkita nonvoyxona bor.

words.example: The village dogs welcomed us very loudly.
words.translation: Qishloq itlari bizni juda shovqinli kutib oldi.

words.example: In the capital, even the pigeons look busy.
words.translation: Poytaxtda hatto kabutarlar ham band ko‘rinadi.

words.example: Our suburb wakes when Mr Ali's rooster sings.
words.translation: Ali akaning xo‘rozi qichqirganda shahar chetidagi turar joy hududimiz uyg‘onadi.

words.example: We reached the centre by following hungry tourists.
words.translation: Och sayyohlarga ergashib markazga yetdik.

words.example: The square was full of pigeons judging tourists.
words.translation: Maydon sayyohlarga baho berayotgan kabutarlarga to‘la edi.

words.example: The castle has no dragons, just expensive tea.
words.translation: Qal’ada ajdarholar yo‘q, faqat qimmat choy bor.

words.example: Cleaning that palace must take all weekend.
words.translation: O‘sha saroyni tozalashga butun dam olish kuni ketsa kerak.

words.example: We climbed the tower and regretted breakfast.
words.translation: Minoraga chiqib, nonushtadan pushaymon bo‘ldik.

words.example: A pigeon sat proudly on the monument.
words.translation: Kabutar yodgorlik ustida mag‘rur o‘tirardi.

words.example: The statue wore snow like a new hat.
words.translation: Haykal qorni yangi shlyapadek kiyib olgan edi.

words.example: The fountain washed my shoes without permission.
words.translation: Favvora tuflilarimni ruxsatsiz yuvdi.

words.example: The cathedral bells woke every sleepy tourist.
words.translation: Sobor qo‘ng‘iroqlari barcha uyquchi sayyohlarni uyg‘otdi.

words.example: We left our shoes neatly outside the mosque.
words.translation: Oyoq kiyimlarimizni masjid tashqarisida tartibli qoldirdik.

words.example: A monkey watched us enter the temple.
words.translation: Ibodatxonaga kirishimizni bir maymun kuzatdi.

words.example: The old ruin has more visitors than walls.
words.translation: Eski xarobaning devoridan ko‘ra mehmoni ko‘p.

words.example: At the gallery, Dad admired a painted potato.
words.translation: Galereyada dadam chizilgan kartoshkaga qoyil qoldi.

words.example: At the aquarium, a fish watched me back.
words.translation: Akvariumda bir baliq ham menga qarab turdi.

words.example: The zoo monkeys looked entertained by us.
words.translation: Hayvonot bog‘idagi maymunlar bizdan zavqlanayotgandek ko‘rindi.

words.example: The huge teapot is our town's favourite landmark.
words.translation: Ulkan choynak shahrimizning sevimli taniqli mo‘ljalidir.

words.example: We found the entrance behind a souvenir stall.
words.translation: Kirish joyini esdalik buyumlari rastasi ortidan topdik.

words.translation: Boks darsida qop meni doim yengadi.

words.example: Wrestling practice left my hair pointing everywhere.
words.translation: Kurash mashqi sochlarimni har tomonga to‘zg‘itdi.

words.example: My karate belt takes longer to tie than yours.
words.translation: Karate belbog‘imni bog‘lash siznikidan ko‘proq vaqt oladi.

words.example: Judo taught me to fall more politely.
words.translation: Dzyudo menga odobliroq yiqilishni o‘rgatdi.

words.example: Gymnastics looks easy until I try it.
words.translation: Gimnastika o‘zim sinagunimcha oson ko‘rinadi.

words.example: Athletics day emptied every water bottle at school.
words.translation: Yengil atletika kuni maktabdagi barcha suv idishlari bo‘shadi.

words.example: Cycling uphill earned us a very large lunch.
words.translation: Tepalikka velosipedda chiqib, katta tushlikka munosib bo‘ldik.

words.example: My first skiing lesson involved plenty of sitting.
words.translation: Birinchi chang‘i darsim ko‘p o‘tirish bilan o‘tdi.

words.example: Snowboarding gave my bottom a cold afternoon.
words.translation: Snoubord uchib, tushdan keyin dumbamni sovuqda qoldirdim.

words.example: Skating made Dad hold the wall very lovingly.
words.translation: Konkida uchish dadamni devorni mehr bilan ushlashga majbur qildi.

words.example: Surfing taught me how salty the sea is.
words.translation: Syorfing menga dengiz qanchalik sho‘r ekanini o‘rgatdi.

words.example: Diving introduced me to some very curious fish.
words.translation: Suv ostiga sho‘ng‘ish meni juda qiziquvchan baliqlar bilan tanishtirdi.

words.example: Sailing is easier when the wind agrees.
words.translation: Shamol rozi bo‘lsa, yelkanli qayiqda suzish osonroq.

words.example: At archery, my first arrow surprised the grass.
words.translation: Kamondan otishda birinchi o‘qim maysani hayron qoldirdi.

words.example: During yoga, my cat copies me more easily.
words.translation: Yoga paytida mushugim harakatlarimni osonroq takrorlaydi.

words.example: Our team shares one ball and many opinions.
words.translation: Jamoamiz bitta to‘p va ko‘p fikrni bo‘lishadi.

words.example: Our smallest player has the loudest celebration.
words.translation: Eng kichik o‘yinchimiz eng baland ovozda nishonlaydi.

words.example: The athlete finished before I opened my water.
words.translation: Sportchi suvimni ochishimdan oldin marraga yetdi.

words.example: Our goalkeeper caught the ball and a leaf.
words.translation: Darvozabonimiz to‘p bilan birga bargni ham tutdi.

words.example: The referee ran more than some players.
words.translation: Hakam ayrim o‘yinchilardan ko‘proq yugurdi.

words.example: The match ended before Dad found his glasses.
words.translation: Dadam ko‘zoynagini topmasidan o‘yin tugadi.

words.example: Our tournament included a very serious biscuit break.
words.translation: Turnirimizda juda jiddiy pechenye tanaffusi bo‘ldi.

words.example: The champion still asks Mum to find his socks.
words.translation: Chempion hali ham onasidan paypoqlarini topishni so‘raydi.

words.example: The winner received a cup bigger than her head.
words.translation: G‘olib boshidan katta kubok oldi.

words.example: My medal looks excellent with my pyjamas.
words.translation: Medalim pijamam bilan juda yaxshi ko‘rinadi.

words.example: The trophy needs its own seat in the car.
words.translation: Kubokka mashinada alohida o‘rindiq kerak.

words.example: Dad forgot the score but remembered every snack.
words.translation: Dadam hisobni unutdi, lekin har bir yegulikni esladi.

words.example: My first goal surprised both teams.
words.translation: Birinchi golim ikkala jamoani ham hayron qoldirdi.

words.example: I won one point and celebrated for five minutes.
words.translation: Bir ochko yutib, besh daqiqa nishonladim.

words.example: The ball bounced straight into the teacher's bag.
words.translation: To‘p sakrab, to‘g‘ri o‘qituvchining sumkasiga tushdi.

words.example: My racket is ready; my legs are not.
words.translation: Raketkam tayyor, oyoqlarim esa yo‘q.

words.example: The net caught more leaves than balls today.
words.translation: Bugun to‘r to‘pdan ko‘ra ko‘proq barg tutdi.

words.example: My helmet makes my head look like a mushroom.
words.translation: Dubulg‘am boshimni qo‘ziqoringa o‘xshatadi.

words.example: The whistle ended our dreams of another goal.
words.translation: Hushtak yana gol urish orzuyimizni tugatdi.

words.example: The stadium cheered louder than our school bell.
words.translation: Stadion maktab qo‘ng‘irog‘imizdan balandroq hayqirdi.

words.example: A duck visited the pitch during our match.
words.translation: O‘yinimiz vaqtida maydonga o‘rdak keldi.

words.example: The tennis court became a puddle after lunch.
words.translation: Tushlikdan keyin tennis maydoni ko‘lmakka aylandi.

words.example: At the gym, I lift more water than weights.
words.translation: Sport zalida og‘irlikdan ko‘ra ko‘proq suv ko‘taraman.

words.example: Our race to the tree ended at the bakery.
words.translation: Daraxtgacha poygamiz nonvoyxonada tugadi.

words.meaning: yo‘lak yoki hovuz bo‘ylab bir aylanish
words.example: One lap was enough to silence my boasting.
words.translation: Bir aylanish maqtanishimni to‘xtatishga yetdi.

words.example: Our adventure began with a very wrong turn.
words.translation: Sarguzashtimiz juda noto‘g‘ri burilishdan boshlandi.

words.example: Hiking makes ordinary bread taste wonderful.
words.translation: Tabiatda uzoq yurish oddiy nonni ham ajoyib mazali qiladi.

words.example: Camping taught us to respect indoor toilets.
words.translation: Chodirda dam olish uydagi hojatxonaning qadrini o‘rgatdi.

words.example: Our tent looked larger on the packet.
words.translation: Chodirimiz qadoqda kattaroq ko‘ringan edi.

words.example: My sleeping bag turned me into a warm sausage.
words.translation: Uyqu qopim meni issiq kolbasaga aylantirdi.

words.example: We told stories beside the campfire until bedtime.
words.translation: Uxlash vaqtigacha gulxan yonida hikoyalar aytdik.

words.example: Our picnic attracted three dogs and one uncle.
words.translation: Sayr dasturxonimiz uchta it va bir amakini jalb qildi.

words.meaning: ochiq olovda taom pishirib dam olish
words.example: Dad's barbecue produced more smoke than dinner.
words.translation: Dadamning ochiq olovda ovqat pishirishi taomdan ko‘proq tutun chiqardi.

words.example: The trail ended beside a very welcome café.
words.translation: Sayr yo‘li juda kerakli kafe yonida tugadi.

words.example: This path is wide enough for one hungry tourist.
words.translation: Bu so‘qmoqqa bitta och sayyoh sig‘adi.

words.example: The footpath took us past suspicious sheep.
words.translation: Piyoda yo‘li bizni shubha bilan qarayotgan qo‘ylar yonidan olib o‘tdi.

words.example: We climb slowly to protect our chocolate biscuits.
words.translation: Shokoladli pechenyelarimizni asrash uchun sekin chiqamiz.

words.example: Jump over the puddle, not into my lunch.
words.translation: Ko‘lmakdan sakrab o‘ting, tushligimning ichiga emas.

words.example: I jog until the bakery smell stops me.
words.translation: Nonvoyxona hidi to‘xtatguncha sekin yuguraman.

words.example: Stretch your legs before our ambitious ten-minute hike.
words.translation: Katta niyat bilan boshlayotgan o‘n daqiqalik sayrimizdan oldin oyoq mushaklaringizni cho‘zing.

words.example: I balance on one foot while finding my sock.
words.translation: Paypog‘imni qidirib, bir oyoqda muvozanat saqlayman.

words.example: Throw the ball away from the birthday cake.
words.translation: To‘pni tug‘ilgan kun tortidan uzoqroqqa oting.

words.example: Catch the ball before it catches your lunch.
words.translation: To‘p tushligingizga tegmasidan uni tuting.

words.example: Kick the ball gently near Grandma's flowers.
words.translation: Buvimning gullari yonida to‘pni sekin teping.

words.example: The ball can bounce higher than my little cousin.
words.translation: To‘p kichik amakivachchamdan balandroq sapchiy oladi.

words.example: We warm up before our very short run.
words.translation: Juda qisqa yugurishimizdan oldin badan qizdiramiz.

words.example: We set off early and forgot the tent.
words.translation: Erta yo‘lga chiqib, chodirni unutdik.

words.example: We get lost whenever Dad says he knows.
words.translation: Dadam yo‘lni bilaman deganida har safar adashamiz.

words.example: Fishing gives Grandpa an excuse to sit quietly.
words.translation: Baliq ovlash bobomga jim o‘tirish uchun bahona beradi.

words.example: Birdwatching is difficult with my sneezing brother.
words.translation: Aksirayotgan ukam bilan qush kuzatish qiyin.

words.example: My leisure time begins when the dishes are clean.
words.translation: Bo‘sh vaqtim idishlar tozalanganda boshlanadi.

words.example: I relax best where nobody can find the vacuum.
words.translation: Hech kim changyutgichni topolmaydigan joyda yaxshi dam olaman.

words.example: After our holiday, Dad needed a rest.
words.translation: Ta’tildan keyin dadamga dam kerak bo‘ldi.

words.example: We had fun even when the kite escaped.
words.translation: Varrak qochib ketganda ham maza qildik.

words.example: Eating outdoors means sharing lunch with curious ants.
words.translation: Ochiq havoda ovqatlanish tushlikni qiziquvchan chumolilar bilan bo‘lishishdir.

words.example: We played indoors after the rain won.
words.translation: Yomg‘ir yutgach, bino ichida o‘ynadik.

words.example: Dad tried to sunbathe under an enormous umbrella.
words.translation: Dadam ulkan soyabon ostida quyoshga toblanmoqchi bo‘ldi.

words.example: We snorkel to meet fish without knocking.
words.translation: Baliqlar bilan eshik taqillatmay uchrashish uchun naycha bilan suzamiz.

words.example: My skateboard moves faster when I fall off.
words.translation: Skeytbordim men yiqilganda tezroq yuradi.

words.example: The kite preferred the tree to the sky.
words.translation: Varrak osmondan ko‘ra daraxtni afzal ko‘rdi.

words.example: Grandma chose the swing before the children arrived.
words.translation: Buvim bolalar kelmasidan arg‘imchoqni tanladi.

words.example: The slide made my little cousin's hair stand up.
words.translation: Sirpanib tushganda kichik amakivachchamning sochi tik bo‘ldi.

words.example: The seesaw works better without Dad on one end.
words.translation: Bir uchida dadam bo‘lmasa, arg‘imchoq yaxshiroq ishlaydi.

words.example: Our playground has no room for adult worries.
words.translation: O‘yin maydonchamizda kattalarning tashvishlariga joy yo‘q.

words.example: The amusement park made Dad scream like a child.
words.translation: Attraksionlar bog‘ida dadam boladek qichqirdi.

words.example: This theme park has dinosaurs selling ice cream.
words.translation: Bu mavzuli bog‘da dinozavrlar muzqaymoq sotadi.

words.example: We left the funfair with an enormous teddy.
words.translation: Attraksionlar saylidan ulkan o‘yinchoq ayiq bilan qaytdik.

words.example: The roller coaster rearranged my carefully combed hair.
words.translation: Tezkor attraksion tartibli taralgan sochimni qayta turmakladi.

words.example: The Ferris wheel showed us everyone's colourful hats.
words.translation: Charxpalak bizga hammaning rang-barang shlyapalarini ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: Our sandcastle had a garage but no roof.
words.translation: Qum qal’amizda garaj bor edi, lekin tom yo‘q edi.

words.example: Getting into the hammock was my daily exercise.
words.translation: Osma belanchakka chiqish kunlik mashqim bo‘ldi.

words.example: The frisbee landed on our sleeping uncle.
words.translation: Uloqtirilgan disk uxlayotgan amakimiz ustiga tushdi.

words.example: The paddling pool was perfect for Dad's tired feet.
words.translation: Bolalar hovuzi dadamning charchagan oyoqlariga ayni muddao edi.

words.example: The deckchair folded before I finished sitting down.
words.translation: O‘tirib bo‘lmasimdan yig‘ma kursi yig‘ilib qoldi.

words.example: The waterslide delivered me without my brave expression.
words.translation: Suvli attraksiondan tushganda yuzimdagi jasorat yo‘qolgan edi.

words.example: Education does not end when the school bell rings.
words.translation: Maktab qo‘ng‘irog‘i chalinganda ta’lim tugamaydi.

words.example: One pupil brought a pumpkin instead of a football.
words.translation: Bir o‘quvchi futbol to‘pi o‘rniga qovoq olib keldi.

words.example: My brother studies cooking at college and experiments on us.
words.translation: Akam kollejda oshpazlikni o‘rganadi va bizda tajriba o‘tkazadi.

words.example: At university, she discovered both physics and instant noodles.
words.translation: Universitetda u ham fizikani, ham tezpishar ugra taomini kashf etdi.

words.example: The campus has three cafés and one very popular cat.
words.translation: Universitet hududida uchta kafe va bitta juda mashhur mushuk bor.

words.example: I joined a photography course to improve my blurry pictures.
words.translation: Xira suratlarimni yaxshilash uchun fotografiya kursiga yozildim.

words.example: History is her favourite subject because people made such strange decisions.
words.translation: Tarix uning sevimli fani, chunki odamlar juda g‘alati qarorlar qabul qilishgan.

words.example: This term, our class will finally learn where commas belong.
words.translation: Bu semestr sinfimiz nihoyat vergullar qayerga qo‘yilishini o‘rganadi.

words.example: She gives maths tuition using biscuits that rarely survive the lesson.
words.translation: U dars oxirigacha kamdan-kam saqlanadigan pechenyelar yordamida matematikadan xususiy dars beradi.

words.example: During the break, even our strict teacher tells jokes.
words.translation: Tanaffusda hatto qattiqqo‘l o‘qituvchimiz ham hazil aytadi.

words.example: At assembly, the microphone made the headteacher sound like a duck.
words.translation: Umumiy yig‘ilishda mikrofon direktorning ovozini o‘rdaknikiga o‘xshatib qo‘ydi.

words.example: Our headteacher knows every pupil and most of their excuses.
words.translation: Maktab direktorimiz har bir o‘quvchini va ularning aksariyat bahonalarini biladi.

words.example: My tutor explains fractions with pizza, which keeps me interested.
words.translation: Ustozim kasrlarni pitsa yordamida tushuntiradi, shuning uchun qiziqishim so‘nmaydi.

words.example: A classmate lent me a ruler longer than my arm.
words.translation: Bir sinfdoshim menga qo‘limdan uzunroq chizg‘ich berib turdi.

words.example: Every learner needs practice, including my very confused parrot.
words.translation: Har bir o‘rganuvchiga, jumladan, juda gangib qolgan to‘tiqushimga ham mashq kerak.

words.example: As a beginner, I could only introduce myself to the computer.
words.translation: Boshlovchi sifatida men kompyuterga faqat o‘zimni tanishtira olardim.

words.example: The next level includes longer texts and fewer pictures of cats.
words.translation: Keyingi darajada uzunroq matnlar va mushuklarning kamroq rasmlari bor.

words.example: The new staff receive training before touching the mysterious machine.
words.translation: Yangi xodimlar sirli uskunaga tegishdan oldin tayyorgarlikdan o‘tadi.

words.example: We built a tiny bridge during the engineering workshop.
words.translation: Muhandislik bo‘yicha amaliy seminarda kichkina ko‘prik qurdik.

words.example: The lecture on sleep kept everyone surprisingly awake.
words.translation: Uyqu haqidagi ma’ruza, ajablanarlisi, hammani hushyor tutdi.

words.example: Our seminar became lively when someone mentioned homework for teachers.
words.translation: Kimdir o‘qituvchilar uchun uy vazifasini tilga olganda seminarimiz jonlanib ketdi.

words.example: Attendance improved after the club started offering biscuits.
words.translation: To‘garak pechenye bera boshlagach, davomat yaxshilandi.

words.example: The teacher checked the register while two late pupils tried to look invisible.
words.translation: Ikki kechikkan o‘quvchi ko‘rinmas bo‘lishga urinayotganda o‘qituvchi davomat ro‘yxatini tekshirdi.

words.example: She won a scholarship and bought her lucky pencil a new case.
words.translation: U stipendiya yutib oldi va omadli qalamiga yangi qalamdon sotib oldi.

words.example: When I graduate, my alarm clock deserves a holiday.
words.translation: O‘qishni tamomlaganimda, budilnigim ta’tilga loyiq bo‘ladi.

words.example: Maths helps me divide a cake without starting an argument.
words.translation: Matematika tortni janjalsiz bo‘lishimga yordam beradi.

words.example: In science, we asked why toast always seems to land butter down.
words.translation: Tabiiy fanlar darsida nega qovurilgan non doim yog‘li tomoni bilan tushgandek bo‘lishini so‘radik.

words.example: History would be easier if kings chose different names.
words.translation: Qirollar har xil ism tanlaganida, tarix osonroq bo‘lardi.

words.example: In algebra, we spend a surprising amount of time looking for x.
words.translation: Algebrada x ni qidirishga hayratlanarli darajada ko‘p vaqt sarflaymiz.

words.example: Our biology teacher introduced a worm as today's special guest.
words.translation: Biologiya o‘qituvchimiz chuvalchangni bugungi maxsus mehmon deb tanishtirdi.

words.example: In chemistry, we learnt why random liquids should not become soup.
words.translation: Kimyoda duch kelgan suyuqliklardan nega sho‘rva qilib bo‘lmasligini o‘rgandik.

words.example: Physics explains why my paper plane keeps attacking the floor.
words.translation: Fizika qog‘oz samolyotim nega doim polga hujum qilishini tushuntiradi.

words.example: Literature gives us heroes who have worse Mondays than we do.
words.translation: Adabiyot bizga dushanbasi biznikidan ham yomonroq o‘tadigan qahramonlarni beradi.

words.example: In art, my portrait looked more like a potato than a person.
words.translation: Tasviriy san’at darsida chizgan portretim odamdan ko‘ra kartoshkaga ko‘proq o‘xshadi.

words.example: Drama taught our quietest pupil to shout like a king.
words.translation: Teatr san’ati eng kamgap o‘quvchimizga qirol kabi baqirishni o‘rgatdi.

words.example: He studies economics but still cannot explain his biscuit budget.
words.translation: U iqtisodiyotni o‘rganadi, lekin pechenye uchun ajratgan pulini hali ham izohlay olmaydi.

words.example: Our computing course began with passwords, not building a robot butler.
words.translation: Kompyuter kursimiz robot xizmatkor yaratishdan emas, parollardan boshlandi.

words.example: During PE, I ran fastest when the ball came towards me.
words.translation: Jismoniy tarbiya darsida to‘p menga qarab kelganda eng tez yugurdim.

words.example: Her knowledge of dinosaurs makes museum visits very long.
words.translation: Uning dinozavrlar haqidagi bilimi muzey sayrlarini juda uzaytiradi.

words.example: One surprising fact can wake up a sleepy class.
words.translation: Bitta hayratlanarli ma’lumot uyqusiragan sinfni uyg‘otishi mumkin.

words.example: His idea for silent crisps impressed the whole library.
words.translation: Uning ovozsiz chips haqidagi g‘oyasi kutubxonadagilarning barchasini qoyil qoldirdi.

words.example: We discussed a theory about how children learn, then asked an actual child.
words.translation: Bolalar qanday o‘rganishi haqidagi nazariyani muhokama qildik, keyin haqiqiy boladan so‘radik.

words.example: The first rule of the lab is that nothing counts as lunch.
words.translation: Laboratoriyaning birinchi qoidasi: hech narsa tushlik hisoblanmaydi.

words.example: I remembered the formula but forgot where I put my calculator.
words.translation: Formulani esladim, lekin kalkulyatorimni qayerga qo‘yganimni unutdim.

words.example: A fraction of the cake remained after our maths demonstration.
words.translation: Matematika namoyishimizdan keyin tortning bir bo‘lagi qoldi.

words.example: What percentage of your notes is actually drawings of spaceships?
words.translation: Qaydlaringizning necha foizi aslida kosmik kemalar rasmlaridan iborat?

words.example: My calculation says we need twelve pizzas for four people.
words.translation: Hisob-kitobimga ko‘ra, to‘rt kishiga o‘n ikkita pitsa kerak.

words.example: We practised addition with buttons until one rolled under the cupboard.
words.translation: Bitta tugma javon tagiga dumalab ketguncha tugmalar bilan qo‘shish amalini mashq qildik.

words.example: Subtraction became real when my brother ate three of my sweets.
words.translation: Ukam uchta konfetimni yeganda ayirish amali hayotiy tus oldi.

words.example: Division is easier when nobody eats the teaching materials.
words.translation: Hech kim dars materiallarini yeb qo‘ymasa, bo‘lish amali osonroq bo‘ladi.

words.example: My textbook has more sticky notes than actual pages.
words.translation: Darsligimda sahifalardan ham ko‘proq yopishqoq qayd qog‘ozlari bor.

words.example: The workbook looked friendly until page forty.
words.translation: Mashq daftari qirqinchi betgacha do‘stona ko‘rindi.

words.example: A breeze took my worksheet on an unexpected school trip.
words.translation: Shamol topshiriqlar varag‘imni kutilmagan maktab sayohatiga olib ketdi.

words.example: The handout explains everything except where I left the handout.
words.translation: Tarqatma material hamma narsani tushuntiradi, faqat uni qayerda qoldirganimni emas.

words.example: Someone drew a tiny crown on the whiteboard above my name.
words.translation: Kimdir oq taxtada ismim tepasiga kichkina toj chizdi.

words.example: The blackboard still carries a dinosaur from yesterday's lesson.
words.translation: Bo‘r taxtada hali ham kechagi darsdan qolgan dinozavr bor.

words.example: A piece of chalk turned my black trousers into a cloudy sky.
words.translation: Bir bo‘lak bo‘r qora shimimni bulutli osmonga aylantirdi.

words.example: This marker makes every small mistake look important.
words.translation: Bu marker har bir kichik xatoni muhim qilib ko‘rsatadi.

words.example: My eraser works harder than my pencil during maths.
words.translation: Matematika darsida o‘chirg‘ichim qalamimdan ko‘proq ishlaydi.

words.example: Use a ruler unless you want another wavy rectangle.
words.translation: Yana to‘lqinsimon to‘rtburchak xohlamasangiz, chizg‘ich ishlating.

words.example: The sharpener made my pencil ready for its tiny writing career.
words.translation: Qalam ochgich qalamimni kichkina yozuvchilik faoliyatiga tayyorladi.

words.example: Even the calculator seemed surprised by my answer.
words.translation: Hatto kalkulyator ham javobimdan hayron qolgandek edi.

words.example: The projector made a small spelling mistake two metres wide.
words.translation: Proyektor kichkina imlo xatosini ikki metr kenglikda ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: With a clipboard in her hand, even my little sister looks official.
words.translation: Qo‘lida qisqichli taxtacha bo‘lsa, hatto singlim ham rasmiy xodimga o‘xshaydi.

words.example: My folder contains neat notes and one ancient sandwich wrapper.
words.translation: Hujjatlar jildimda tartibli qaydlar va bitta qadimiy sendvich o‘rami bor.

words.example: This binder keeps my papers together better than I keep my thoughts together.
words.translation: Bu halqali jild qog‘ozlarimni men fikrlarimni jamlaganimdan yaxshiroq jamlaydi.

words.example: I used the highlighter so much that the whole page glowed.
words.translation: Matn ajratish markerini shunchalik ko‘p ishlatdimki, butun sahifa yorishib ketdi.

words.example: This flashcard has a picture so funny that I never forget the word.
words.translation: Bu o‘quv kartochkasidagi rasm shunchalik kulgiliki, so‘zni hech qachon unutmayman.

words.example: The protractor proved that my perfect corner was not perfect.
words.translation: Transportir mukammal burchagim mukammal emasligini isbotladi.

words.example: She spun the globe and chose our imaginary holiday destination.
words.translation: U globusni aylantirib, xayoliy ta’til manzilimizni tanladi.

words.example: Grandpa's atlas knows countries that my new one does not.
words.translation: Bobomning atlasi yangi atlasim bilmaydigan mamlakatlarni biladi.

words.example: The missing page contained the answer, of course.
words.translation: Albatta, javob aynan yo‘qolgan sahifada edi.

words.example: This chapter is short enough to read before my tea gets cold.
words.translation: Bu bob choyim soviguncha o‘qib tugatadigan darajada qisqa.

words.example: Your paragraph needs a full stop before we all run out of breath.
words.translation: Hammamizning nafasimiz tugamasidan xatboshingizga nuqta kerak.

words.example: I used a bus ticket as a bookmark and nearly read past my stop.
words.translation: Avtobus chiptasini xatcho‘p qilib ishlatdim va o‘qib bekatimdan o‘tib ketay dedim.

words.example: I revise with the fridge closed to avoid long snack breaks.
words.translation: Uzoq tamaddilardan qochish uchun muzlatkichni yopib qo‘yib takrorlayman.

words.example: Let's review the notes before our memories go on holiday.
words.translation: Xotiramiz ta’tilga chiqishidan oldin qaydlarni qayta ko‘rib chiqaylik.

words.example: She can memorise a poem faster than I can find my glasses.
words.translation: U men ko‘zoynagimni topgunimcha she’rni yodlay oladi.

words.example: It is hard to concentrate when the clock sounds like a woodpecker.
words.translation: Soat qizilishton kabi taqillasa, diqqatni jamlash qiyin.

words.example: Focus on the instructions, not the squirrel outside.
words.translation: Tashqaridagi olmaxonga emas, ko‘rsatmalarga diqqat qarating.

words.example: Can you explain gravity without dropping my lunch?
words.translation: Tushligimni tushirib yubormasdan tortishish kuchini tushuntira olasizmi?

words.example: Describe your ideal classroom without including a swimming pool.
words.translation: Suzish havzasini qo‘shmasdan ideal sinfxonangizni tasvirlang.

words.example: We compare two essays, and both begin with a talking carrot.
words.translation: Ikki inshoni taqqoslaymiz, ikkalasi ham gapiradigan sabzi bilan boshlanadi.

words.example: Summarise the chapter without making your summary longer than the book.
words.translation: Qisqacha mazmunni kitobdan uzunroq qilmasdan bobni bayon qiling.

words.example: Underline the main point before your pencil wanders off.
words.translation: Qalamingiz boshqa yoqqa ketib qolmasidan asosiy fikrning tagiga chizing.

words.example: Highlight only the key words, or we will need sunglasses.
words.translation: Faqat asosiy so‘zlarni rang bilan ajrating, aks holda quyosh ko‘zoynagi kerak bo‘ladi.

words.example: Copy the address carefully unless you want your letter to travel alone.
words.translation: Xatingiz yolg‘iz sayohat qilishini xohlamasangiz, manzilni diqqat bilan ko‘chiring.

words.example: Please correct my spelling before I invite everyone to a desert instead of dessert.
words.translation: Hammani shirinlik o‘rniga sahroga taklif qilishimdan oldin imlomni tuzating.

words.example: Complete the final exercise and your pencil can rest.
words.translation: Oxirgi mashqni tugating, keyin qalamingiz dam olishi mumkin.

words.example: We managed to solve the problem before the bell rescued us.
words.translation: Qo‘ng‘iroq bizni qutqarishidan oldin masalani yechishga ulgurdik.

words.example: Calculate the total before promising everyone free ice cream.
words.translation: Hammaga bepul muzqaymoq va’da qilishdan oldin jami miqdorni hisoblang.

words.example: I had to guess the answer because my notes were in my other bag.
words.translation: Qaydlarim boshqa sumkamda bo‘lgani uchun javobni taxmin qilishimga to‘g‘ri keldi.

words.example: We will discuss the story after deciding who ate the last biscuit.
words.translation: Oxirgi pechenyeni kim yeganini aniqlagach, hikoyani muhokama qilamiz.

words.example: For homework, we research local history rather than local pizza prices.
words.translation: Uy vazifasi uchun mahalliy pitsa narxlarini emas, mahalliy tarixni o‘rganamiz.

words.example: I prepare my bag at night so mornings involve less detective work.
words.translation: Ertalab kamroq qidiruv bilan shug‘ullanish uchun sumkamni kechasi tayyorlayman.

words.example: Organise your notes before they form their own paper mountain.
words.translation: Qaydlaringiz alohida qog‘oz tog‘iga aylanmasidan ularni tartibga soling.

words.example: You can join our study group if you promise not to eat the examples.
words.translation: Misollarni yeb qo‘ymaslikka va’da bersangiz, o‘quv guruhimizga qo‘shilishingiz mumkin.

words.example: He plans to attend every lecture, including the one about planning.
words.translation: U har bir ma’ruzaga, jumladan, rejalashtirish haqidagisiga ham qatnashmoqchi.

words.example: Hand in your essay before the deadline grows teeth.
words.translation: Muddat tish chiqarishidan oldin inshongizni topshiring.

words.example: After missing a week, I needed two evenings to catch up.
words.translation: Bir hafta dars qoldirgach, yetishib olishim uchun ikki oqshom kerak bo‘ldi.

words.example: The exam began just as my lucky pen ran out of ink.
words.translation: Omadli ruchkamning siyohi tugashi bilan imtihon boshlandi.

words.example: Our spelling test included a word nobody could pronounce.
words.translation: Imlo sinovimizda hech kim talaffuz qila olmaydigan so‘z bor edi.

words.example: Dad lost the history quiz to someone who still needs help tying shoes.
words.translation: Dadam tarix savol-javobida hali oyoq kiyimini bog‘lashga yordam kerak bo‘lgan bolaga yutqazdi.

words.example: I got one extra mark for remembering my own name.
words.translation: O‘z ismimni eslaganim uchun bitta qo‘shimcha ball oldim.

words.example: Her grade went from C to A after she moved away from the window.
words.translation: U derazadan uzoqroqqa o‘tgach, bahosi C dan A ga ko‘tarildi.

words.example: My coursework includes three reports and a model that barely stands up.
words.translation: Kurs ishlarim uchta hisobot va zo‘rg‘a tik turadigan maketdan iborat.

words.example: The result surprised everyone, especially the student who had guessed.
words.translation: Natija hammani, ayniqsa taxmin qilgan o‘quvchini hayron qoldirdi.

words.example: If I pass this exam, my notes are getting a retirement party.
words.translation: Bu imtihondan o‘tsam, qaydlarim uchun nafaqaga chiqish bazmini qilaman.

words.example: You will not fail just because your handwriting looks like spaghetti.
words.translation: Faqat yozuvingiz spagettiga o‘xshagani uchun imtihondan yiqilmaysiz.

words.example: My first mistake was writing Tuesday on a Friday.
words.translation: Birinchi xatom juma kuni seshanba deb yozish bo‘ldi.

words.example: A small error turned fifty students into five hundred on the report.
words.translation: Kichik xatolik hisobotdagi ellik o‘quvchini besh yuztaga aylantirdi.

words.example: The teacher's feedback was kind, even about my square horse.
