words.translation: O‘qituvchining fikrlari, hatto to‘rtburchak otim haqida ham, muloyim edi.

words.example: That correction changed the meaning from hungry to angry.
words.translation: O‘sha tuzatish ma’noni ochdan jahldorga o‘zgartirdi.

words.example: My progress is slow, but at least my dictionary gets regular exercise.
words.translation: O‘sishim sekin, lekin hech bo‘lmasa lug‘atim muntazam mashq qiladi.

words.example: She framed her certificate before unpacking her course books.
words.translation: U kurs kitoblarini sumkadan olishdan oldin sertifikatini ramkaga soldi.

words.example: His diploma hangs above the desk where he once cried over homework.
words.translation: Uning diplomi bir paytlar uy vazifasi ustida yig‘lagan stoli tepasida osilib turibdi.

words.example: She has a degree in chemistry and a very serious biscuit recipe.
words.translation: Uning kimyo bo‘yicha oliy ma’lumoti va juda jiddiy pechenye retsepti bor.

words.example: This qualification proves I can repair more than my own mistakes.
words.translation: Bu malaka faqat o‘z xatolarimdan boshqa narsalarni ham tuzata olishimni tasdiqlaydi.

words.example: My essay about silence was surprisingly long.
words.translation: Sukunat haqidagi inshom hayratlanarli darajada uzun bo‘ldi.

words.example: The assignment was to study advertising, not to buy everything.
words.translation: Topshiriq reklamani o‘rganish edi, hamma narsani sotib olish emas.

words.example: Our first task was finding a table under all the paper.
words.translation: Birinchi vazifamiz barcha qog‘ozlar ostidan stolni topish edi.

words.example: This grammar exercise gives my brain more exercise than my legs get.
words.translation: Bu grammatika mashqi miyamni oyoqlarimdan ham ko‘proq mashq qildiradi.

words.example: The deadline is Friday, which suddenly feels very close.
words.translation: Oxirgi muddat juma, u esa birdan juda yaqin tuyulmoqda.

words.example: I will retake the test with more revision and fewer lucky socks.
words.translation: Sinovni ko‘proq takrorlash va kamroq omadli paypoqlar bilan qayta topshiraman.

words.example: The oral exam went well until my stomach answered a question.
words.translation: Og‘zaki imtihon qornim bir savolga javob berguncha yaxshi o‘tdi.

words.example: My food vocabulary grows faster than my cooking skills.
words.translation: Taomlarga oid so‘z boyligim oshpazlik ko‘nikmalarimdan tezroq o‘sadi.

words.example: Grammar helps us explain who ate whose sandwich.
words.translation: Grammatika kim kimning sendvichini yeganini tushuntirishga yordam beradi.

words.example: I practise pronunciation with my dog, a very patient listener.
words.translation: Talaffuzni juda sabrli tinglovchi bo‘lgan itim bilan mashq qilaman.

words.example: My spelling improves when I stop trusting my sleepy fingers.
words.translation: Uyqusiragan barmoqlarimga ishonishni to‘xtatsam, imlom yaxshilanadi.

words.example: The alphabet song lives in my head without paying rent.
words.translation: Alifbo qo‘shig‘i boshimda ijara to‘lamay yashaydi.

words.example: Changing one vowel turned my pet into a pot.
words.translation: Bitta unlini o‘zgartirish uy hayvonimni qozonga aylantirdi.

words.example: That final consonant keeps escaping when I speak quickly.
words.translation: Tez gapirsam, oxirgi undosh doim qochib ketadi.

words.example: We clap for each syllable, so the lesson sounds like a tiny concert.
words.translation: Har bir bo‘g‘inda qarsak chalamiz, shuning uchun dars kichik konsertga o‘xshaydi.

words.example: A noun can name a person, a place, or your missing sandwich.
words.translation: Ot shaxsni, joyni yoki yo‘qolgan sendvichingizni bildirishi mumkin.

words.example: The verb sleep is easy to remember on Monday morning.
words.translation: Uxlash fe’lini dushanba ertalab eslab qolish oson.

words.example: She added the adjective enormous to describe my tiny lunch.
words.translation: U mening kichkina tushligimni tasvirlash uchun ulkan sifatini qo‘shdi.

words.example: The adverb quietly does not describe our study group.
words.translation: Jim ravishi bizning o‘quv guruhimizni tasvirlamaydi.

words.example: Without a pronoun, I would repeat my brother's name twenty times.
words.translation: Olmoshsiz akamning ismini yigirma marta takrorlagan bo‘lardim.

words.example: The wrong preposition put the cat inside the table.
words.translation: Noto‘g‘ri predlog mushukni stolning ichiga joylashtirdi.

words.example: Use the past tense for homework you actually finished.
words.translation: Haqiqatan tugatgan uy vazifangiz haqida o‘tgan zamonni ishlating.

words.example: The singular form is useful when only one biscuit remains.
words.translation: Faqat bitta pechenye qolganida birlik shakli foydali bo‘ladi.

words.example: The plural form tells us that one mouse has invited friends.
words.translation: Ko‘plik shakli bitta sichqon do‘stlarini taklif qilganini bildiradi.

words.example: His definition of homework was something that interrupts football.
words.translation: Uning uy vazifasiga bergan ta’rifi futbolni to‘xtatadigan narsa bo‘ldi.

words.example: Find a synonym for nice before you describe everything as nice.
words.translation: Hamma narsani yaxshi deb tasvirlashdan oldin yaxshi so‘ziga sinonim toping.

words.example: Awake is an antonym of asleep, although my face suggests both.
words.translation: Uyg‘oq uxlayotgan so‘zining antonimi, garchi yuzim ikkalasini ham ifodalasa-da.

words.example: The phrase just five minutes rarely means five minutes in our house.
words.translation: Uyimizda atigi besh daqiqa iborasi kamdan-kam besh daqiqani anglatadi.

words.example: That idiom confused me because no actual cats were falling from the sky.
words.translation: O‘sha ibora meni chalg‘itdi, chunki osmondan haqiqiy mushuklar tushmayotgan edi.

words.example: My accent changes whenever I watch too many British detective shows.
words.translation: Britaniya detektiv seriallarini ko‘p ko‘rsam, aksentim o‘zgaradi.

words.example: She is fluent in French until someone asks her to explain algebra.
words.translation: Kimdir undan algebrani tushuntirishni so‘ramaguncha u fransuz tilida ravon gapiradi.

words.example: Please translate the menu before I accidentally order six soups.
words.translation: Adashib oltita sho‘rva buyurtma qilishimdan oldin taomnomani tarjima qiling.

words.example: The accountant found our missing money in the biscuit budget.
words.translation: Hisobchi yo‘qolgan pulimizni pechenyega ajratilgan mablag‘dan topdi.

words.example: The architect designed a house with enough shelves for all her books.
words.translation: Me’mor barcha kitoblariga yetadigan javonlari bor uy loyihaladi.

words.example: Our lawyer reads the small print even on board games.
words.translation: Advokatimiz hatto stol o‘yinlaridagi mayda yozuvlarni ham o‘qiydi.

words.example: A journalist interviewed the mayor while a goat ate her notes.
words.translation: Echki qaydlarini yeyayotganda jurnalist hokimdan intervyu oldi.

words.example: The reporter stayed calm when the dog stole his microphone.
words.translation: It mikrofonini o‘g‘irlaganda muxbir xotirjamligini saqladi.

words.example: The editor removed three commas and one unnecessary dragon.
words.translation: Muharrir uchta vergul va bitta keraksiz ajdarni olib tashladi.

words.example: The author named the brave hero after her nervous hamster.
words.translation: Yozuvchi jasur qahramonga qo‘rqoq xomyagining ismini berdi.

words.example: The translator made the instructions clear enough for my uncle.
words.translation: Tarjimon ko‘rsatmalarni hatto amakim tushunadigan darajada aniq qildi.

words.example: The interpreter translated the joke, and everyone laughed twice.
words.translation: Og‘zaki tarjimon hazilni tarjima qildi va hamma ikki marta kuldi.

words.example: The programmer taught a computer to complain about Monday.
words.translation: Dasturchi kompyuterga dushanbadan shikoyat qilishni o‘rgatdi.

words.example: A developer built an app that reminds me to stop using apps.
words.translation: Dastur yaratuvchi menga ilovalardan foydalanishni to‘xtatishni eslatadigan ilova yaratdi.

words.example: The designer made our boring logo look awake at last.
words.translation: Dizayner zerikarli logotipimizga nihoyat uyg‘oq ko‘rinish berdi.

words.example: The electrician fixed the light that kept giving us surprise discos.
words.translation: Elektrik bizga doim kutilmagan diskoteka uyushtiradigan chiroqni tuzatdi.

words.example: A plumber rescued my ring from a very unpleasant journey down the pipe.
words.translation: Santexnik uzugimni quvur bo‘ylab juda yoqimsiz sayohatdan qutqardi.

words.example: The mechanic understood the strange noise I could only describe as clonk.
words.translation: Men faqat taq deb tasvirlay olgan g‘alati tovushni mexanik tushundi.

words.example: The carpenter built a desk that does not dance when I type.
words.translation: Duradgor yozayotganimda raqsga tushmaydigan stol yasadi.

words.example: The builder checked the wall while we argued about its colour.
words.translation: Biz devorning rangi haqida tortishayotganda quruvchi uni tekshirdi.

words.example: The typist finished the page while I was still looking for the comma key.
words.translation: Men hali vergul tugmasini qidirayotganimda matn teruvchi sahifani tugatdi.

words.example: The secretary found a free hour in a diary that looked completely full.
words.translation: Kotiba butunlay band ko‘ringan kundalikdan bo‘sh bir soat topdi.

words.example: The assistant brought the files and wisely left the office cat outside.
words.translation: Yordamchi hujjatlarni olib keldi va oqilona yo‘l tutib, ofis mushugini tashqarida qoldirdi.

words.example: The librarian can silence a room with one raised eyebrow.
words.translation: Kutubxonachi bir qoshini ko‘tarib butun xonani jim qila oladi.

words.example: The scientist studied sleep while trying very hard to stay awake.
words.translation: Olim uyg‘oq qolishga juda tirishib, uyquni o‘rgandi.

words.example: A researcher asked fifty people why they talk to their plants.
words.translation: Tadqiqotchi ellik kishidan nega o‘simliklari bilan gaplashishini so‘radi.

words.example: Our lecturer explains statistics using his enormous sock collection.
words.translation: Ma’ruzachimiz statistikani ulkan paypoq to‘plami yordamida tushuntiradi.

words.example: The driving instructor has a calm voice and very quick feet.
words.translation: Haydash yo‘riqchisining ovozi xotirjam, oyoqlari esa juda chaqqon.

words.example: The technician fixed our projector before the giant error message scared anyone.
words.translation: Texnik ulkan xatolik yozuvi kimnidir qo‘rqitishidan oldin proyektorimizni tuzatdi.

words.example: The consultant suggested fewer meetings, so we held a meeting about it.
words.translation: Maslahatchi yig‘ilishlarni kamaytirishni taklif qildi, shunda biz bu haqda yig‘ilish o‘tkazdik.

words.example: The examiner smiled, which helped more than my lucky socks.
words.translation: Imtihon oluvchi jilmaydi, bu omadli paypoqlarimdan ko‘proq yordam berdi.

words.example: The trainee learnt everyone's name before learning where we keep the paper.
words.translation: Stajyor qog‘ozni qayerda saqlashimizni bilishdan oldin hammaning ismini o‘rgandi.

words.example: The photographer waited until nobody was chewing.
words.translation: Suratkash hech kim ovqat chaynamay qolguncha kutdi.

words.example: The presenter smiled as the weather map disappeared behind him.
words.translation: Orqasidagi ob-havo xaritasi yo‘qolib qolganida boshlovchi jilmaydi.

words.example: The broadcaster's cheerful voice made the traffic jam sound almost pleasant.
words.translation: Radio boshlovchisining quvnoq ovozi tirbandlikni deyarli yoqimli qilib ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: The filmmaker spent two hours persuading a cat to walk left.
words.translation: Film yaratuvchi mushukni chapga yurishga ko‘ndirish uchun ikki soat sarfladi.

words.example: An animator gave our company logo a very silly walk.
words.translation: Animator kompaniyamiz logotipiga juda kulgili yurish usulini berdi.

words.example: The musician recognised the tune my printer seemed to be playing.
words.translation: Musiqachi printerim chalayotgandek tuyulgan kuyni tanidi.

words.example: The actor played a tree so well that a bird landed on him.
words.translation: Aktyor daraxt rolini shunchalik yaxshi ijro etdiki, ustiga qush qo‘ndi.

words.example: The actress forgot her lines but remembered the whole lunch menu.
words.translation: Aktrisa replikalarini unutdi, lekin butun tushlik taomnomasini esladi.

words.example: The singer warmed up while the sound engineer searched for earplugs.
words.translation: Xonanda ovozini sozlayotganda ovoz muhandisi quloq tiqinlarini qidirdi.

words.example: The dancer made the difficult step look easier than getting out of bed.
words.translation: Raqqos qiyin qadamni yotoqdan turishdan ham oson qilib ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: The apprentice built a chair that surprised everyone by staying upright.
words.translation: Shogird tik turib, hammani hayron qoldirgan stul yasadi.

words.example: The firefighter visited our school and made every toy helmet look tiny.
words.translation: O‘t o‘chiruvchi maktabimizga keldi va uning oldida barcha o‘yinchoq dubulg‘alar juda kichik ko‘rindi.

words.example: The officer helped a lost child find his dad beside the ice cream van.
words.translation: Politsiya xodimi adashgan bolaga muzqaymoq mashinasi yonidan dadasini topishga yordam berdi.

words.example: The soldier packed his bag neatly while I sat on mine to close it.
words.translation: Askar sumkasini tartibli joylayotganda men o‘zimnikini yopish uchun ustiga o‘tirdim.

words.example: The tailor added a pocket large enough for my ridiculous phone.
words.translation: Tikuvchi mening g‘alati darajada katta telefonim sig‘adigan cho‘ntak qo‘shdi.

words.example: My hairdresser politely called my home haircut creative.
words.translation: Sartaroshim uyda olgan sochimni muloyimlik bilan ijodiy deb atadi.

words.example: The barber finished my haircut before finishing his story.
words.translation: Sartarosh hikoyasini tugatishdan oldin sochimni olib bo‘ldi.

words.example: The cleaner found the key we had spent an hour discussing.
words.translation: Tozalovchi xodim biz bir soat muhokama qilgan kalitni topdi.

words.example: Our gardener can name every plant, while I just say the green one.
words.translation: Bog‘bonimiz har bir o‘simlikning nomini ayta oladi, men esa shunchaki yashili deyman.

words.example: The chef tasted the soup and reached for salt without a speech.
words.translation: Bosh oshpaz sho‘rvani tatib ko‘rdi va ortiqcha gapirmay tuzga qo‘l uzatdi.

words.example: The security guard checked my badge, then admired my enormous sandwich.
words.translation: Qo‘riqlash xodimi nishonimni tekshirdi, keyin ulkan sendvichimga qoyil qoldi.

words.example: The staff agreed that the coffee machine deserved its own parking space.
words.translation: Xodimlar qahva mashinasi alohida to‘xtash joyiga loyiq degan fikrga kelishdi.

words.example: Our newest employee found the printer faster than the rest of us.
words.translation: Eng yangi xodimimiz printerni hammamizdan tezroq topdi.

words.example: Her employer provides free fruit, but the biscuits disappear first.
words.translation: Uning ish beruvchisi bepul meva beradi, lekin avval pechenyelar tugaydi.

words.example: A colleague taught me the unofficial password to the biscuit cupboard.
words.translation: Hamkasbim menga pechenye javonining norasmiy parolini o‘rgatdi.

words.example: The boss joined our video call with a cat on his shoulder.
words.translation: Boshliq yelkasida mushuk bilan videoqo‘ng‘irog‘imizga qo‘shildi.

words.example: Our workplace has excellent lighting and a printer with a difficult personality.
words.translation: Ish joyimizning yoritilishi ajoyib, printerimizning esa fe’li qiyin.

words.example: The sales department has claimed the only comfortable sofa.
words.translation: Savdo bo‘limi yagona qulay divanni o‘ziniki qilib oldi.

words.example: The company began with two desks and a very ambitious kettle.
words.translation: Kompaniya ikkita stol va juda katta maqsadli choynak bilan ish boshlagan.

words.example: Her repair business grew because she could fix almost anything except Mondays.
words.translation: Uning ta’mirlash korxonasi o‘sdi, chunki u dushanbadan boshqa deyarli hamma narsani tuzata olardi.

words.example: This organisation teaches adults to use computers without fearing every beep.
words.translation: Bu tashkilot kattalarga har bir tovushdan qo‘rqmay kompyuterdan foydalanishni o‘rgatadi.

words.example: The toy factory makes tiny cars and enormous amounts of noise.
words.translation: O‘yinchoq fabrikasi kichik mashinalar va ulkan miqdorda shovqin chiqaradi.

words.example: The recording studio is quiet until someone opens a packet of crisps.
words.translation: Kimdir chips paketini ochmaguncha ovoz yozish studiyasi jim bo‘ladi.

words.example: In the lab, even the sugar must wear a label.
words.translation: Laboratoriyada hatto shakarning ham yorlig‘i bo‘lishi kerak.

words.example: The company headquarters has more meeting rooms than our town has cafés.
words.translation: Kompaniyaning bosh idorasida shahrimizdagi kafelardan ko‘proq yig‘ilish xonasi bor.

words.example: The canteen queue moves faster when pudding is on the menu.
words.translation: Taomnomada puding bo‘lsa, oshxona navbati tezroq yuradi.

words.example: The warehouse stores enough paper to wrap a very large elephant.
words.translation: Omborxonada juda katta filni o‘rashga yetadigan qog‘oz saqlanadi.

words.example: The shredder turns old papers into something that looks like office spaghetti.
words.translation: Hujjat maydalagich eski qog‘ozlarni ofis spagettisiga o‘xshash narsaga aylantiradi.

words.example: My locker holds a coat, a helmet, and a mysterious single sock.
words.translation: Javonchamda palto, dubulg‘a va sirli bitta paypoq bor.

words.example: The noticeboard advertises a meeting about reducing notices.
words.translation: E’lonlar taxtasida e’lonlarni kamaytirish haqidagi yig‘ilish e’loni bor.

words.example: Ordering stationery makes me happier than buying shoes.
words.translation: Yozuv-chizuv buyumlariga buyurtma berish meni oyoq kiyim sotib olishdan ko‘proq quvontiradi.

words.example: The stapler is missing again, probably attending another meeting.
words.translation: Stepler yana yo‘q, ehtimol, boshqa yig‘ilishda qatnashayotgandir.

words.example: One bent staple held up our entire printing job.
words.translation: Bitta egilgan qistirgich butun chop etish ishimizni to‘xtatib qo‘ydi.

words.example: A paperclip kept the contract together while my hands shook.
words.translation: Qo‘llarim titrayotganda qog‘oz qisqichi shartnoma varaqlarini birga ushlab turdi.

words.example: The envelope said urgent, but it contained the office party invitation.
words.translation: Konvertda shoshilinch deb yozilgandi, ichida esa ofis bazmiga taklifnoma bor edi.

words.example: The photocopier produced twenty copies of my thumb.
words.translation: Nusxa ko‘chirish apparati bosh barmog‘imning yigirmata nusxasini chiqardi.

words.example: My first job taught me to smile before my morning tea.
words.translation: Birinchi ishim menga ertalabki choydan oldin jilmayishni o‘rgatdi.

words.example: His career in computing began with fixing his grandmother's printer.
words.translation: Uning kompyuter sohasidagi faoliyati buvisining printerini tuzatishdan boshlangan.

words.example: Teaching is a profession that requires both knowledge and spare pens.
words.translation: O‘qituvchilik bilimni ham, zaxira ruchkalarni ham talab qiladigan kasb.

words.example: On the form, write your occupation, not your dream superhero name.
words.translation: Shaklga orzungizdagi superqahramon ismini emas, kasbingizni yozing.

words.example: Her promotion brought more responsibility and a chair that finally adjusts.
words.translation: Lavozimi ko‘tarilishi unga ko‘proq mas’uliyat va nihoyat sozlanadigan stul olib keldi.

words.example: I checked my application twice before sending it to the wrong company.
words.translation: Arizamni noto‘g‘ri kompaniyaga yuborishdan oldin ikki marta tekshirdim.

words.meaning: ish tajribasi va ma’lumot haqidagi qisqa hujjat
words.example: My CV fits on one page if I leave out my childhood lemonade stand.
words.translation: Bolalikdagi limonad rastamni kiritmasam, rezyumem bir sahifaga sig‘adi.

words.example: During the interview, my phone politely reminded me to relax.
words.translation: Ishga kirish suhbatida telefonim muloyimlik bilan bo‘shashishni eslatdi.

words.example: One candidate arrived early enough to help us find the interview room.
words.translation: Bir nomzod shunchalik erta keldiki, suhbat xonasini topishimizga yordam berdi.

words.example: Running a school club gave me experience in solving biscuit disputes.
words.translation: Maktab to‘garagini boshqarish menga pechenye nizolarini hal qilish tajribasini berdi.

words.example: My first salary made my bank account look less lonely.
words.translation: Birinchi maoshim bank hisobimni kamroq yolg‘iz ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: He earns a decent hourly wage for repairing bicycles.
words.translation: U velosipedlarni ta’mirlab, soatiga yaxshi ish haqi oladi.

words.example: Her income from tutoring pays for books and a heroic amount of tea.
words.translation: Qo‘shimcha darslardan olgan daromadi kitoblar va juda ko‘p choyga yetadi.

words.example: Grandad uses part of his pension to learn computer skills.
words.translation: Bobom pensiyasining bir qismini kompyuter ko‘nikmalarini o‘rganishga sarflaydi.

words.example: Read the contract before promising to work every Saturday forever.
words.translation: Abadiy har shanba ishlashga va’da berishdan oldin shartnomani o‘qing.

words.example: My early shift starts before the neighbour's rooster feels ready.
words.translation: Erta smenam qo‘shnining xo‘rozi o‘zini tayyor his qilishidan oldin boshlanadi.

words.example: We worked overtime to finish the display before the shop opened.
words.translation: Do‘kon ochilguncha ko‘rgazmani tugatish uchun ish vaqtidan tashqari ishladik.

words.example: Her part-time job leaves afternoons free for study and occasional naps.
words.translation: Uning to‘liqsiz ish vaqtidagi ishi tushdan keyinni o‘qish va ba’zan mizg‘ish uchun bo‘sh qoldiradi.

words.example: A full-time job made me appreciate weekends with fresh enthusiasm.
words.translation: To‘liq ish vaqtidagi ish dam olish kunlarini yangicha ishtiyoq bilan qadrlashimga sabab bo‘ldi.

words.example: She found a permanent position and finally unpacked her favourite mug.
words.translation: U doimiy ish topdi va nihoyat sevimli krujkasini qutidan chiqardi.

words.example: My temporary desk is a table that still thinks it belongs in a café.
words.translation: Vaqtinchalik ish stolim hali ham o‘zini kafega tegishli deb o‘ylaydigan stol.

words.example: We need to hire someone who understands both numbers and our printer.
words.translation: Raqamlarni ham, printerimizni ham tushunadigan odamni ishga olishimiz kerak.

words.example: The company employs twenty people and unofficially supports three office cats.
words.translation: Kompaniya yigirma kishini ish bilan ta’minlaydi va norasmiy ravishda uchta ofis mushugini boqadi.

words.example: He decided to resign and open the bookshop he always talked about.
words.translation: U ishdan ketib, doim gapiradigan kitob do‘konini ochishga qaror qildi.

words.example: When she retires, she plans to give her alarm clock away.
words.translation: Nafaqaga chiqqach, u budilnigini birovga berishni rejalashtirgan.

words.example: The meeting ended early, and nobody knew what to do with the miracle.
words.translation: Yig‘ilish erta tugadi va hech kim bu mo‘jiza bilan nima qilishni bilmadi.

words.example: The agenda includes budgets, training, and the mysterious fridge smell.
words.translation: Kun tartibiga budjet, o‘qitish va muzlatkichdagi sirli hid kiradi.

words.example: The minutes recorded our decisions but kindly ignored my sneeze.
words.translation: Bayonnoma qarorlarimizni qayd etdi, lekin aksirganimni muloyimlik bilan e’tiborsiz qoldirdi.

words.example: A discussion about office chairs somehow lasted longer than lunch.
words.translation: Ofis stullari haqidagi muhokama qandaydir qilib tushlikdan ham uzoq davom etdi.

words.example: In my opinion, every long meeting needs a short cake break.
words.translation: Menimcha, har bir uzun yig‘ilishga qisqa tort tanaffusi kerak.

words.example: Her suggestion to label the cables saved us a weekly guessing game.
words.translation: Uning kabellarga yorliq qo‘yish taklifi bizni haftalik topishmoqdan qutqardi.

words.example: We reached an agreement after sharing the last slice fairly.
words.translation: Oxirgi bo‘lakni adolatli bo‘lishgach, kelishuvga erishdik.

words.example: The decision to buy a quiet keyboard pleased everyone near my desk.
words.translation: Ovozsiz klaviatura sotib olish qarori stolim yaqinidagi hammani xursand qildi.

words.example: We will vote on the new logo after someone removes the accidental moustache.
words.translation: Kimdir tasodifan paydo bo‘lgan mo‘ylovni olib tashlagach, yangi logotip uchun ovoz beramiz.

words.example: Our leader asks questions before giving answers, which is refreshing.
words.translation: Yetakchimiz javob berishdan oldin savol beradi, bu yoqimli holat.

words.example: My project partner brings the ideas, and I bring the working charger.
words.translation: Loyihadagi sherigim g‘oyalarni olib keladi, men esa ishlaydigan quvvatlagichni.

words.example: Each team member gets a task, including the person hiding behind the plant.
words.translation: Jamoaning har bir a’zosi, hatto o‘simlik orqasiga yashiringan odam ham vazifa oladi.

words.example: My role is to check facts before our report becomes a fairy tale.
words.translation: Mening vazifam hisobotimiz ertakka aylanmasidan ma’lumotlarni tekshirish.

words.example: Keeping the customer files safe is a responsibility, not a guessing game.
words.translation: Mijoz hujjatlarini xavfsiz saqlash taxmin o‘yini emas, mas’uliyatdir.

words.example: We support new colleagues by explaining the software and the coffee machine.
words.translation: Yangi hamkasblarga dastur va qahva mashinasini tushuntirib, ularni qo‘llab-quvvatlaymiz.

words.example: If we cooperate, this task might finish before my tea does.
words.translation: Hamkorlik qilsak, bu vazifa choyim tugashidan oldin bitishi mumkin.

words.example: Please share your notes, especially the part you wrote while I was sneezing.
words.translation: Qaydlaringizni, ayniqsa men aksirayotganimda yozgan qismini bo‘lishing.

words.example: Everyone can contribute an idea, even one that sounds slightly strange.
words.translation: Har kim bir g‘oya, hatto biroz g‘alati tuyuladiganini ham qo‘shishi mumkin.

words.example: Our trainer encourages us to ask questions before pressing mysterious buttons.
words.translation: Trenerimiz sirli tugmalarni bosishdan oldin savol berishga undaydi.

words.example: Respect your colleagues' time by giving your story a reasonably quick ending.
words.translation: Hikoyangizni uncha cho‘zmay tugatib, hamkasblaringiz vaqtini hurmat qiling.

words.example: Our patient trainer explained the same button for the sixth time.
words.translation: Sabrli trenerimiz o‘sha tugmani oltinchi marta tushuntirdi.

words.example: A polite email can still say that the printer is driving us mad.
words.translation: Xushmuomala xatda ham printer bizni aqldan ozdirayotganini aytish mumkin.

words.example: She is so reliable that I trust her more than my calendar.
words.translation: U shunchalik ishonchliki, unga taqvimimdan ham ko‘proq ishonaman.

words.example: Our punctual colleague arrives before the clock has finished striking nine.
words.translation: Vaqtida keladigan hamkasbimiz soat to‘qqizni urib bo‘lmasidan yetib keladi.

words.example: A helpful colleague showed me the shortcut after watching my ten clicks.
words.translation: Yordamga tayyor hamkasbim o‘n marta bosganimni ko‘rib, qisqa yo‘lni ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: Our project is a school website, not the next space station.
words.translation: Loyihamiz keyingi kosmik stansiya emas, maktab veb-saytidir.

words.example: The plan looked perfect until we remembered the office closes at six.
words.translation: Ofis oltida yopilishini eslagunimizcha reja mukammal ko‘rindi.

words.example: The checklist reminded us to bring the projector, not just its remote.
words.translation: Tekshiruv ro‘yxati faqat pultni emas, proyektorni ham olib kelishimizni eslatdi.

words.example: The aim of the guide is to make the software less frightening.
words.translation: Qo‘llanmaning maqsadi dasturni kamroq qo‘rqinchli qilish.

words.example: We reached our monthly target without turning the office into a campsite.
words.translation: Ofisni chodirli lagerga aylantirmay oylik ko‘rsatkichimizga erishdik.

words.example: My schedule has room for lunch, if I eat while walking.
words.translation: Yurib ovqatlansam, jadvalimda tushlikka joy bor.

words.example: Good teamwork means nobody carries all the boxes while everyone else gives advice.
words.translation: Yaxshi jamoaviy mehnatda qolganlar maslahat berib turganida bir kishi barcha qutilarni tashimaydi.

words.example: At this stage, our app can do everything except open.
words.translation: Bu bosqichda ilovamiz ochilishdan boshqa hamma ishni qila oladi.

words.example: The approval process involves three people and one very busy inbox.
words.translation: Tasdiqlash jarayoniga uch kishi va bitta juda band kiruvchi xatlar qutisi jalb qilingan.

words.example: Her method of sorting files works better than my colourful piles.
words.translation: Uning fayllarni saralash usuli mening rangli uyumlarimdan yaxshiroq ishlaydi.

words.example: The final instruction said relax, so I followed it carefully.
words.translation: Oxirgi ko‘rsatmada dam oling deyilgan edi, men uni puxta bajardim.

words.example: Follow the safety procedure even if the machine looks friendly.
words.translation: Uskuna do‘stona ko‘rinsa ham, xavfsizlik tartibiga rioya qiling.

words.example: One small detail matters: the invitation needs an actual address.
words.translation: Bitta kichik jihat muhim: taklifnomaga haqiqiy manzil kerak.

words.example: A working microphone is a requirement for the online presentation.
words.translation: Ishlaydigan mikrofon onlayn taqdimot uchun talab hisoblanadi.

words.example: Fixing the broken website is our priority; choosing new mugs can wait.
words.translation: Buzilgan saytni tuzatish birinchi vazifamiz; yangi krujkalar tanlash kutishi mumkin.

words.example: The budget covers new chairs but sadly no office helicopter.
words.translation: Budjet yangi stullarga yetadi, ammo afsuski, ofis vertolyotiga emas.

words.meaning: foydalanish mumkin bo‘lgan manba yoki vosita
words.example: The library is a useful resource when your internet takes a holiday.
words.translation: Internetingiz ta’tilga chiqqanda kutubxona foydali manba bo‘ladi.

words.example: Our recording equipment fits in one bag, unlike the singer's snacks.
words.translation: Ovoz yozish jihozlarimiz bir sumkaga sig‘adi, xonandaning yeguliklaridan farqli ravishda.

words.example: The training material includes a picture of what not to put in a printer.
words.translation: O‘quv materialida printerga nima solmaslik kerakligi ko‘rsatilgan rasm bor.

words.example: This document is important enough to deserve a sensible filename.
words.translation: Bu hujjat mantiqli fayl nomiga loyiq darajada muhim.

words.example: The report explains why our busiest hour is just before lunch.
words.translation: Hisobot eng band soatimiz nega tushlik oldidan bo‘lishini tushuntiradi.

words.example: My first draft contains useful ideas and several unfinished complaints.
words.translation: Birinchi qoralamamda foydali g‘oyalar va bir nechta tugallanmagan shikoyat bor.

words.example: This version of the timetable finally includes a lunch break.
words.translation: Jadvalning bu nusxasida nihoyat tushlik tanaffusi bor.

words.example: Her presentation had six slides and no chance for us to get sleepy.
words.translation: Uning taqdimotida oltita slayd bor edi, bizda esa uyqusirashga imkon bo‘lmadi.

words.example: The summary should be shorter than the report, despite my colleague's efforts.
words.translation: Hamkasbimning urinishlariga qaramay, qisqacha mazmun hisobotdan qisqaroq bo‘lishi kerak.

words.example: Technology lets me attend a meeting without finding matching socks.
words.translation: Texnologiya menga bir xil paypoqlarni topmasdan yig‘ilishda qatnashish imkonini beradi.

words.example: This device counts my steps, including trips to the biscuit tin.
words.translation: Bu qurilma qadamlarimni, jumladan, pechenye qutisigacha borganlarimni ham sanaydi.

words.example: Grandma uses her tablet for recipes and surprisingly competitive chess.
words.translation: Buvim planshetini retseptlar va hayratlanarli darajada shiddatli shaxmat uchun ishlatadi.

words.example: My smartphone knows the weather but cannot find itself under the sofa.
words.translation: Smartfonim ob-havoni biladi, lekin divan tagida o‘zini topa olmaydi.

words.example: A larger monitor makes my spreadsheet look more important.
words.translation: Kattaroq monitor elektron jadvalimni muhimroq qilib ko‘rsatadi.

words.example: The printer waits until I am late before asking for paper.
words.translation: Printer qog‘oz so‘rashdan oldin kech qolishimni kutadi.

words.example: The scanner captured my drawing and a corner of my sleeve.
words.translation: Skaner rasmimni va yengimning bir chetini nusxaladi.

words.example: The tiny speaker makes our office sound like a concert hall.
words.translation: Kichkina karnay ofisimizni konsert zalidek jaranglatadi.

words.example: Move the microphone away from your lunch before the whole team hears it.
words.translation: Butun jamoa eshitmasidan mikrofonni tushligingizdan uzoqlashtiring.

words.example: My headphones help me study while my brother learns the trumpet.
words.translation: Ukam karnay chalishni o‘rganayotganda quloqchinim dars qilishimga yordam beradi.

words.example: With this headset, I look ready to land a plane rather than answer calls.
words.translation: Bu mikrofonli quloqchin bilan qo‘ng‘iroqqa javob berishga emas, samolyotni qo‘ndirishga tayyordek ko‘rinaman.

words.example: The webcam revealed the laundry mountain behind my tidy desk.
words.translation: Veb-kamera ozoda stolim ortidagi kir tog‘ini ko‘rsatib qo‘ydi.

words.example: My smartwatch reminds me to stand up during meetings about productivity.
words.translation: Aqlli soatim unumdorlik haqidagi yig‘ilishlarda o‘rnimdan turishimni eslatadi.

words.example: Whoever brings a charger becomes the hero of the afternoon.
words.translation: Quvvatlagich olib kelgan odam tushdan keyinning qahramoniga aylanadi.

words.example: My battery reaches one per cent whenever I need directions.
words.translation: Yo‘l ko‘rsatma kerak bo‘lganida batareyam bir foizga tushadi.

words.example: This cable is long enough to trip over from another room.
words.translation: Bu kabel boshqa xonadan turib ham qoqilib ketadigan darajada uzun.

words.example: The technician replaced a wire thinner than a piece of spaghetti.
words.translation: Texnik spagettidan ham ingichka simni almashtirdi.

words.example: The keyboard connects by USB, once I find the right port behind the desk.
words.translation: Stol ortidan kerakli portni topsam, klaviatura USB orqali ulanadi.

words.example: The faster processor finishes calculations before I finish reading the question.
words.translation: Tezroq protsessor savolni o‘qib bo‘lgunimcha hisob-kitoblarni tugatadi.

words.example: The sensor turns on the lights whenever our office cat walks past.
words.translation: Ofis mushugimiz yonidan o‘tganda datchik chiroqlarni yoqadi.

words.example: The joystick helped us steer the little robot away from everyone's shoes.
words.translation: Joystik kichkina robotni hammaning oyoq kiyimidan chetga yo‘naltirishga yordam berdi.

words.example: The modem stopped working just as my online class became interesting.
words.translation: Onlayn darsim qiziq bo‘la boshlaganda modem ishlamay qoldi.

words.example: The touchscreen works better when my fingers are not covered in biscuit crumbs.
words.translation: Barmoqlarim pechenye ushoqlariga belanmaganida sensorli ekran yaxshiroq ishlaydi.

words.example: We upgraded the hardware, but my typing speed stayed proudly slow.
words.translation: Kompyuter qismlarini yangiladik, ammo yozish tezligim mag‘rurona sekinligicha qoldi.

words.example: The computer needs more memory to hold all my unfinished projects.
words.translation: Tugallanmagan barcha loyihalarimni saqlash uchun kompyuterga ko‘proq xotira kerak.

words.example: The new software checks spelling but cannot improve my jokes.
words.translation: Yangi dastur imloni tekshiradi, lekin hazillarimni yaxshilay olmaydi.

words.example: This program turns numbers into charts and confusion into slightly prettier confusion.
words.translation: Bu dastur raqamlarni diagrammaga, chalkashlikni esa biroz chiroyliroq chalkashlikka aylantiradi.

words.example: I downloaded an app to remind me which apps I should delete.
words.translation: Qaysi ilovalarni o‘chirish kerakligini eslatish uchun ilova yuklab oldim.

words.example: Give the file a clear name before it joins the other twelve mysteries.
words.translation: Qolgan o‘n ikkita sirga qo‘shilmasidan faylga aniq nom bering.

words.example: The bin icon looks small, but it can swallow a whole report.
words.translation: Savat belgisi kichik ko‘rinadi, lekin butun hisobotni yutishi mumkin.

words.example: I opened the menu looking for settings, not soup.
words.translation: Menyuni sho‘rva emas, sozlamalarni qidirib ochdim.

words.example: The toolbar has a button for everything except making my deadline later.
words.translation: Asboblar panelida muddatimni kechiktirishdan boshqa hamma ish uchun tugma bor.

words.example: My cursor disappeared just when I wanted to look professional.
words.translation: Aynan professional ko‘rinmoqchi bo‘lganimda kursorim yo‘qolib qoldi.

words.example: My desktop is tidy because every file is hiding in one folder.
words.translation: Kompyuter ish stolim tartibli, chunki barcha fayllar bitta papkada yashiringan.

words.example: Our spreadsheet tracks office expenses, including emergency chocolate.
words.translation: Elektron jadvalimiz ofis xarajatlarini, jumladan, favqulodda shokolad xaridlarini ham hisobga oladi.

words.example: The database contains every customer except the one I need right now.
words.translation: Ma’lumotlar bazasida ayni damda kerak bo‘lganidan tashqari barcha mijozlar bor.

words.example: One missing bracket in the code ruined my peaceful afternoon.
words.translation: Koddagi bitta yetishmayotgan qavs tinch tushdan keyinimni buzdi.

words.example: I changed one setting and the computer began speaking Italian.
words.translation: Bitta sozlamani o‘zgartirdim va kompyuter italyancha gapira boshladi.

words.example: Update the app before blaming it for last year's problems.
words.translation: O‘tgan yilgi muammolarda ayblashdan oldin ilovani yangilang.

words.example: We can install the software while the kettle performs its own important task.
words.translation: Choynak o‘zining muhim vazifasini bajarayotganda dasturni o‘rnatishimiz mumkin.

words.example: I will uninstall the game before my lunch breaks become suspiciously long.
words.translation: Tushlik tanaffuslarim shubhali darajada cho‘zilmasidan o‘yinni o‘chirib tashlayman.

words.example: Delete the empty file, not the report we spent all week writing.
words.translation: Bir hafta yozgan hisobotimizni emas, bo‘sh faylni o‘chiring.

words.example: Please edit the title before our manager becomes a mango again.
words.translation: Menejerimiz yana mangoga aylanmasidan sarlavhani tahrir qiling.

words.example: Paste the address into the box, not into the public chat.
words.translation: Manzilni umumiy chatga emas, maydonga joylang.

words.example: Click undo before that accidental purple background becomes our official design.
words.translation: Tasodifiy binafsha fon rasmiy dizaynimizga aylanmasidan bekor qilishni bosing.

words.example: Print one copy first unless you want fifty identical mistakes.
words.translation: Ellikta bir xil xato xohlamasangiz, avval bitta nusxani chop eting.

words.example: Scan the receipt before the ink fades into a financial mystery.
words.translation: Siyoh o‘chib, moliyaviy sirga aylanmasidan chekni skaner qiling.

words.example: I type faster when nobody is watching my fingers.
words.translation: Hech kim barmoqlarimga qaramaganda tezroq yozaman.

words.example: Click once; the computer is thinking, not ignoring you.
words.translation: Bir marta bosing; kompyuter sizni mensimayotgani yo‘q, o‘ylayapti.

words.example: Drag the picture into place before it covers the boss's face.
words.translation: Boshliqning yuzini yopib qolmasidan rasmni joyiga suring.

words.example: Our class is online today, so my slippers can attend too.
words.translation: Bugun darsimiz onlayn, shuning uchun shippagim ham qatnashishi mumkin.

words.example: The app works offline, which makes train tunnels less annoying.
words.translation: Ilova internetsiz ishlaydi, bu poyezd tunnellarini kamroq zerikarli qiladi.

words.example: My browser has so many tabs that each title is now one letter.
words.translation: Brauzerimda shunchalik ko‘p varaq ochilganki, har bir sarlavha endi bitta harfdan iborat.

words.example: A search engine cannot find my glasses, although I keep asking.
words.translation: Qidiruv tizimi ko‘zoynagimni topa olmaydi, garchi qayta-qayta so‘rasam ham.

words.example: The link took us to a recipe instead of the meeting.
words.translation: Havola bizni yig‘ilishga emas, retseptga olib bordi.

words.example: Our homepage now explains what we sell before showing a giant smiling duck.
words.translation: Bosh sahifamiz endi ulkan jilmaygan o‘rdakni ko‘rsatishdan oldin nima sotishimizni tushuntiradi.

words.example: This webpage loads slowly enough for me to make tea.
words.translation: Bu veb-sahifa choy damlashga ulguradigan darajada sekin yuklanadi.

words.example: Somewhere in a tab, a video is playing music I cannot stop.
words.translation: Qaysidir brauzer varag‘ida men to‘xtata olmayotgan musiqa videosi o‘ynayapti.

words.example: Check the website address before trusting its offer of free laptops.
words.translation: Bepul noutbuklar taklifiga ishonishdan oldin sayt manzilini tekshiring.

words.example: Download the lesson before the village Wi-Fi takes its afternoon nap.
words.translation: Qishloqning Wi-Fi tarmog‘i tushdan keyin mizg‘ishga ketmasidan darsni yuklab oling.

words.example: Upload the final photo, preferably the one where my eyes are open.
words.translation: Yakuniy suratni, yaxshisi ko‘zlarim ochiq tushganini yuklang.

words.example: I subscribe to a science newsletter that makes breakfast more interesting.
words.translation: Nonushtani qiziqroq qiladigan ilmiy xabarnomaga obuna bo‘lganman.

words.example: I browse the library website when I should be returning its books.
words.translation: Kutubxona kitoblarini qaytarishim kerak bo‘lgan paytda uning saytini ko‘rib o‘tiraman.

words.example: Search for the exact phrase unless you want results about dancing onions.
words.translation: Raqsga tushadigan piyozlar haqida natijalar xohlamasangiz, aniq iborani qidiring.

words.example: Connect to the school network before declaring the internet broken.
words.translation: Internet buzilganini e’lon qilishdan oldin maktab tarmog‘iga ulaning.

words.example: My connection froze with my mouth open during the introduction.
words.translation: Tanishtirish paytida ulanishim og‘zim ochiq holatda qotib qoldi.

words.example: The office network is busiest when everyone sends Friday reports.
words.translation: Hamma juma hisobotlarini yuborganda ofis tarmog‘i eng band bo‘ladi.

words.example: The Wi-Fi password is longer than our office welcome speech.
words.translation: Wi-Fi paroli ofisimizdagi qutlov nutqidan uzunroq.

words.example: The router blinked calmly while we blamed it for everything.
words.translation: Biz hamma narsada ayblayotganimizda router xotirjam miltillab turdi.

words.example: The signal is strongest beside the window and weakest beside my patience.
words.translation: Signal deraza yonida eng kuchli, sabrim yonida esa eng kuchsiz.

words.example: Faster broadband means my video calls now show every embarrassing detail.
words.translation: Tezroq internet videoqo‘ng‘iroqlarim endi har bir noqulay tafsilotni ko‘rsatishini anglatadi.

words.example: Her blog explains computer problems using pictures of confused penguins.
words.translation: Uning blogi kompyuter muammolarini gangigan pingvinlar rasmlari bilan tushuntiradi.

words.example: Someone on the forum solved the problem I had blamed on Monday.
words.translation: Forumdagi kimdir men dushanbadan ko‘rgan muammoni hal qildi.

words.example: I listen to a language podcast while my laundry goes round.
words.translation: Kirlarim aylanayotganda til o‘rgatuvchi podkast tinglayman.

words.example: The webinar taught me useful skills while my cat slept through the whole thing.
words.translation: Mushugim boshidan oxirigacha uxlagan vebinar menga foydali ko‘nikmalar o‘rgatdi.

words.example: Clear communication prevents five people from bringing the same cake.
words.translation: Aniq axborot almashish besh kishining bir xil tort olib kelishiga yo‘l qo‘ymaydi.

words.example: Our conversation about work became a serious debate about lunch.
words.translation: Ish haqidagi suhbatimiz tushlik bo‘yicha jiddiy bahsga aylandi.

words.example: The group chat contains three useful messages and forty pictures of cats.
words.translation: Guruh chatida uchta foydali xabar va qirqta mushuk rasmi bor.

words.example: Text me the room number so I do not join another wedding by mistake.
words.translation: Yana adashib boshqa to‘yga kirib qolmasligim uchun xona raqamini xabar qilib yuboring.

words.example: Please reply before I invent six possible explanations for your silence.
words.translation: Sukutingiz uchun oltita mumkin bo‘lgan izoh o‘ylab topishimdan oldin javob bering.

words.example: She responds to customer questions faster than I respond to my alarm.
words.translation: U mijoz savollariga men budilnigimga javob berganimdan tezroq javob qaytaradi.

words.example: Contact the help desk if your computer starts speaking in symbols.
words.translation: Kompyuteringiz belgilar tilida gapira boshlasa, yordam xizmatiga bog‘laning.

words.example: Dial the office number carefully; yesterday I called a pet shop.
words.translation: Ofis raqamini diqqat bilan tering; kecha men hayvonlar do‘koniga qo‘ng‘iroq qilibman.

words.example: Do not hang up yet; I have finally found the document under my lunch.
words.translation: Hali telefonni qo‘ymang; hujjatni nihoyat tushligim tagidan topdim.

words.example: I left a voicemail, then worried that I had forgotten my own name.
words.translation: Ovozli xabar qoldirdim, keyin o‘z ismimni aytishni unutdimmi deb xavotirlandim.

words.example: My inbox fills up faster than the office kettle.
words.translation: Kiruvchi xatlar qutim ofis choynagidan tezroq to‘ladi.

words.example: The attachment was missing from my email about checking attachments.
words.translation: Biriktirilgan fayllarni tekshirish haqidagi xatimda ilova yo‘q edi.

words.example: Forward the invitation to Ali before he plans a quiet evening.
words.translation: Ali tinch oqshom rejalashtirmasidan taklifnomani unga yuboring.

words.example: Did you receive my message, or is it still touring the internet?
words.translation: Xabarimni oldingizmi yoki u hali ham internet bo‘ylab sayohat qilyaptimi?

words.example: The service could not deliver my message because the address was imaginary.
words.translation: Manzil xayoliy bo‘lgani uchun xizmat xabarimni yetkaza olmadi.

words.example: A notification interrupted the app that was teaching me to concentrate.
words.translation: Diqqatni jamlashni o‘rgatayotgan ilovamni bildirishnoma bo‘lib qo‘ydi.

words.example: The calendar alert reminded me of a meeting I was already missing.
words.translation: Taqvim ogohlantirishi allaqachon o‘tkazib yuborayotgan yig‘ilishimni eslatdi.

words.example: Mute your microphone before your blender joins the discussion.
words.translation: Blenderingiz muhokamaga qo‘shilmasidan mikrofoningizni o‘chiring.

words.example: Remember to unmute before delivering another brilliant silent speech.
words.translation: Yana bir ajoyib ovozsiz nutq so‘zlashdan oldin mikrofonni yoqishni unutmang.

words.example: Turn the volume down unless the next village needs this lecture too.
words.translation: Bu ma’ruza keyingi qishloqqa ham kerak bo‘lmasa, ovozni pasaytiring.

words.example: The training video stars a stapler that never jams.
words.translation: O‘quv videosining bosh qahramoni hech qachon tiqilib qolmaydigan stepler.

words.example: The audio is clear enough to hear someone opening biscuits.
words.translation: Ovoz kimdir pechenye ochayotganini eshitadigan darajada aniq.

words.example: They broadcast the school concert, including our surprise microphone squeak.
words.translation: Ular maktab konsertini, jumladan, mikrofonimizning kutilmagan chiyillashini ham efirga uzatishdi.

words.example: Please announce the winner before my knees stop shaking.
words.translation: Tizzalarim titrashdan to‘xtamasidan g‘olibni e’lon qiling.

words.example: Mention the deadline early, not after everyone has put their coats on.
words.translation: Muddatni hamma paltosini kiyganidan keyin emas, oldinroq ayting.

words.example: My account has a serious username and a picture of a dancing lemon.
words.translation: Hisobimning foydalanuvchi nomi jiddiy, rasmi esa raqsga tushayotgan limon.

words.example: Choose a username you will not hate explaining at a job interview.
words.translation: Ishga kirish suhbatida tushuntirish noqulay bo‘lmaydigan foydalanuvchi nomini tanlang.

words.example: Max looks offended that his name is not a strong password.
words.translation: Maks o‘z ismi kuchli parol emasligidan xafa ko‘rinadi.

words.example: Her profile photo looks professional, unlike the twelve attempts before it.
words.translation: Profil surati undan oldingi o‘n ikki urinishdan farqli ravishda professional ko‘rinadi.

words.example: Check your privacy settings before the whole internet meets your bedroom.
words.translation: Butun internet yotoqxonangiz bilan tanishmasidan maxfiylik sozlamalarini tekshiring.

words.example: Keep the class group private unless you want strangers checking your homework.
words.translation: Begonalar uy vazifangizni tekshirishini xohlamasangiz, sinf guruhini yopiq saqlang.

words.example: That post is public, so even your old headteacher could read it.
words.translation: O‘sha post hammaga ochiq, shuning uchun hatto sobiq direktoringiz ham uni o‘qishi mumkin.

words.example: A secure account needs more protection than your pet's birthday.
words.translation: Himoyalangan hisob uchun uy hayvoningizning tug‘ilgan kunidan ko‘proq himoya kerak.

words.example: Verify the sender's identity before helping a mysterious prince with his banking.
words.translation: Sirli shahzodaga bank ishlarida yordam berishdan oldin jo‘natuvchining kimligini tekshiring.

words.example: Protect your files before your laptop decides to have an adventure.
words.translation: Noutbukingiz sarguzashtga otlanishga qaror qilmasidan fayllaringizni himoya qiling.

words.example: The torch app asked for permission to read my contacts, which seemed rather curious.
words.translation: Chiroq ilovasi kontaktlarimni o‘qishga ruxsat so‘radi, bu ancha qiziq tuyuldi.

words.example: Only the project team has access to our unfinished designs.
words.translation: Tugallanmagan dizaynlarimizdan faqat loyiha jamoasi foydalana oladi.

words.example: A backup saved my report when the laptop met a cup of tea.
words.translation: Noutbuk bir piyola choy bilan uchrashganda zaxira nusxa hisobotimni saqlab qoldi.

words.example: A computer virus does not need a scarf or hot soup.
words.translation: Kompyuter virusiga sharf ham, issiq sho‘rva ham kerak emas.

words.example: My spam folder thinks I have won more prizes than any athlete.
words.translation: Spam papkam meni har qanday sportchidan ko‘proq sovrin yutgan deb o‘ylaydi.

words.example: The free-laptop offer was a scam with very enthusiastic punctuation.
words.translation: Bepul noutbuk taklifi juda jo‘shqin tinish belgilariga ega firibgarlik edi.

words.example: A hacker would find my cat's name easier to guess than I once thought.
words.translation: Xaker uchun mushugimning ismini topish men ilgari o‘ylaganimdan osonroq bo‘lardi.

words.example: Block the sender who keeps offering you a castle for ten pounds.
words.translation: Sizga o‘n funtga qasr taklif qilaveradigan jo‘natuvchini bloklang.

words.example: The email filter sent the fake prince straight to spam.
words.translation: Xat filtri soxta shahzodani to‘g‘ri spamga jo‘natdi.

words.example: You can sign up for the course without telling the website your dog's life story.
words.translation: Saytga itingizning hayotini hikoya qilmasdan kursga ro‘yxatdan o‘tishingiz mumkin.

words.example: I could not unlock my phone while wearing those enormous gloves.
words.translation: O‘sha ulkan qo‘lqoplarni kiyib telefonimni qulfdan chiqara olmadim.

words.example: Reset your password if remembering it requires an archaeological expedition.
words.translation: Parolingizni eslash uchun arxeologik ekspeditsiya kerak bo‘lsa, uni yangidan belgilang.

words.example: We managed to recover the file that I had confidently deleted.
words.translation: Men ishonch bilan o‘chirgan faylni tiklashga muvaffaq bo‘ldik.

words.example: Log in before writing your essay, or the website may forget you exist.
words.translation: Insho yozishdan oldin hisobga kiring, aks holda sayt borligingizni unutishi mumkin.

words.example: Log out on shared computers before the next person becomes you.
words.translation: Umumiy kompyuterda keyingi odam sizga aylanmasidan hisobdan chiqing.

words.example: Explaining a problem calmly is a skill I practise near the printer.
words.translation: Muammoni xotirjam tushuntirish printer yonida mashq qiladigan ko‘nikmamdir.

words.example: Her ability to remember names makes every school reunion easier.
words.translation: Uning ismlarni eslab qolish qobiliyati har bir sinfdoshlar uchrashuvini osonlashtiradi.

words.example: He has a talent for turning dull numbers into interesting stories.
words.translation: U zerikarli raqamlarni qiziqarli hikoyalarga aylantirish iste’dodiga ega.

words.example: The broken projector tested our creativity and our drawing skills.
words.translation: Buzilgan proyektor ijodkorligimizni va rasm chizish ko‘nikmalarimizni sinadi.

words.example: My confidence grew after the audience laughed at the right moment.
words.translation: Tinglovchilar kerakli paytda kulgach, o‘zimga ishonchim oshdi.

words.example: Learning to code requires patience, especially with missing commas.
words.translation: Kod yozishni o‘rganish, ayniqsa tushib qolgan vergullar bilan, sabr talab qiladi.

words.example: My concentration survived the traffic but not the smell of fresh bread.
words.translation: Diqqatim transport shovqiniga bardosh berdi, lekin yangi non hidiga emas.

words.example: A little effort every day works better than one heroic night before the exam.
words.translation: Har kuni ozgina harakat qilish imtihon oldidagi bitta qahramonona kechadan yaxshiroq natija beradi.

words.example: There is a clear improvement: my emails now reach the right people.
words.translation: Aniq yaxshilanish bor: xatlarim endi kerakli odamlarga yetib boryapti.

words.example: Finishing the course was an achievement worth more than a sleepy thumbs-up.
words.translation: Kursni tugatish uyqusirab bosh barmoq ko‘rsatishdan ko‘proq e’tirofga loyiq yutuq edi.

words.example: The workshop was a success because everyone left with a working website.
words.translation: Amaliy seminar muvaffaqiyatli o‘tdi, chunki hamma ishlaydigan sayt bilan ketdi.

words.example: Her main strength is explaining complex ideas without making anyone feel silly.
words.translation: Uning asosiy kuchli jihati murakkab g‘oyalarni hech kimni nodon his qildirmay tushuntirishidir.

words.example: My weakness is public speaking, especially when the microphone whistles back.
words.translation: Zaif jihatim omma oldida gapirish, ayniqsa mikrofon javoban hushtak chalganda.

words.example: You are capable of leading the session without hiding behind the slides.
words.translation: Slaydlar ortiga yashirinmasdan mashg‘ulotni boshqarishga qodirsiz.

words.example: A skilled technician can hear trouble before the machine starts dancing.
words.translation: Malakali texnik uskuna raqsga tushishidan oldin nosozlikni ovozidan sezadi.

words.example: The course teaches practical skills, such as fixing a tap without flooding the room.
words.translation: Kurs xonani suvga bostirmay kranni tuzatish kabi amaliy ko‘nikmalarni o‘rgatadi.

words.example: Our creative designer turned a boring instruction sheet into a comic.
words.translation: Ijodkor dizaynerimiz zerikarli ko‘rsatmalar varag‘ini komiksga aylantirdi.

words.example: I felt confident until someone asked me to connect the projector.
words.translation: Kimdir proyektorni ulashimni so‘raguncha o‘zimga ishongan edim.

words.example: Independent learners still ask questions; they just find the answers more actively.
words.translation: Mustaqil o‘rganuvchilar ham savol beradi; ular shunchaki javoblarni faolroq izlaydi.

words.example: A flexible team can change the plan without treating it as a national disaster.
words.translation: Moslashuvchan jamoa rejani milliy falokat deb bilmasdan o‘zgartira oladi.

words.example: Accurate notes stopped us from ordering a thousand folders instead of a hundred.
words.translation: Aniq qaydlar yuzta o‘rniga mingta jild buyurtma qilishimizga yo‘l qo‘ymadi.

words.example: A careful reader noticed that the meeting date was last Tuesday.
words.translation: Sinchkov o‘quvchi yig‘ilish sanasi o‘tgan seshanba ekanini payqadi.

words.example: You can develop your speaking skills without giving speeches to the whole bus.
words.translation: Butun avtobusga nutq so‘zlamasdan ham gapirish ko‘nikmalaringizni rivojlantira olasiz.

words.example: I want to improve my typing so the keyboard stops winning our daily race.
words.translation: Klaviatura kundalik poygamizda yutishni to‘xtatishi uchun yozishimni yaxshilamoqchiman.

words.example: We had to adapt when the training room became a temporary storeroom.
words.translation: O‘quv xonasi vaqtinchalik omborga aylanganda moslashishga majbur bo‘ldik.

words.example: Our experiment tested whether music helps plants or just entertains the gardener.
words.translation: Tajribamiz musiqa o‘simliklarga yordam beradimi yoki faqat bog‘bonni ovutadimi, shuni tekshirdi.

words.example: The survey found that nobody wanted meetings before breakfast.
words.translation: So‘rov hech kim nonushtadan oldin yig‘ilish xohlamasligini aniqladi.

words.example: The questionnaire about free time took most of my free time.
words.translation: Bo‘sh vaqt haqidagi anketa bo‘sh vaqtimning ko‘p qismini oldi.

words.example: We took a sample of pond water and found a very busy tiny world.
words.translation: Hovuz suvidan namuna oldik va juda serharakat mitti olamni topdik.

words.example: Our data shows that the office gets quieter when the biscuits run out.
words.translation: Ma’lumotlarimiz pechenye tugaganda ofis tinchroq bo‘lishini ko‘rsatadi.

words.example: Crumbs on the keyboard are evidence that someone ignored the no-food rule.
words.translation: Klaviaturadagi ushoqlar kimdir ovqatlanmaslik qoidasini buzganining dalilidir.

words.example: Check the source before believing that penguins invented email.
words.translation: Pingvinlar elektron pochtani ixtiro qilganiga ishonishdan oldin manbani tekshiring.

words.example: Add a reference so readers know the fact did not come from your hamster.
words.translation: O‘quvchilar ma’lumot xomyagingizdan kelmaganini bilishi uchun manbaga havola qo‘shing.

words.example: She chose sleep as her research topic and promised to stay awake.
words.translation: U tadqiqot mavzusi sifatida uyquni tanladi va uxlamaslikka va’da berdi.

words.example: The title caught my attention because it mentioned both robots and sandwiches.
words.translation: Sarlavha ham robotlarni, ham sendvichlarni tilga olgani uchun e’tiborimni tortdi.

words.example: The purpose of the experiment is learning, not decorating the ceiling.
words.translation: Tajribaning maqsadi shiftni bezash emas, bilim olish.

words.example: My prediction was wrong, but at least the paper bridge looked elegant.
words.translation: Taxminim noto‘g‘ri chiqdi, lekin hech bo‘lmasa qog‘oz ko‘prik nafis ko‘rindi.

words.example: Observe the ants without offering them your entire lunch.
words.translation: Chumolilarni butun tushligingizni taklif qilmasdan kuzating.

words.example: My first observation was that the snail had no interest in our timetable.
words.translation: Birinchi kuzatuvim shuki, shilliqqurt jadvalimizga umuman qiziqmadi.

words.example: We will investigate why one classroom is always colder than the corridor.
words.translation: Nega bitta sinfxona doim yo‘lakdan sovuqroq bo‘lishini tekshirib o‘rganamiz.

words.example: Our biggest discovery was that the sensor had been upside down.
words.translation: Eng katta topilmamiz datchik teskari o‘rnatilganini aniqlash bo‘ldi.

words.example: We analyse the results before celebrating our imaginary scientific genius.
words.translation: Xayoliy ilmiy daholigimizni nishonlashdan oldin natijalarni tahlil qilamiz.

words.example: The analysis showed that my favourite explanation was completely wrong.
words.translation: Tahlil men yoqtirgan izoh butunlay noto‘g‘ri ekanini ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: Count the responses twice, unless you want one student to become three.
words.translation: Bitta o‘quvchi uchtaga aylanishini xohlamasangiz, javoblarni ikki marta sanang.

words.example: One careless measurement turned our model house into a very narrow tower.
words.translation: Bitta e’tiborsiz o‘lchov maket uyimizni juda ingichka minoraga aylantirdi.

words.example: Record each result immediately, before your memory improves the story.
words.translation: Xotirangiz hikoyani bezashidan oldin har bir natijani darhol qayd eting.

words.example: We collect temperature readings, not excuses for missing science class.
words.translation: Biz tabiiy fanlar darsini qoldirish bahonalarini emas, harorat ko‘rsatkichlarini to‘playmiz.

words.example: Group the answers by topic before your desk becomes a paper jungle.
words.translation: Stolingiz qog‘oz changalzoriga aylanmasidan javoblarni mavzu bo‘yicha guruhlang.

words.example: We can conclude that one sleepy volunteer is not enough for this study.
words.translation: Bitta uyqusiragan ko‘ngilli bu tadqiqot uchun yetarli emas degan xulosa chiqarishimiz mumkin.

words.example: Our conclusion was simple: the plants needed water, not motivational speeches.
words.translation: Xulosamiz oddiy edi: o‘simliklarga ruhlantiruvchi nutqlar emas, suv kerak ekan.

words.example: A scientific explanation needs more than my uncle's confident nod.
words.translation: Ilmiy izoh uchun amakimning ishonchli bosh irg‘ashidan ko‘proq narsa kerak.

words.example: The digital scale gave a precise answer that the baker did not expect.
words.translation: Raqamli tarozi novvoy kutmagan aniq javobni berdi.

words.example: Under the microscope, a drop of water looked busier than our office.
words.translation: Mikroskop ostida bir tomchi suv ofisimizdan ham gavjumroq ko‘rindi.

words.example: The telescope showed us the moon without revealing any cheese.
words.translation: Teleskop bizga Oyni ko‘rsatdi, lekin hech qanday pishloqni ochib bermadi.

words.example: Clean the lens before announcing that every star has a fingerprint.
words.translation: Har bir yulduzda barmoq izi borligini e’lon qilishdan oldin linzani tozalang.

words.example: The test tube was tiny, but our excitement was enormous.
words.translation: Probirka kichkina edi, hayajonimiz esa ulkan.

words.example: The thermometer confirmed that the classroom was warmer than our welcome.
words.translation: Termometr sinfxona kutib olishimizdan ham iliqroq ekanini tasdiqladi.

words.example: The lab was twenty degrees Celsius, but my tea had other plans.
words.translation: Laboratoriyada harorat yigirma daraja Selsiy edi, lekin choyimning rejalari boshqacha edi.

words.example: A millimetre sounds tiny until your robot misses a doorway by one.
words.translation: Robot eshikdan bir millimetr tufayli o‘tolmay qolmaguncha, bu birlik juda kichik tuyuladi.

words.example: Write the unit beside the number, or your bridge might be three bananas long.
words.translation: Raqam yoniga o‘lchov birligini yozing, aks holda ko‘prigingiz uch banan uzunlikda bo‘lishi mumkin.

words.example: We measured the length of the cable before celebrating its usefulness.
words.translation: Kabelning foydaliligini nishonlashdan oldin uzunligini o‘lchadik.

words.example: The width of the robot matters when the classroom door is narrow.
words.translation: Sinfxona eshigi tor bo‘lsa, robotning kengligi muhim bo‘ladi.

words.example: The height of our paper tower impressed everyone until someone sneezed.
words.translation: Kimdir aksirguncha qog‘oz minoramizning balandligi hammani qoyil qoldirdi.

words.meaning: diametr; aylana markazidan o‘tuvchi kesma uzunligi
words.example: We measured the diameter of the wheel before discovering it would not fit our robot.
words.translation: G‘ildirak robotimizga sig‘masligini bilishdan oldin uning diametrini o‘lchadik.

words.example: The weight of the books bent our experimental cardboard shelf.
words.translation: Kitoblarning og‘irligi tajriba uchun yasalgan karton tokchamizni egib qo‘ydi.

words.example: One extra centimetre made our model too wide for its carefully built box.
words.translation: Bitta ortiqcha santimetr maketimizni puxta yasalgan qutisiga sig‘maydigan darajada keng qilib qo‘ydi.

words.example: The robot's speed increased after we removed the unnecessary toy passenger.
words.translation: Keraksiz o‘yinchoq yo‘lovchini olib tashlagach, robotning tezligi oshdi.

words.example: The average rose sharply when we included the headteacher's enormous bookshelf.
words.translation: Direktorning ulkan kitob javonini qo‘shganimizda o‘rtacha qiymat keskin oshdi.

words.example: The total includes every survey response, even the one written in purple crayon.
words.translation: Jami miqdorga har bir so‘rov javobi, hatto binafsha mumqalamda yozilgani ham kiradi.

words.example: The maximum was twelve clicks, which seemed a lot for opening one file.
words.translation: Eng katta miqdor o‘n ikki marta bosish bo‘ldi, bu bitta faylni ochish uchun ko‘pdek tuyuldi.

words.example: The minimum was two seconds, set by someone who clearly wanted lunch.
words.translation: Eng kichik vaqt ikki soniya bo‘ldi, uni tushlikni juda xohlagan kimdir qayd etdi.

words.example: My diagram explains the machine better than my excited hand movements.
words.translation: Chizmam uskunani hayajonli qo‘l harakatlarimdan yaxshiroq tushuntiradi.

words.example: The chart shows that our coffee use rises with the number of meetings.
words.translation: Diagramma yig‘ilishlar soni oshishi bilan qahva iste’molimiz ham oshishini ko‘rsatadi.

words.example: The graph went up so steeply that someone drew a tiny climber on it.
words.translation: Grafik shunchalik tik ko‘tarildiki, kimdir unga mitti alpinist chizdi.

words.example: The graph shows a clear trend: fewer people answer surveys on Friday afternoons.
words.translation: Grafik aniq yo‘nalishni ko‘rsatadi: juma kuni tushdan keyin so‘rovlarga kamroq odam javob beradi.

words.example: An honest child returned my wallet but kept the sweet I offered.
words.translation: Rostgo‘y bola hamyonimni qaytardi, lekin men taklif qilgan konfetni oldi.

words.example: Her gentle voice calmed the child and nearly put me to sleep.
words.translation: Uning muloyim ovozi bolani tinchlantirib, meni ham deyarli uxlatdi.

words.example: The well-mannered boy thanked everyone, including the sleeping dog.
words.translation: Yaxshi tarbiya ko‘rgan bola hammaga, hatto uxlayotgan itga ham rahmat aytdi.

words.example: My generous aunt gave everyone cake, including the taxi driver.
words.translation: Saxiy xolam hammaga, hatto taksi haydovchisiga ham tort berdi.

words.example: She's dependable: if she promises cake, bring a plate.
words.translation: Unga ishonsa bo‘ladi: tort va’da qilsa, likopcha olib kel.

words.example: My loyal friend supported me through three terrible haircuts.
words.translation: Sodiq do‘stim uchta dahshatli soch turmagimga qaramay yonimda bo‘ldi.

words.example: She was brave enough to tell Grandma the soup needed salt.
words.translation: U buvisiga sho‘rvaga tuz kerakligini aytishga jur’at etdi.

words.example: My outgoing sister made three friends while I was choosing a seat.
words.translation: Men o‘rindiq tanlayotganimda kirishimli singlim uchta do‘st orttirdi.

words.example: Our cheerful neighbour whistles even when he takes out rubbish.
words.translation: Quvnoq qo‘shnimiz hatto axlat olib chiqayotganda ham hushtak chaladi.

words.example: Wearing flat shoes to chase a puppy was a sensible choice.
words.translation: Kuchukchani quvish uchun poshnasiz tufli kiyish oqilona tanlov edi.

words.example: A thoughtful friend brought dinner when our baby was born.
words.translation: Farzandimiz tug‘ilganida e’tiborli do‘stimiz kechki ovqat olib keldi.

words.example: Despite winning, she was modest and praised her opponent's socks.
words.translation: G‘alaba qozonganiga qaramay, u kamtarlik qilib raqibining paypog‘ini maqtadi.

words.example: The responsible teenager watered the plants before watering his brother.
words.translation: Mas’uliyatli o‘smir ukasiga suv sepishdan oldin gullarni sug‘ordi.

words.example: Be considerate and practise your trumpet after breakfast.
words.translation: Boshqalarni ham o‘ylab, karnayni nonushtadan keyin mashq qil.

words.example: I'm optimistic: perhaps the burnt toast will taste better with jam.
words.translation: Yaxshilikka umid qilaman: balki kuygan non murabbo bilan mazaliroq bo‘lar.

words.example: His sincere apology included a replacement for my broken mug.
words.translation: U samimiy uzr so‘rab, singan krujkam o‘rniga yangisini ham berdi.

words.example: Our warm-hearted neighbour brings soup whenever anyone sneezes.
words.translation: Mehribon qo‘shnimiz kimdir aksirsa bas, sho‘rva olib keladi.

words.example: My easy-going flatmate doesn't mind my collection of unusual mugs.
words.translation: Chiqishimli xonadoshim g‘alati krujkalar to‘plamimga qarshi emas.

words.example: She remained calm while everyone searched for the missing birthday cake.
words.translation: Hamma yo‘qolgan tug‘ilgan kun tortini izlayotganda u xotirjam qoldi.

words.example: My caring brother made soup and only asked for one medal.
words.translation: G‘amxo‘r akam sho‘rva tayyorlab, atigi bitta medal so‘radi.

words.example: A fair referee cannot give extra points to his favourite nephew.
words.translation: Adolatli hakam sevimli jiyaniga qo‘shimcha ochko bera olmaydi.

words.example: My level-headed aunt switched off the oven before discussing the smoke.
words.translation: Vazmin xolam tutunni muhokama qilishdan oldin pechni o‘chirdi.

words.example: The curious child wanted to know whether dentists fear sweets.
words.translation: Qiziquvchan bola tish shifokorlari shirinlikdan qo‘rqadimi, bilmoqchi edi.

words.example: She's self-reliant and can even assemble furniture without phoning Dad.
words.translation: U o‘ziga tayanadi, hatto dadamga qo‘ng‘iroq qilmasdan mebel yig‘a oladi.

words.example: Our sociable uncle made friends while waiting for the lift.
words.translation: Odamlar bilan tez chiqishadigan amakimiz lift kutayotib do‘st orttirdi.

words.example: Taking the last six biscuits was rather selfish.
words.translation: Oxirgi oltita pechenyeni olish ancha xudbinlik edi.

words.example: My stubborn brother insisted the map was upside down, not us.
words.translation: Qaysar akam biz adashmadik, xarita teskari deb turib oldi.

words.example: It is rude to yawn loudly during someone's wedding speech.
words.translation: Birovning to‘ydagi nutqi paytida ovoz chiqarib esnash odobsizlikdir.

words.example: I felt lazy enough to call my brother in the next room.
words.translation: Shunchalik dangasalik tutdiki, qo‘shni xonadagi ukamga telefon qildim.

words.example: He was jealous of the attention our new puppy received.
words.translation: U yangi kuchukchamizga ko‘rsatilayotgan e’tiborga hasad qildi.

words.example: The greedy guest asked whether the cake stand was edible too.
words.translation: Ochko‘z mehmon tort tagligini ham yesa bo‘ladimi deb so‘radi.

words.example: My bossy cousin even tells the kettle when to boil.
words.translation: Buyruq beraveradigan amakivachcham hatto choynakka ham qachon qaynashni aytadi.

words.example: The impatient man pressed the lift button twelve times.
words.translation: Sabrsiz odam lift tugmasini o‘n ikki marta bosdi.

words.example: He sounded arrogant when he called himself the king of sandwiches.
words.translation: O‘zini sendvichlar qiroli deb ataganida, u kibrli eshitildi.

words.example: I felt self-conscious in my new hat until everyone tried it on.
words.translation: Hamma yangi shlyapamni kiyib ko‘rmaguncha, unda o‘zimni noqulay his qildim.

words.example: Our shy cousin introduced himself to the curtains first.
words.translation: Uyatchan amakivachchamiz avval o‘zini pardalarga tanishtirdi.

words.example: A careless reply sent our dinner plans to the whole office.
words.translation: E’tiyotsizlik bilan yuborilgan javob kechki ovqat rejamizni butun ofisga tarqatdi.

words.example: My moody flatmate may offer tea or a long silence.
words.translation: Kayfiyati tez o‘zgaradigan xonadoshim choy taklif qilishi ham, uzoq jim qolishi ham mumkin.

words.example: He's sensitive about his cooking, so don't call the soup wallpaper glue.
words.translation: U taomlari haqida gap ketsa tez ranjiydi, shuning uchun sho‘rvani gulqog‘oz yelimi dema.

words.example: Our strict coach allows jokes, but only after ten press-ups.
words.translation: Qattiqqo‘l murabbiyimiz hazilga ruxsat beradi, ammo avval o‘n marta qo‘lda tayanib turish kerak.

words.example: It was mean of him to charge his sister for one biscuit.
words.translation: Singlisidan bitta pechenye uchun pul olish uning baxilligini ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: His immature response was to hide my slippers.
words.translation: Uning bolalarcha javobi shippagimni yashirish bo‘ldi.

words.example: My pessimistic uncle packs two umbrellas for an indoor party.
words.translation: Har narsaning yomon tomonini kutadigan amakim bino ichidagi bazmga ikkita soyabon oladi.

words.example: Calling a broken chair a rocking chair is dishonest.
words.translation: Singan stulni tebranadigan kursi deb atash insofsizlikdir.

words.example: Our childish argument ended when Mum took away both remote controls.
words.translation: Bachkana tortishuvimiz oyim ikkala pultni olib qo‘yganda tugadi.

words.example: My nosy neighbour knows my visitors before I do.
words.translation: Birovning ishiga burnini suqadigan qo‘shnim mehmonlarimni mendan oldin biladi.

words.example: She's fussy about tea and interviews every new teapot.
words.translation: U choy masalasida injiq, har bir yangi choynakni go‘yo suhbatdan o‘tkazadi.

words.example: I'm too clumsy to carry soup while answering the phone.
words.translation: Telefonga javob berib sho‘rva ko‘tarish uchun haddan tashqari beso‘naqayman.

words.example: My forgetful grandad wrote a reminder to read his reminders.
words.translation: Unutuvchan bobom eslatmalarini o‘qish uchun eslatma yozdi.

words.example: Our competitive aunt turns washing up into a race.
words.translation: Bellashishni yaxshi ko‘radigan xolamiz idish yuvishni musobaqaga aylantiradi.

words.example: I was pleased with my haircut until the wind redesigned it.
words.translation: Shamol sochimni qayta bezaguncha, yangi turmagimdan mamnun edim.

words.example: Grandma was delighted when we finally understood her phone joke.
words.translation: Telefon haqidagi hazilini nihoyat tushunganimizda buvim juda xursand bo‘ldi.

words.example: I felt relieved when the strange noise turned out to be Dad snoring.
words.translation: G‘alati tovush dadamning xurragi ekanini bilib yengil tortdim.

words.example: She was proud of her first loaf, even though it looked like a shoe.
words.translation: Birinchi noni tufliga o‘xshasa ham, u undan faxrlandi.

words.example: We were grateful to the guest who rescued dinner with pizza.
words.translation: Pitsa olib kelib kechki ovqatni qutqargan mehmondan minnatdor edik.

words.example: The children were excited about camping in the living room.
words.translation: Bolalar mehmonxonada chodir tikib tunashdan zavqlanishdi.

words.example: I'm hopeful that my next cake will need a knife, not a hammer.
words.translation: Keyingi tortimga bolg‘a emas, pichoq kerak bo‘lishidan umidvorman.

words.example: With warm socks and a book, she felt completely content.
words.translation: Issiq paypoq va kitob bilan u o‘zini butunlay mamnun his qildi.

words.example: Dad looked relaxed until the puppy stole his newspaper.
words.translation: Kuchukcha gazetasini olib qochguncha dadam xotirjam ko‘rinardi.

words.example: The receptionist looked amused by my attempt to push a pull door.
words.translation: Tortiladigan eshikni itarishga uringanimni ko‘rib qabulxonadagi xodimaning kulgisi keldi.

words.example: He's enthusiastic about jogging, especially the breakfast afterwards.
words.translation: U yugurishga, ayniqsa undan keyingi nonushtaga juda ishtiyoqli.

words.example: I felt comfortable with the group after someone else spilled tea.
words.translation: Yana kimdir choy to‘kib yuborgach, guruh ichida o‘zimni erkin his qildim.

words.example: The cat seemed satisfied with my apology and new cushion.
words.translation: Mushuk uzrim va yangi yostiqdan qoniqqanday ko‘rindi.

words.example: Finding a forgotten biscuit brought me unexpected joy.
words.translation: Unutilgan pechenyeni topish menga kutilmagan quvonch berdi.

words.example: It was a pleasure to hear my alarm on my day off and ignore it.
words.translation: Dam olish kunim budilnikni eshitib, unga e’tibor bermaslik zavqli edi.

words.example: What a relief to discover the exam was tomorrow, not today!
words.translation: Imtihon bugun emas, ertaga ekanini bilish naqadar yengillik!

words.example: Finding money in an old coat brought a minute of pure happiness.
words.translation: Eski paltodan pul topish bir daqiqalik sof baxt keltirdi.

words.example: In his excitement, he put his party hat on the dog.
words.translation: U hayajondan bayram qalpog‘ini itga kiydirib qo‘ydi.

words.example: Dad showed us his repaired shelf with obvious pride.
words.translation: Dadam tuzatgan tokchasini yaqqol faxr bilan ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: My uncle shows affection by giving everyone enormous sandwiches.
words.translation: Amakim hammaga ulkan sendvich berib mehrini ko‘rsatadi.

words.example: The house felt peaceful until someone found the karaoke machine.
words.translation: Kimdir karaoke qurilmasini topguncha uy osoyishta edi.
