words.example: She cheered up when her brother arrived wearing two different shoes.
words.translation: Akasi ikki xil tufli kiyib kelganida uning kayfiyati ko‘tarildi.

words.example: I look forward to Sundays because my alarm gets a holiday.
words.translation: Yakshanbani intizorlik bilan kutaman, chunki budilnigim dam oladi.

words.example: We enjoy talking about exercise over a large cake.
words.translation: Katta tort yeb, jismoniy mashqlar haqida suhbatlashishdan zavqlanamiz.

words.example: I admire anyone who can fold a fitted sheet neatly.
words.translation: Rezinkali choyshabni chiroyli taxlay oladigan har kimga qoyil qolaman.

words.example: I felt anxious when the dentist said my name twice.
words.translation: Tish shifokori ismimni ikki marta aytganda xavotirlandim.

words.example: Mum was worried because even the dog refused my biscuits.
words.translation: Hatto it ham pechenyelarimni yemagani uchun oyim tashvishlandi.

words.example: He was upset when his balloon left the party early.
words.translation: Shari bazmdan erta uchib ketganida u xafa bo‘ldi.

words.example: I was disappointed to find sewing needles in the biscuit tin.
words.translation: Pechenye qutisidan tikuv ignalari chiqib, hafsalam pir bo‘ldi.

words.example: She felt embarrassed after waving at her own reflection.
words.translation: O‘z aksiga qo‘l silkitganidan keyin u xijolat bo‘ldi.

words.example: I felt ashamed for blaming my brother when I had eaten the cake.
words.translation: Tortni o‘zim yeb, ukamni ayblaganimdan uyaldim.

words.example: He felt guilty about laughing at his friend's serious poem.
words.translation: Do‘stining jiddiy she’riga kulgani uchun u o‘zini aybdor his qildi.

words.example: Feeling lonely, I invited a friend and accidentally invited his whole family.
words.translation: Yolg‘izlikni his qilib, do‘stimni chaqirdim va bilmasdan uning butun oilasini ham taklif qilibman.

words.example: Before my speech, I was nervous enough to introduce myself to the microphone.
words.translation: Nutqimdan oldin shunchalik hayajonlandimki, o‘zimni mikrofonga tanishtirdim.

words.example: I grew frustrated when the password hint said 'your password'.
words.translation: Parol eslatmasida «parolingiz» deb yozilganda asabiylashdim.

words.example: She was annoyed that my phone alarm interrupted her dream holiday.
words.translation: Telefonim budilnigi tushidagi ta’tilni buzganidan uning jahli chiqdi.

words.example: Dad was furious when someone used his passport as a shopping list.
words.translation: Kimdir pasportiga xarid ro‘yxatini yozganida dadam juda g‘azablandi.

words.example: I was terrified until the shadow turned out to be a coat.
words.translation: Soya paltoniki ekanini bilguncha dahshatga tushdim.

words.example: Wet shoes made me miserable all afternoon.
words.translation: Ho‘l tufli tufayli tushdan keyin rosa dilgir bo‘ldim.

words.example: I felt homesick when nobody argued about who made the best tea.
words.translation: Kim eng yaxshi choy damlashi haqida hech kim tortishmaganda uyimni sog‘indim.

words.example: The twins looked confused when I wished only one of them a happy birthday.
words.translation: Faqat bittasini tug‘ilgan kuni bilan tabriklaganimda egizaklar gangib qolishdi.

words.example: We were shocked when our quiet uncle started singing opera.
words.translation: Kamgap amakimiz opera kuylay boshlaganda lol qoldik.

words.example: I had a doubt about his story when the fish became bigger than the boat.
words.translation: Baliq qayiqdan kattalashib ketgan joyida uning hikoyasiga shubham tug‘ildi.

words.example: Her fear of spiders includes the plastic ones on my desk.
words.translation: U stolimdagi plastik o‘rgimchaklardan ham qo‘rqadi.

words.example: His anger disappeared when the missing sandwich fell out of his bag.
words.translation: Yo‘qolgan sendvich sumkasidan tushib ketgach, uning g‘azabi tarqaldi.

words.example: Don't worry about the noise; Dad is learning the flute.
words.translation: Shovqindan tashvishlanma; dadam nay chalishni o‘rganyapti.

words.example: I regret teaching my little brother how to whistle.
words.translation: Ukamga hushtak chalishni o‘rgatganimdan afsuslanaman.

words.example: Packing for a holiday causes more stress than my holidays remove.
words.translation: Ta’tilga yuk yig‘ish ta’tilim ketkazadiganidan ko‘proq ruhiy zo‘riqish tug‘diradi.

words.example: He calmed down once we explained that the tattoo was a sticker.
words.translation: Tatuirovka yopishtirma ekanini tushuntirganimizdan keyin u tinchlandi.

words.example: The little boy burst into tears when his ice cream fell off the cone.
words.translation: Muzqaymog‘i vafli karnaychasidan tushib ketganda bolakay birdan yig‘lab yubordi.

words.example: Our friendship survived a holiday and one very small tent.
words.translation: Do‘stligimiz ta’til va juda kichik bitta chodir sinovidan o‘tdi.

words.example: My walking companion stops at every bench to rest.
words.translation: Sayrdagi hamrohim dam olish uchun har bir skameyka yonida to‘xtaydi.

words.example: A stranger waved at me, so I checked whether I was wearing his coat.
words.translation: Notanish kishi menga qo‘l silkitdi, men esa uning paltosini kiyib olmaganmidim deb tekshirdim.

words.example: An acquaintance greeted me warmly, but I couldn't remember his name.
words.translation: Bir tanishim iliq salomlashdi, lekin ismini eslay olmadim.

words.example: My flatmate labels his cheese as if it might escape.
words.translation: Ijaradoshim pishlog‘iga go‘yo qochib ketadigandek yorliq yopishtiradi.

words.example: My roommate talks in his sleep, but never answers my questions.
words.translation: Xonadoshim uyqusida gapiradi, ammo savollarimga hech javob bermaydi.

words.example: My son's playmate arrived with plans to turn the garden into a zoo.
words.translation: O‘g‘limning o‘yin do‘sti bog‘ni hayvonot bog‘iga aylantirish rejalari bilan keldi.

words.example: An old schoolmate recognised my laugh before recognising my face.
words.translation: Eski maktabdoshim yuzimdan oldin kulgimni tanidi.

words.example: My mate arrived to help and immediately asked about snacks.
words.translation: O‘rtog‘im yordam berishga kelib, darrov yeguliklarni so‘radi.

words.example: The newcomer soon learned which chair belonged to Grandma.
words.translation: Yangi kelgan kishi qaysi kursi buvimniki ekanini tezda bilib oldi.

words.example: Her circle of friends includes three people who all claim to make the best tea.
words.translation: Uning do‘stlar davrasida eng yaxshi choyni men damlayman deydigan uch kishi bor.

words.example: Let me introduce my cousin before he introduces his six cats.
words.translation: Amakivachcham oltita mushugini tanishtirishidan oldin, uni tanishtiray.

words.example: She greeted every visitor with a smile and a huge biscuit.
words.translation: U har bir mehmonni tabassum va katta pechenye bilan kutib oldi.

words.example: We invited six people, but twelve arrived with good explanations.
words.translation: Oltita odamni taklif qildik, ammo o‘n ikkitasi asosli izohlar bilan keldi.

words.example: She befriended the quiet newcomer by offering half her sandwich.
words.translation: U sendvichining yarmini taklif qilib, kamgap yangi kelgan bilan do‘st tutindi.

words.example: We socialise over tea and pretend not to count the biscuits.
words.translation: Choy ustida muloqot qilib, pechenyelarni sanamayotgandek bo‘lamiz.

words.example: I trust her with my secrets, but not my last chocolate.
words.translation: Sirlarimni unga ishonaman, ammo oxirgi shokoladimni emas.

words.example: Their closeness grew during long walks and arguments about silly films.
words.translation: Uzoq sayrlar va kulgili filmlar haqidagi bahslar ularning yaqinligini oshirdi.

words.example: We get along because neither of us likes washing dishes.
words.translation: Ikkalamiz ham idish yuvishni yoqtirmaganimiz uchun chiqishamiz.

words.example: We hang out at her flat and spend an hour choosing a film.
words.translation: Uning uyida birga vaqt o‘tkazib, bir soat film tanlaymiz.

words.example: We keep in touch by sending photos of our cooking disasters.
words.translation: Pishirishdagi muvaffaqiyatsizliklarimiz suratlarini yuborib aloqani saqlaymiz.

words.example: We get together every Friday to discuss everything except our unfinished chores.
words.translation: Har juma tugamagan yumushlarimizdan boshqa hamma narsani muhokama qilish uchun yig‘ilamiz.

words.example: At our school reunion, everyone still blamed the same boy for the broken window.
words.translation: Maktabdoshlar uchrashuvida hamma hamon singan deraza uchun o‘sha bolani aybladi.

words.example: A shared dislike of early mornings created a bond between us.
words.translation: Erta tongni birdek yoqtirmasligimiz oramizda yaqin rishta yaratdi.

words.example: He became popular after learning everyone's tea preferences.
words.translation: Hammaning choy borasidagi didini bilib olgach, uni ko‘pchilik yoqtira boshladi.

words.example: Their relationship improved when they bought a second blanket.
words.translation: Ikkinchi ko‘rpani sotib olishgach, ularning munosabati yaxshilandi.

words.example: Each guest could bring a spouse, but Uncle also brought his guitar.
words.translation: Har bir mehmon turmush o‘rtog‘ini olib kelishi mumkin edi, ammo amakim gitarasini ham olib keldi.

words.example: The couple disagreed about everything except dessert.
words.translation: Juftlik shirinlikdan boshqa hamma masalada kelisha olmadi.

words.example: Her boyfriend brought flowers and a bag to carry the shopping.
words.translation: Uning sevgilisi gul va xaridlarni tashish uchun sumka olib keldi.

words.example: My girlfriend knows I am nervous when I start discussing the weather.
words.translation: Ob-havo haqida gapira boshlasam, sevgilim hayajonlanayotganimni biladi.

words.example: Our romantic dinner included candles because we forgot to pay for electricity.
words.translation: Romantik kechki ovqatimiz sham yorug‘ida bo‘ldi, chunki elektr haqini to‘lashni unutgan edik.

words.example: Their marriage has lasted longer than any of their washing machines.
words.translation: Ularning nikohi kir yuvish mashinalarining har biridan ham uzoq yashadi.

words.example: At the wedding, my little cousin caught the flowers and asked for cake instead.
words.translation: To‘yda kichik amakivachcham gullarni ilib olib, o‘rniga tort so‘radi.

words.example: The bride wore trainers under her dress for serious dancing.
words.translation: Kelin yaxshilab raqs tushish uchun ko‘ylagi ostidan krossovka kiygan edi.

words.example: The groom checked his pocket for the ring every thirty seconds.
words.translation: Kuyov har o‘ttiz soniyada uzukni tekshirib cho‘ntagini paypasladi.

words.example: They got engaged after agreeing that neither could cook.
words.translation: Ikkalasi ham ovqat pishira olmasligiga kelishib, ular unashtirildi.

words.example: He planned to propose, but the waiter nearly served the ring with dessert.
words.translation: U turmush qurishni taklif qilmoqchi edi, ammo ofitsiant uzukni deyarli shirinlik bilan tortib yubordi.

words.example: She wants to marry someone who can find things in the fridge.
words.translation: U muzlatkichdan narsalarni topa oladigan odamga turmushga chiqmoqchi.

words.example: After the divorce, they remained friends and shared care of the dog.
words.translation: Ajrashgandan keyin ular do‘st bo‘lib qolib, itga birgalikda qarashdi.

words.example: They split up last year but still send each other birthday cards.
words.translation: Ular o‘tgan yili ayrilishdi, ammo hamon bir-biriga tug‘ilgan kun tabriknomalarini yuborishadi.

words.example: A relative I barely knew recognised my laugh immediately.
words.translation: O‘zim zo‘rg‘a taniydigan bir qarindoshim kulgimni darrov tanidi.

words.example: Having a sibling means someone remembers all your embarrassing hairstyles.
words.translation: Aka-uka yoki opa-singling bo‘lsa, kimdir barcha kulgili soch turmaklaringni eslab yuradi.

words.example: My twin borrowed my jacket and then complained that we looked alike.
words.translation: Egizagim kurtkamni olib kiyib, keyin bir xil ko‘rinishimizdan shikoyat qildi.

words.example: My niece gave me a drawing of myself with twelve fingers.
words.translation: Jiyanim menga o‘n ikki barmoqli qilib chizgan rasmimni berdi.

words.example: My nephew thinks my beard is a useful place to hide pencils.
words.translation: Jiyanim soqolimni qalam yashirishga qulay joy deb o‘ylaydi.

words.example: My mother-in-law kindly taught me how to rescue burnt rice.
words.translation: Qaynonam kuygan guruchni qanday qutqarishni mehr bilan o‘rgatdi.

words.example: My father-in-law brings his own tools even when invited only for tea.
words.translation: Qaynotam faqat choyga taklif qilinganda ham asboblarini olib keladi.

words.example: For our anniversary, we returned to the café where I spilled my first coffee.
words.translation: Yillik sanamizda men birinchi qahvani to‘kkan kafega qaytdik.

words.example: They broke up but agreed that the dog could visit both homes.
words.translation: Ular munosabatini tugatishdi, ammo it ikkala uyga ham borib turishiga kelishishdi.

words.example: They fell in love while arguing about the last library chair.
words.translation: Ular kutubxonadagi oxirgi bo‘sh stul ustida tortishib turib bir-birini sevib qolishdi.

words.example: We argued about the route while the dog walked home without us.
words.translation: Yo‘l ustida tortishayotganimizda it bizsiz uyga ketdi.

words.example: Our argument about dinner ended when the power went off.
words.translation: Kechki ovqat haqidagi tortishuvimiz elektr o‘chganda tugadi.

words.example: I disagree with anyone who calls one biscuit a proper snack.
words.translation: Bitta pechenyeni yetarli yegulik deydigan odamning fikriga qo‘shilmayman.

words.example: A quarrel over a borrowed jumper lasted longer than winter.
words.translation: Olib turilgan jemper ustidagi janjal qishdan ham uzoq davom etdi.

words.example: The conflict between the neighbours began with a very loud rooster.
words.translation: Qo‘shnilar orasidagi ziddiyat juda baland qichqiradigan xo‘rozdan boshlandi.

words.example: He complained about the music while tapping his foot to it.
words.translation: U oyog‘i bilan kuyga jo‘r bo‘lib turib, musiqadan shikoyat qildi.

words.example: My only complaint was that the free cake had disappeared too quickly.
words.translation: Yagona shikoyatim bepul tort juda tez tugab qolgani edi.

words.example: Don't blame the dog; he can't reach the biscuit cupboard.
words.translation: Itni ayblama; uning bo‘yi pechenye javoniga yetmaydi.

words.example: She accused me of hiding the remote, which was under her own cushion.
words.translation: U pultni yashirganlikda meni aybladi, holbuki pult o‘z yostig‘i tagida edi.

words.example: He denied eating chocolate despite the evidence on his chin.
words.translation: Iyakdagi dalilga qaramay, u shokolad yeganini inkor etdi.

words.example: You can criticise my singing after you hear my brother's.
words.translation: Akamning kuylashini eshitganingdan keyin menikini tanqid qilishing mumkin.

words.example: Don't insult his hat; he knitted it during a very long winter.
words.translation: Uning shlyapasini haqorat qilma; uni juda uzun qishda to‘qigan.

words.example: I didn't mean to offend her when I called her serious painting cheerful.
words.translation: Uning jiddiy suratini quvnoq deb ataganimda uni ranjitmoqchi emasdim.

words.example: Please don't interrupt unless the kettle is actually on fire.
words.translation: Choynak rostdan yonmayotgan bo‘lsa, iltimos, gapimni bo‘lma.

words.example: She ignored my advice and successfully repaired the chair.
words.translation: U maslahatimni e’tiborsiz qoldirib, stulni muvaffaqiyatli tuzatdi.

words.example: Dad threatened to sing if we didn't get out of bed.
words.translation: O‘rnimizdan turmasak, dadam qo‘shiq aytishini aytib do‘q qildi.

words.example: There is no need to shout; your microphone is already on.
words.translation: Baqirish shart emas; mikrofoningiz allaqachon yoqilgan.

words.example: I screamed when a cold spoon touched my neck.
words.translation: Bo‘ynimga sovuq qoshiq tekkanda chinqirib yubordim.

words.example: My cousins tease me about the time I got lost in our own garden.
words.translation: Amakivachchalarim o‘z bog‘imizda adashganimni eslatib meni mazax qilishadi.

words.example: Office gossip travels faster than the lift.
words.translation: Ofisdagi g‘iybat liftdan tezroq tarqaladi.

words.example: A rumour that the boss was leaving turned out to mean he was going to lunch.
words.translation: Boshliq ketayotgani haqidagi mish-mish uning tushlikka chiqishini anglatgan ekan.

words.example: His lie about finishing the washing up was exposed by the mountain of plates.
words.translation: Idishlarni yuvib bo‘lgani haqidagi yolg‘onini tog‘day uyilgan likopchalar fosh qildi.

words.example: I misunderstood 'bring something light' and arrived with a lamp.
words.translation: «Yengil narsa olib kel» degan gapni noto‘g‘ri tushunib, chiroq olib keldim.

words.example: Reading jokes during her speech was disrespectful.
words.translation: Uning nutqi paytida latifalar o‘qish hurmatsizlik edi.

words.example: The brothers fell out over who had to wash the enormous pan.
words.translation: Ulkan tovani kim yuvishi masalasida aka-uka arazlashib qolishdi.

words.example: I apologised for the noise before revealing my new drum kit.
words.translation: Yangi barabanlarimni ko‘rsatishdan oldin shovqin uchun uzr so‘radim.

words.example: His apology was longer than the speech he had interrupted.
words.translation: Uning uzri o‘zi gapini bo‘lgan odamning nutqidan ham uzun edi.

words.example: She forgave me for shrinking her jumper, but the teddy bear kept it.
words.translation: U jemperini kichraytirib qo‘yganimni kechirdi, lekin jemper ayiqchada qoldi.

words.example: Excuse me, I think you are wearing my coat and holding your own.
words.translation: Kechirasiz, menimcha, mening paltomni kiyib, o‘zingiznikini ushlab turibsiz.

words.example: We made up after discovering that neither of us had eaten the missing cake.
words.translation: Yo‘qolgan tortni ikkalamiz ham yemaganimizni bilib yarashdik.

words.example: We compromised and watched half a film before going for a walk.
words.translation: O‘zaro yon berib, sayrga chiqishdan oldin filmning yarmini ko‘rdik.

words.example: I value your honesty, even when it concerns my terrible haircut.
words.translation: Hatto yomon soch turmagim haqida bo‘lsa ham, rostgo‘yligingni qadrlayman.

words.example: My sister backed me up when I said the dog had opened the cupboard.
words.translation: Javonni it ochganini aytganimda singlim gapimni qo‘lladi.

words.example: Her praise motivated me to cook again, despite the first burnt pie.
words.translation: Uning maqtovi birinchi pirog kuyganiga qaramay, yana pishirishga ruhlantirdi.

words.example: I comforted my niece after her snowman lost its head.
words.translation: Qor odamining boshi tushib ketgach, jiyanimni ovutdim.

words.example: The dentist reassured me that the loud drill was next door.
words.translation: Tish shifokori baland parma ovozi qo‘shni xonadan kelayotganini aytib meni xotirjam qildi.

words.example: I had sympathy for him after the puppy ate his homework for real.
words.translation: Kuchukcha uy vazifasini rostdan yegach, men unga hamdard bo‘ldim.

words.example: She showed understanding when I arrived wearing two different shoes.
words.translation: Ikki xil tuflida kelganimda u holatimni tushunib munosabat bildirdi.

words.example: Her kindness included pretending my first cake was delicious.
words.translation: Uning mehribonligi birinchi tortimni mazali deb ko‘rsatishida ham namoyon bo‘ldi.

words.example: He hugged his brother carefully because they were both holding ice cream.
words.translation: Ikkalasi ham muzqaymoq ushlab turgani uchun u ukasini ehtiyotkorlik bilan quchoqladi.

words.example: Mum praised my clean room before opening the cupboard.
words.translation: Oyim javonni ochishidan oldin toza xonamni maqtadi.

words.example: Her compliment about my hat made me wear it all week.
words.translation: Shlyapam haqidagi iltifoti sabab uni hafta bo‘yi kiyib yurdim.

words.example: I appreciate your help, especially the part where you brought biscuits.
words.translation: Yordamingizni, ayniqsa pechenye olib kelganingizni qadrlayman.

words.example: He accepted my apology and the slightly damaged replacement cake.
words.translation: U uzrimni va o‘rniga olib kelgan sal shikastlangan tortni qabul qildi.

words.meaning: bir yoqadan bosh chiqarib harakat qilmoq
words.example: We pulled together to clean the flat before Mum arrived.
words.translation: Oyim kelmasidan uyni tozalash uchun bir yoqadan bosh chiqardik.

words.example: He defended his little sister when the older children laughed at her drawing.
words.translation: Katta bolalar singlisining rasmiga kulganda u singlisini himoya qildi.

words.example: I looked after my nephew, who gave me a list of his rules.
words.translation: Jiyanimga qaradim, u esa menga o‘z qoidalari ro‘yxatini berdi.

words.example: My friends stood by me after my terrible performance in the school play.
words.translation: Maktab spektaklida yomon o‘ynaganimdan keyin do‘stlarim yonimda turishdi.

words.example: I let my sister down by forgetting her concert, so I apologised.
words.translation: Konsertini unutib singlimning ishonchini oqlamadim, shuning uchun uzr so‘radim.

words.example: We cheered on our grandad as he finished his first fun run.
words.translation: Bobomiz ilk havaskorlar yugurishini tugatayotganida uni olqishlab ruhlantirdik.

words.example: My only symptom was a cough, but Dad brought three blankets.
words.translation: Yagona alomatim yo‘tal edi, ammo dadam uchta ko‘rpa olib keldi.

words.example: His fever kept him in bed, where he became the family TV expert.
words.translation: Isitmasi uni yotoqda ushlab turdi va u oilaning televizor mutaxassisiga aylandi.

words.example: My cough interrupted the film at all the quiet moments.
words.translation: Yo‘talim filmning barcha sokin joylarini buzdi.

words.example: I sneezed just as the photographer said 'perfect'.
words.translation: Suratkash «ajoyib» degan zahoti aksirdim.

words.example: I had a headache, so my brother practised his trumpet somewhere else.
words.translation: Boshim og‘rigani uchun ukam karnayni boshqa joyda mashq qildi.

words.example: A stomachache made me regret the third piece of cake.
words.translation: Qorin og‘rig‘i uchinchi bo‘lak tortni yeganimdan afsuslantirdi.

words.example: My toothache finally persuaded me to call the dentist.
words.translation: Tish og‘rig‘im nihoyat meni tish shifokoriga qo‘ng‘iroq qilishga undadi.

words.example: After moving the sofa, we shared both tea and backache.
words.translation: Divanni ko‘chirgandan keyin choy ham, bel og‘rig‘i ham hammamizga nasib etdi.

words.example: My throat is sore, so my terrible singing is cancelled today.
words.translation: Tomog‘im achishib og‘riyapti, shuning uchun bugun yomon qo‘shiqlarim bekor.

words.example: I felt dizzy after spinning round to show off my new coat.
words.translation: Yangi paltomni ko‘z-ko‘z qilib aylangach, boshim aylandi.

words.example: The smell of the old milk made me feel sick.
words.translation: Eski sutning hidi ko‘nglimni aynitdi.

words.example: He looked pale, so we asked him to sit down.
words.translation: Rangi oqarib ketgani uchun undan o‘tirishni so‘radik.

words.example: My swollen ankle would not fit into my favourite shoe.
words.translation: Shishgan to‘pig‘im sevimli tuflimga sig‘madi.

words.example: The rash on my arm made me stop trying that new soap.
words.translation: Qo‘limdagi toshma yangi sovunni ishlatishni to‘xtatishimga sabab bo‘ldi.

words.example: My nose always seems to itch when both hands are covered in flour.
words.translation: Ikkala qo‘lim unga belanganida burnim doim qichishadigandek tuyuladi.

words.example: The pain in my foot explained why I was walking like a penguin.
words.translation: Oyog‘imdagi og‘riq nega pingvindek yurayotganimni tushuntirdi.

words.example: My shoulders ache after carrying all those picnic bags.
words.translation: Barcha sayr sumkalarini ko‘targanimdan keyin yelkalarim simillab og‘riyapti.

words.example: I was breathless after climbing the stairs with a giant teddy bear.
words.translation: Ulkan ayiqchani ko‘tarib zinadan chiqqach, nafasim qisildi.

words.example: We shivered outside while Dad searched every pocket for the key.
words.translation: Dadam kalitni barcha cho‘ntaklaridan qidirayotganda tashqarida titrab turdik.

words.example: I sweat when I dance, even if the dance lasts one minute.
words.translation: Raqs atigi bir daqiqa davom etsa ham terlayman.

words.example: The flu ruined his weekend plans but improved his knowledge of daytime TV.
words.translation: Gripp uning dam olish rejalarini buzdi, ammo kunduzgi ko‘rsatuvlar haqidagi bilimini oshirdi.

words.example: The doctor checked my ear for an infection while I tried to sit still.
words.translation: Men qimirlamay o‘tirishga urinayotganimda shifokor qulog‘imni infeksiyaga tekshirdi.

words.example: My allergy to cats makes visiting my aunt a very sneezy experience.
words.translation: Mushuklarga allergiyam tufayli xolamnikida ko‘p aksiraman.

words.example: We were exhausted after entertaining five children and one energetic grandmother.
words.translation: Beshta bola va bitta serg‘ayrat buvining ko‘nglini olgach, holdan toydik.

words.example: She felt unwell and left the party before the embarrassing games began.
words.translation: Tobi yo‘qligi uchun u noqulay o‘yinlar boshlanishidan oldin bazmdan ketdi.

words.example: His knee injury came from dancing, although he preferred to say sport.
words.translation: U sportdan deb aytishni ma’qul ko‘rsa-da, tizzasidagi jarohat raqsdan edi.

words.example: This bruise is a souvenir from the coffee table.
words.translation: Bu ko‘kargan joy jurnal stolchasidan esdalik.

words.example: The scratch on my arm came from a rose, not an angry tiger.
words.translation: Qo‘limdagi tirnalgan joy g‘azabli yo‘lbarsdan emas, atirguldan edi.

words.example: My new shoes gave me a blister and a reason to sit down.
words.translation: Yangi tuflilarim oyog‘imni qavartirib, o‘tirish uchun sabab berdi.

words.example: The nurse cleaned the wound while I stared bravely at the ceiling.
words.translation: Hamshira yarani tozalayotganda shiftga jasurlarcha tikildim.

words.example: He sprained his ankle while celebrating a goal he hadn't scored.
words.translation: U o‘zi urmagan golni nishonlayotib to‘pig‘ining payini cho‘zib oldi.

words.example: The X-ray showed a fracture, ending my plans to dance that evening.
words.translation: Rentgen suyak singanini ko‘rsatib, o‘sha kechki raqs rejalarimni bekor qildi.

words.example: My finger started to bleed after an argument with a sharp envelope.
words.translation: O‘tkir konvert bilan «tortishuvdan» keyin barmog‘im qonay boshladi.

words.example: My feet hurt after I wore stylish shoes to a long wedding.
words.translation: Uzoq davom etgan to‘yga zamonaviy tufli kiyganimdan keyin oyoqlarim og‘ridi.

words.example: I slipped on a wet floor but managed to save my sandwich.
words.translation: Ho‘l polda sirpandim, ammo sendvichimni saqlab qoldim.

words.example: I stumbled over my own bag while warning everyone to be careful.
words.translation: Hammaga ehtiyot bo‘lishni aytayotib o‘z sumkamga qoqildim.

words.example: He nearly fainted at the sight of blood, even in a cartoon.
words.translation: U hatto multfilmda qon ko‘rib ham hushidan ketay dedi.

words.example: After the fall, she was conscious and asking where her glasses were.
words.translation: Yiqilganidan keyin uning hushi joyida edi va ko‘zoynagini so‘rayotgandi.

words.example: The man was unconscious, so someone immediately called an ambulance.
words.translation: Erkak hushsiz edi, shuning uchun kimdir darrov tez yordam chaqirdi.

words.example: They carried the injured player on a stretcher while he waved to his mum.
words.translation: Jarohatlangan o‘yinchini zambilda olib ketishayotganda u onasiga qo‘l silkitdi.

words.example: In an emergency, clear information matters more than a long story.
words.translation: Shoshilinch vaziyatda uzun hikoyadan ko‘ra aniq ma’lumot muhimroq.

words.example: The bandage on my hand made washing dishes difficult, which my brother doubted.
words.translation: Qo‘limdagi bog‘lam idish yuvishni qiyinlashtirdi, akam esa bunga shubhalandi.

words.example: My niece chose a plaster with dinosaurs for her tiny cut.
words.translation: Jiyanim kichik kesigiga dinozavrli yopishqoq tasma tanladi.

words.example: This scar comes from a bicycle accident, not a battle with a shark.
words.translation: Bu chandiq akula bilan jangdan emas, velosiped halokatidan qolgan.

words.example: A mosquito chose my ankle from all the people at the picnic.
words.translation: Chivin sayrdagi barcha odamlar ichidan mening to‘pig‘imni tanladi.

words.example: The bracelet was too big for my wrist but perfect for the teddy bear.
words.translation: Bilaguzuk bilagimga katta, ayiqchaga esa juda mos edi.

words.example: My elbow knocked over the salt during an enthusiastic story.
words.translation: Hayajon bilan hikoya qilayotib tirsagim bilan tuzni ag‘dardim.

words.example: The doctor listened to my chest with a very cold stethoscope.
words.translation: Shifokor ko‘kragimni juda sovuq stetoskop bilan tingladi.

words.example: A dry throat made my welcome speech sound like a frog's greeting.
words.translation: Quruq tomog‘im sabab tabrik nutqim qurbaqaning salomiga o‘xshadi.

words.example: My skin turned red where I had forgotten the sunscreen.
words.translation: Quyoshdan himoya kremini surtishni unutgan joyimdagi teri qizardi.

words.example: I arrived early for my appointment and read a magazine older than my nephew.
words.translation: Qabulga erta kelib, jiyanimdan ham eski jurnalni o‘qidim.

words.example: The clinic had comfortable chairs, but nobody wanted to stay longer.
words.translation: Klinikada qulay stullar bor edi, ammo hech kim uzoqroq qolishni istamadi.

words.example: At the pharmacy, I forgot the medicine's name but remembered its orange box.
words.translation: Dorixonada dori nomini unutdim, ammo to‘q sariq qutisini esladim.

words.example: The pharmacist patiently listened to my description of a mysterious blue box.
words.translation: Farmatsevt sirli ko‘k quti haqidagi ta’rifimni sabr bilan tingladi.

words.example: The medicine tasted awful, so I made a face even before taking it.
words.translation: Dorining ta’mi yomon edi, shuning uchun ichishdan oldinoq yuzimni burishtirdim.

words.example: The ointment came in a tiny tube with surprisingly long instructions.
words.translation: Dorivor surtma ajablanarli uzun yo‘riqnomali kichik tubikda edi.

words.example: She checked the label before taking the pill, unlike her impatient husband.
words.translation: U sabrsiz eridan farqli ravishda hapdorini ichishdan oldin yorliqni tekshirdi.

words.example: I put the prescription in my pocket and checked it five times.
words.translation: Retseptni cho‘ntagimga solib, besh marta tekshirdim.

words.example: The label explained the dose more clearly than my uncle did.
words.translation: Yorliqda dori miqdori amakimning tushuntirishidan aniqroq yozilgan edi.

words.example: Her treatment finished before she finished the clinic's crossword.
words.translation: U klinikadagi krossvordni tugatmasidan muolajasi tugadi.

words.example: He hoped for a quick cure so he could return to his dance class.
words.translation: Raqs darsiga qaytish uchun u tez ta’sir qiladigan davodan umid qildi.

words.example: I hope you get better before your uncle offers to sing for you again.
words.translation: Amakingiz yana kuylab berishni taklif qilishidan oldin sog‘ayishingizni tilayman.

words.example: The cut healed, but I still treated that envelope with respect.
words.translation: Kesik bitdi, ammo men o‘sha konvertga hamon hurmat bilan qarardim.

words.example: The doctor examined my knee while I explained my ambitious dance move.
words.translation: Men katta raqs harakatimni tushuntirayotganda shifokor tizzamni tekshirdi.

words.example: The nurse checked my pulse while I tried not to talk about lunch.
words.translation: Tushlik haqida gapirmaslikka urinayotganimda hamshira tomir urishimni tekshirdi.

words.example: The injection was over before I finished my brave speech.
words.translation: Jasurlik haqidagi nutqimni tugatmasimdan ukol tugadi.

words.example: After the vaccination, my nephew proudly showed everyone his little plaster.
words.translation: Emlashdan keyin jiyanim kichik plastirini hammaga faxr bilan ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: After the operation, he was more interested in lunch than in television.
words.translation: Operatsiyadan keyin uni televizordan ko‘ra tushlik ko‘proq qiziqtirdi.

words.example: The surgeon explained everything clearly, even to my worried uncle.
words.translation: Jarroh hamma narsani, hatto xavotirdagi amakimga ham aniq tushuntirdi.

words.example: Everyone in the ward knew when my uncle received visitors.
words.translation: Kasalxona bo‘limidagi hamma amakimga mehmon kelganini bilardi.

words.example: My check-up took less time than finding a parking space.
words.translation: Tibbiy ko‘rigim mashina qo‘yish joyini topishdan kamroq vaqt oldi.

words.example: The X-ray showed my bones, but thankfully not my embarrassing dance moves.
words.translation: Rentgen suyaklarimni ko‘rsatdi, xayriyatki, uyatli raqs harakatlarimni emas.

words.example: She packed her medical records more carefully than her holiday clothes.
words.translation: U tibbiy hujjatlarini ta’til kiyimlaridan ham ehtiyotkorroq joyladi.

words.example: My health matters more than winning our neighbourhood cake-eating contest.
words.translation: Sog‘lig‘im mahallamizdagi tort yeyish musobaqasida g‘olib bo‘lishdan muhimroq.

words.example: Sleepiness was a possible side effect listed on the medicine box.
words.translation: Uyquchanlik dori qutisida keltirilgan ehtimoliy nojo‘ya ta’sirlardan biri edi.

words.example: A healthy breakfast does not become healthier when you photograph it.
words.translation: Foydali nonushta uni suratga olganingiz bilan yanada foydaliroq bo‘lib qolmaydi.

words.example: My fitness improved when the lift stopped working.
words.translation: Lift ishlamay qolgach, jismoniy chiniqqanligim yaxshilandi.

words.example: More physical activity sounded easy until I met the stairs.
words.translation: Zinapoyaga duch kelgunimcha ko‘proq jismoniy faollik oson tuyuldi.

words.example: We loosened up before dancing so our knees wouldn't complain.
words.translation: Tizzalarimiz shikoyat qilmasin deb raqsdan oldin mushaklarimizni yozdik.

words.example: I unwind after work by watering plants and ignoring my phone.
words.translation: Ishdan keyin gullarni sug‘orib va telefonimga qaramay hordiq chiqaraman.

words.meaning: diqqatni jamlab sokin o‘tirmoq; meditatsiya qilmoq
words.example: I tried to meditate, but the cat thought my lap was a new bed.
words.translation: Meditatsiya qilishga urindim, ammo mushuk tizzamni yangi yotoq deb o‘yladi.

words.example: After the race, I needed a moment to breathe before telling my heroic story.
words.translation: Poygadan keyin qahramonlik hikoyamni aytishdan oldin nafas rostlashim kerak edi.

words.example: My ten-minute nap somehow lasted until dinner.
words.translation: O‘n daqiqalik kunduzgi uyqum qandaydir qilib kechki ovqatgacha cho‘zildi.

words.example: Grandad snores so loudly that nobody hears the film.
words.translation: Bobom shunchalik baland xurrak otadiki, hech kim filmni eshitmaydi.

words.example: I yawned during my own story and decided to finish it quickly.
words.translation: O‘z hikoyamni aytayotib esnadim va uni tezroq tugatishga qaror qildim.

words.example: I was wide awake, but my brain had not arrived at work yet.
words.translation: Men butunlay uyg‘oq edim, ammo miyam hali ishga yetib kelmagan edi.

words.example: He was asleep before he finished complaining about the uncomfortable pillow.
words.translation: Noqulay yostiqdan shikoyat qilib bo‘lmasidan u uxlab qoldi.

words.example: At bedtime, my nephew suddenly has seventeen important questions.
words.translation: Uxlash paytida jiyanimning birdan o‘n yettita muhim savoli paydo bo‘ladi.

words.example: During a week of insomnia, I became very familiar with the ceiling.
words.translation: Bir haftalik uyqusizlik paytida shiftni juda yaxshi o‘rganib oldim.

words.example: The children had enough energy to chase the adults after the picnic.
words.translation: Sayrdan keyin bolalarda kattalarni quvishga ham yetarli quvvat bor edi.

words.example: The long walk gave me an appetite large enough to surprise Grandma.
words.translation: Uzoq sayrdan keyin ishtaham buvimni ham hayratlantiradigan darajada ochildi.

words.example: His diet includes vegetables, although he negotiates with every carrot.
words.translation: Uning ovqatlanish tartibida sabzavotlar bor, garchi har bir sabzi bilan kelishishga urinsa ham.

words.example: We discussed nutrition while carefully avoiding the subject of yesterday's cake.
words.translation: Kecha yegan tort mavzusini ehtiyotkorlik bilan chetlab, oziqlanish haqida gaplashdik.

words.example: She read about each vitamin instead of believing her uncle's loud advice.
words.translation: U amakisining baland ovozdagi maslahatiga ishonish o‘rniga har bir vitamin haqida o‘qidi.

words.example: The lesson on hygiene made the children inspect Dad's fingernails.
words.translation: Gigiyena darsi bolalarni dadamning tirnoqlarini tekshirishga undadi.

words.example: I have a habit of checking the fridge when I need a break.
words.translation: Dam kerak bo‘lganda muzlatkichni tekshirish odatim bor.

words.example: My morning routine begins with finding the alarm under my pillow.
words.translation: Ertalabki tartibim yostiq ostidagi budilnikni topishdan boshlanadi.

words.example: I'm trying to cut down on sugar, and my tea seems surprised.
words.translation: Shakar iste’molini kamaytirishga harakat qilyapman, choyim esa hayronday.

words.example: He gave up smoking and started collecting unusual mugs instead.
words.translation: U chekishni tashlab, o‘rniga g‘alati krujkalar yig‘a boshladi.

words.example: We work out together, then argue about who deserves the biggest sandwich.
words.translation: Birga mashq qilamiz, keyin eng katta sendvich kimga tegishini tortishamiz.

words.example: An honest dialogue helped us settle the argument about our noisy flat.
words.translation: Samimiy suhbat shovqinli uyimiz haqidagi bahsni hal qilishga yordam berdi.

words.example: Our debate about house rules ended with everyone washing one dish.
words.translation: Uy qoidalari haqidagi bahsimiz hamma bittadan idish yuvishi bilan tugadi.

words.example: I confided in my sister about my fear of giving a speech.
words.translation: Nutq so‘zlash qo‘rquvimni singlimga ishonib aytdim.

words.example: Please don't refer to my burnt cake during the wedding speech.
words.translation: Iltimos, to‘ydagi nutqda kuygan tortimni tilga olmang.

words.example: Mum spelled out the rules before leaving us alone with the cake.
words.translation: Oyim bizni tort bilan yolg‘iz qoldirishdan oldin qoidalarni aniq tushuntirdi.

words.example: To sum up our picnic: lovely people, wet sandwiches.
words.translation: Sayrimizni qisqacha aytsam: ajoyib odamlar, ho‘l sendvichlar.

words.example: He acknowledged my warning with a nod, then touched the wet paint.
words.translation: U bosh irg‘ab ogohlantirishimni eshitganini bildirdi, keyin ho‘l bo‘yoqqa tegdi.

words.example: How did your mother react when she saw your purple hair?
words.translation: Binafsha sochingizni ko‘rganda onangiz qanday munosabat bildirdi?

words.example: He declared that he could cook, then asked where we kept the eggs.
words.translation: U ovqat pishira olishini qat’iy aytib, keyin tuxum qayerdaligini so‘radi.

words.example: Please inform your guests that the parrot repeats everything.
words.translation: Mehmonlaringizni to‘tiqush hamma gapni takrorlashidan xabardor qiling.

words.example: Remind me to buy milk before I pour water on my cereal again.
words.translation: Yana yormamga suv quyishimdan oldin sut olishni eslat.

words.example: Could you clarify whether 'early' means before lunch or before sunrise?
words.translation: «Erta» deganingiz tushlikdan oldinmi yoki quyosh chiqishidan oldinmi, aniqlashtirasizmi?

words.example: I can pronounce her surname now, but only after a deep breath.
words.translation: Endi uning familiyasini talaffuz qila olaman, ammo avval chuqur nafas olishim kerak.

words.example: He whispered the secret so loudly that the next table listened.
words.translation: U sirni shunchalik baland pichirladiki, qo‘shni stol ham eshitdi.

words.example: Dad muttered about the instructions while holding them upside down.
words.translation: Dadam yo‘riqnomani teskari ushlab, undan g‘udrandi.

words.example: Her remark about my giant hat started a very cheerful conversation.
words.translation: Uning ulkan shlyapam haqidagi izohi juda quvnoq suhbatni boshlab berdi.

words.example: Nobody commented on the cake's unusual shape until it fell over.
words.translation: Tort yiqilib tushmaguncha hech kim uning noodatiy shakli haqida fikr bildirmadi.

words.example: She pointed out that I was searching for glasses already on my head.
words.translation: U boshimda turgan ko‘zoynakni qidirayotganimni aytib qo‘ydi.

words.example: Don't bring up my driving test while Uncle is drinking tea.
words.translation: Amakim choy ichayotganda haydovchilik imtihonim mavzusini ko‘tarma.

words.example: Please speak up; the blender is winning this conversation.
words.translation: Iltimos, balandroq gapiring; bu suhbatda blender yutyapti.

words.example: I finally got my point across by drawing the broken chair.
words.translation: Singan stulning rasmini chizib, nihoyat fikrimni tushuntira oldim.

words.example: Grandma has a saying for every problem, including broken kettles.
words.translation: Buvimda har bir muammoga, hatto singan choynakka ham maqol bor.

words.example: I understood the meaning of his smile when I saw the hidden cake.
words.translation: Yashirilgan tortni ko‘rib, uning tabassumi ma’nosini tushundim.

words.example: My polite enquiry about dinner received a very long answer.
words.translation: Kechki ovqat haqidagi odobli so‘rovimga juda uzun javob berildi.

words.example: I made small talk about the weather while trying to remember her name.
words.translation: Uning ismini eslashga urinib, ob-havo haqida yengil suhbat qurdim.

words.example: I recognised his voice before I saw his enormous new moustache.
words.translation: Ulkan yangi mo‘ylovini ko‘rmasimdan uning ovozini tanidim.

words.example: Her calm tone made even the bad news easier to hear.
words.translation: Uning bosiq ohangi hatto yomon xabarni ham eshitishni osonlashtirdi.

words.example: His hesitation before answering made us suspect he had eaten the cake.
words.translation: Javob berishdan oldingi ikkilanishi tortni u yegan deb gumon qilishimizga sabab bo‘ldi.

words.example: One gesture from Grandma stopped the whole table from talking.
words.translation: Buvimning bitta ishorasi butun dasturxon atrofidagilarni jim qildi.

words.example: His expression changed when he discovered the cake was made of soap.
words.translation: Tort sovundan yasalganini bilgach, uning yuz ifodasi o‘zgardi.

words.example: She smiled when she noticed my shoes were on the wrong feet.
words.translation: Tuflilarimni teskari kiyganimni ko‘rib u tabassum qildi.

words.example: We laughed so much that the dog came to investigate.
words.translation: Shunchalik ko‘p kuldikki, it tekshirish uchun keldi.

words.example: The children giggled when the teacher's chair squeaked.
words.translation: O‘qituvchining stuli g‘ijirlaganda bolalar qiqirlab kulishdi.

words.example: She frowned at the instructions as if they had insulted her.
words.translation: U yo‘riqnomaga go‘yo uni haqorat qilgandek qoshini chimirib qaradi.

words.example: I nodded to show agreement, not to order another bowl of soup.
words.translation: Yana sho‘rva buyurtirish uchun emas, rozilik bildirish uchun bosh irg‘adim.

words.example: He shrugged when asked where the missing socks went.
words.translation: Yo‘qolgan paypoqlar qayerga ketganini so‘rashganda u yelka qisdi.

words.example: She beckoned me over, and I hoped it wasn't my turn to sing.
words.translation: U meni imo bilan chaqirdi, men esa kuylash navbatim bo‘lmasin deb umid qildim.

words.example: Everyone stared at the man carrying a full-sized plastic horse.
words.translation: Hamma haqiqiy ot kattaligidagi plastik otni ko‘targan odamga tikildi.

words.example: She glanced at the clock when his story reached its third beginning.
words.translation: Hikoyasi uchinchi marta boshlanganda u soatga bir qarab qo‘ydi.

words.example: He avoided eye contact when Mum asked who had eaten the strawberries.
words.translation: Oyim qulupnaylarni kim yeganini so‘raganda u ko‘zga qarashdan qochdi.

words.example: Her body language said she wanted to leave before her words did.
words.translation: Gapirishidan oldinoq tana harakatlari uning ketmoqchi ekanini ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: An awkward silence followed my joke about the wrong person.
words.translation: Boshqa odam haqida hazil qilib yuborganimdan keyin noqulay sukunat cho‘kdi.

words.example: There was a long pause while he tried to remember his own postcode.
words.translation: O‘z pochta indeksini eslashga urinayotganda uzoq pauza bo‘ldi.

words.example: Dad sighed when the instructions mentioned forty-seven screws.
words.translation: Yo‘riqnomada qirq yettita vint tilga olinganda dadam xo‘rsindi.

words.example: His loud laugh frightened a pigeon off the windowsill.
words.translation: Uning baland kulgisi deraza tokchasidagi kaptarni cho‘chitib yubordi.

words.example: Her instructions were clear, but my left and right still got confused.
words.translation: Uning ko‘rsatmalari aniq edi, ammo men baribir chap bilan o‘ngni adashtirdim.

words.example: It was awkward when I forgot the name of the person I was introducing.
words.translation: Tanishtirayotgan odamimning ismini unutganim noqulay bo‘ldi.

words.example: His formal greeting sounded strange at a picnic in our garden.
words.translation: Bog‘imizdagi sayrda uning rasmiy salomi g‘alati eshitildi.

words.example: The meeting was informal, so even the chairperson wore slippers.
words.translation: Uchrashuv norasmiy edi, shuning uchun rais ham shippak kiygan edi.

words.example: Her sarcastic 'lovely weather' came as rain filled her shoe.
words.translation: Tuflisi yomg‘irga to‘layotganida u kinoya bilan «ajoyib ob-havo» dedi.

words.example: My preference for quiet evenings surprised nobody who had heard my neighbours.
words.translation: Sokin oqshomlarni afzal ko‘rishim qo‘shnilarimni eshitgan hech kimni ajablantirmadi.

words.example: Her best advice was to read the recipe before inviting twenty guests.
words.translation: Uning eng yaxshi maslahati yigirmata mehmon chaqirishdan oldin retseptni o‘qish edi.

words.example: My proposal to skip the speeches and serve dinner was extremely popular.
words.translation: Nutqlarni o‘tkazib yuborib, ovqat tortish taklifim hammaga juda yoqdi.

words.example: His request for silence was interrupted by his own phone.
words.translation: Uning jimlik haqidagi iltimosini o‘z telefoni bo‘ldi.

words.example: Could you do me a favour and distract Mum from the broken vase?
words.translation: Menga bir yaxshilik qilib, oyimni singan vazadan chalg‘ita olasanmi?

words.example: I asked for her consent before sharing the funny photograph.
words.translation: Kulgili suratni ulashishdan oldin uning roziligini so‘radim.

words.example: They allow dogs in the café, but not on the piano.
words.translation: Kafeda itlarga ruxsat berishadi, ammo pianino ustida emas.

words.example: He refused to sing until someone promised to close the windows.
words.translation: Kimdir derazalarni yopishga va’da bermaguncha u kuylashdan bosh tortdi.

words.example: She offered to cut my hair, and I suddenly remembered an appointment.
words.translation: U sochimni qirqishni taklif qildi va birdan uchrashuvim borligi esimga tushdi.

words.example: I suggest we test the tent before the rain does.
words.translation: Chodirni yomg‘irdan oldin o‘zimiz sinab ko‘rishni taklif qilaman.

words.example: My dentist didn't recommend the enormous bag of sweets.
words.translation: Tish shifokorim ulkan konfet paketini tavsiya qilmadi.

words.example: She advised me to check my pockets before blaming the washing machine.
words.translation: U kir yuvish mashinasini ayblashdan oldin cho‘ntaklarimni tekshirishni maslahat berdi.

words.example: We persuaded Grandad to join the dance, then couldn't make him stop.
words.translation: Bobomni raqsga qo‘shilishga ko‘ndirdik, keyin esa to‘xtata olmadik.

words.example: I couldn't convince my niece that the moon wasn't following our car.
words.translation: Jiyanimni oy mashinamizga ergashmayotganiga ishontira olmadim.

words.example: We finally agreed that nobody wanted to cook.
words.translation: Nihoyat hech kim ovqat pishirishni istamayotganiga kelishdik.

words.example: Grandma approved of my new haircut after adjusting it herself.
words.translation: Buvim yangi soch turmagimni o‘zi tuzatgach ma’qulladi.

words.example: Nobody objected when we replaced the long speech with lunch.
words.translation: Uzun nutqni tushlikka almashtirganimizda hech kim e’tiroz bildirmadi.

words.example: He insisted on carrying everything, then asked us to carry him.
words.translation: U hamma narsani o‘zi ko‘tarishga qat’iy turib oldi, keyin o‘zini ko‘tarishimizni so‘radi.

words.example: I prefer honest advice to compliments about my burnt cake.
words.translation: Kuygan tortim haqidagi maqtovdan ko‘ra samimiy maslahatni afzal ko‘raman.

words.example: Her view changed after she tried camping in the rain.
words.translation: Yomg‘irda chodirda tunab ko‘rgach, uning nuqtayi nazari o‘zgardi.

words.example: His reason for being late involved a duck and sounded surprisingly believable.
words.translation: Kechikishining sababi o‘rdak bilan bog‘liq edi va ajablanarli darajada ishonarli eshitildi.

words.example: Your explanation needs to include why the cat is wearing my tie.
words.translation: Izohingda mushuk nega mening galstugimni taqqanini ham aytishing kerak.

words.example: Asking for one quiet evening seemed reasonable to everyone except the drummer.
words.translation: Bir oqshom jimlik so‘rash barabanchidan boshqa hammaga asosli tuyuldi.

words.example: It seemed unfair that the person who cooked also had to wash up.
words.translation: Ovqat pishirgan odam idishlarni ham yuvishi adolatsiz tuyuldi.

words.example: Honestly, I liked the box more than the present.
words.translation: Rostini aytsam, sovg‘adan ko‘ra qutisi ko‘proq yoqdi.

words.example: My dilemma was whether to admit I broke the vase or let Dad blame the cat.
words.translation: Vazani sindirganimni tan olish yoki dadamning mushukni ayblashiga yo‘l qo‘yish orasida qoldim.

words.example: We decided to stay home after packing for three hours.
words.translation: Uch soat yuk yig‘gach, uyda qolishga qaror qildik.

words.example: Choosing the quiet table was a good choice until the band arrived.
words.translation: Orkestr kelguncha sokin stolni tanlash yaxshi tanlov edi.

words.example: Our last option was to ask Grandma, who already knew the answer.
words.translation: Oxirgi variant javobni allaqachon biladigan buvimdan so‘rash edi.

words.example: A picnic indoors was a dry alternative to our original plan.
words.translation: Uy ichidagi sayr dastlabki rejamizga quruq muqobil bo‘ldi.

words.example: Consider the neighbours before buying your child a drum.
words.translation: Farzandingizga baraban olishdan oldin qo‘shnilarni o‘ylab ko‘ring.

words.example: We evaluated the options before trusting Uncle with the birthday cake.
words.translation: Tug‘ilgan kun tortini amakimga ishonishdan oldin variantlarni baholadik.

words.example: We weighed up the options before letting Dad choose the film.
words.translation: Dadamga film tanlashga ruxsat berishdan oldin variantlarni o‘lchab ko‘rdik.

words.example: I hesitated before accepting a second helping of his experimental soup.
words.translation: Uning tajriba uchun pishirgan sho‘rvasidan yana olishdan oldin ikkilandim.

words.example: She was uncertain whether to trust a hairdresser with orange eyebrows.
words.translation: U to‘q sariq qoshli sartaroshga ishonishga ikkilanardi.

words.example: I was certain I had locked the door, but I checked it anyway.
words.translation: Eshikni qulflaganimga ishonchim komil edi, ammo baribir tekshirdim.

words.example: He's likely to agree if you mention that lunch is included.
words.translation: Tushlik ham borligini aytsangiz, uning rozi bo‘lish ehtimoli katta.

words.example: It's unlikely that my brother will volunteer to wash the windows.
words.translation: Akam derazalarni yuvishga ko‘ngilli bo‘lishi ehtimoli kam.

words.example: Is it possible to leave this party without taking more cake?
words.translation: Yana tort olmasdan bu bazmdan ketish mumkinmi?

words.example: Keeping the surprise secret from my nosy aunt was impossible.
words.translation: Syurprizni hamma narsaga qiziqadigan xolamdan sir tutish imkonsiz edi.

words.example: These shoes are suitable for a photo, but probably not a walk.
words.translation: Bu tuflilar suratga mos, lekin sayrga unchalik emasdir.

words.example: Was it necessary to invite the entire football team to breakfast?
words.translation: Butun futbol jamoasini nonushtaga taklif qilish zarurmidi?

words.example: The urgency in his voice made us realise that the bath was overflowing.
words.translation: Ovozidagi shoshilinchlik vannadan suv toshayotganini anglatdi.

words.example: A sticky kitchen was the consequence of leaving my nephew with the jam.
words.translation: Jiyanimni murabbo bilan yolg‘iz qoldirish oqibatida oshxona yopishqoq bo‘lib qoldi.

words.example: Letting Dad choose my clothes was a risk I would not take again.
words.translation: Kiyimlarimni dadamga tanlatish boshqa qilmaydigan tavakkalim edi.

words.example: One benefit of living alone is never arguing about the last biscuit.
words.translation: Yolg‘iz yashashning bir afzalligi oxirgi pechenye ustida hech tortishmaslikdir.

words.example: The only drawback of the quiet room was its very loud clock.
words.translation: Sokin xonaning yagona kamchiligi juda baland chiqillaydigan soati edi.

words.example: I intend to apologise before she discovers the second broken cup.
words.translation: U ikkinchi singan piyolani topmasidan uzr so‘rash niyatidaman.

words.example: Please make up your mind before the ice cream melts.
words.translation: Muzqaymoq erimasidan bir qarorga kel, iltimos.

words.example: You can change your mind about the haircut before I make the first cut.
words.translation: Qaychini birinchi marta ishlatishimdan oldin soch turmagi haqidagi fikringdan qaytishing mumkin.

words.example: The problem wasn't the missing key; it was the cat sitting on it.
words.translation: Muammo kalit yo‘qolganida emas, mushuk uning ustida o‘tirganida edi.

words.example: We had trouble opening the jar until Grandma arrived.
words.translation: Buvim kelguncha bankani ochishga qiynaldik.

words.example: My main difficulty was carrying an umbrella and three birthday cakes.
words.translation: Asosiy qiyinchiligim soyabon va uchta tug‘ilgan kun tortini ko‘tarish edi.

words.example: Finding matching socks is too much hassle before breakfast.
words.translation: Nonushtadan oldin bir xil paypoq topish ortiqcha ovora bo‘lishdir.

words.example: The broken lift was an inconvenience, especially for the man delivering our sofa.
words.translation: Buzuq lift, ayniqsa divanimizni yetkazayotgan odamga, noqulaylik tug‘dirdi.

words.example: The accident with the paint left my brother with a green shoe.
words.translation: Bo‘yoq bilan bo‘lgan tasodifiy ko‘ngilsizlikdan akamning tuflisi yashil bo‘lib qoldi.

words.example: We checked the damage after the puppy discovered the cushions.
words.translation: Kuchukcha yostiqlarni topib olgach, yetkazilgan zararni tekshirdik.

words.example: It wasn't my fault that the chair made a noise during the speech.
words.translation: Nutq paytida stul ovoz chiqargani mening aybim emas edi.

words.example: My room was such a mess that I found last year's birthday card.
words.translation: Xonam shunchalik betartib ediki, o‘tgan yilgi tabriknomamni topdim.

words.example: I spilled tea just as I promised to be more careful.
words.translation: Ehtiyotkorroq bo‘lishga va’da bergan zahotim choyni to‘kib yubordim.

words.example: My bottle leaked into my bag and washed my shopping list.
words.translation: Idishimdagi suv sumkamga sizib chiqib, xarid ro‘yxatimni yuvib yubordi.

words.example: My hand was stuck in the biscuit jar, which was hard to explain.
words.translation: Qo‘lim pechenye bankasiga tiqilib qoldi, buni tushuntirish qiyin edi.

words.example: The missing remote appeared when Dad finally stood up.
words.translation: Dadam nihoyat turganida yo‘qolgan pult topildi.

words.example: The broken clock was correct twice a day, which impressed my nephew.
words.translation: Buzuq soat kuniga ikki marta to‘g‘ri vaqtni ko‘rsatardi, bu jiyanimni lol qoldirdi.

words.example: A faulty doorbell kept announcing visitors who didn't exist.
words.translation: Nosoz eshik qo‘ng‘irog‘i yo‘q mehmonlar kelganini bildiraverdi.

words.example: The lift was unavailable, so our shopping got a tour of the stairs.
words.translation: Liftdan foydalanib bo‘lmasdi, shuning uchun xaridlarimiz zinapoyani aylanib chiqdi.

words.example: The kitchen was so crowded that stirring the soup required permission.
words.translation: Oshxona shunchalik gavjum ediki, sho‘rvani aralashtirishga ruxsat kerak edi.

words.example: A mix-up with the invitations brought my dentist to our family picnic.
words.translation: Taklifnomalardagi chalkashlik sabab tish shifokorim oilaviy sayrimizga keldi.

words.example: I misplaced my glasses and searched while wearing them.
words.translation: Ko‘zoynagimni qayerga qo‘yganimni unutib, uni taqib olgan holda qidirdim.

words.example: My brother accidentally locked me out while I was wearing slippers.
words.translation: Shippakda turganimda akam bilmasdan meni tashqarida qulflab qoldirdi.

words.example: We ran out of tea just as Grandma arrived with six friends.
words.translation: Buvim olti dugonasi bilan kelganida choyimiz tugab qoldi.

words.example: My headphones came out of my pocket in a perfect tangle.
words.translation: Quloqchinlarim cho‘ntagimdan butunlay chigallashib chiqdi.

words.example: The buzzing fly was a nuisance during our serious conversation.
words.translation: Jiddiy suhbatimizda vizillagan pashsha bezovta qildi.

words.example: We hit a snag when the new sofa was wider than the door.
words.translation: Yangi divan eshikdan kengroq chiqqanda kutilmagan to‘siqqa duch keldik.

words.example: Burning the first cake was a setback, but the second one survived.
words.translation: Birinchi tortning kuyishi ishni orqaga surdi, ammo ikkinchisi omon qoldi.

words.example: Our solution to the missing chairs was a picnic on the floor.
words.translation: Yetishmagan stullar muammosiga yechimimiz polda sayr dasturxoni yozish bo‘ldi.

words.example: He fixed the squeaky door, but now it refuses to close.
words.translation: U g‘ijirlaydigan eshikni tuzatdi, ammo endi eshik yopilmaydi.

words.example: We resolved the argument by letting the youngest child choose dinner.
words.translation: Kechki ovqatni eng kichik bolaga tanlatib tortishuvni hal qildik.

words.example: I'll deal with the broken chair after I rescue Dad from it.
words.translation: Dadamni undan qutqarganimdan keyin singan stul bilan shug‘ullanaman.

words.example: She coped with three noisy guests and a kettle that wouldn't boil.
words.translation: U uchta shovqinli mehmon va qaynamaydigan choynak tashvishini ham epladi.

words.example: I managed to carry all the bags without dropping the eggs.
words.translation: Tuxumlarni tushirmasdan barcha sumkalarni ko‘tarishni uddaladim.

words.example: He overcame his fear of singing and immediately wanted an audience.
words.translation: U kuylash qo‘rquvini yengib, darrov tomoshabin istab qoldi.

words.example: A lid would have prevented the soup from decorating my bag.
words.translation: Qopqoq sho‘rvaning sumkamni bezashining oldini olgan bo‘lardi.

words.example: I avoid arguments about football by offering everyone tea.
words.translation: Hammaga choy taklif qilib, futbol haqidagi tortishuvlardan qochaman.

words.example: My flatmate puts up with my singing because I wash the dishes.
words.translation: Idishlarni yuvganim uchun ijaradoshim qo‘shiqlarimga chidaydi.

words.example: Let's sort out the sleeping arrangements before Uncle claims the sofa.
words.translation: Amakim divanni egallamasidan yotish joylarini hal qilib olaylik.

words.example: It took him a week to get over the embarrassment of calling his teacher Mum.
words.translation: O‘qituvchisini «oyi» deb yuborganidagi xijolatdan chiqishiga bir hafta ketdi.

words.example: She carried on telling her story while we searched for the escaped hamster.
words.translation: Qochgan og‘maxonni qidirayotganimizda u hikoyasini davom ettirdi.

words.example: Hold on while I find a pen that actually writes.
words.translation: Rostdan yozadigan qalam topgunimcha biroz kuting.

words.example: I put off cleaning my room until I couldn't find the door.
words.translation: Eshikni topa olmay qolgunimcha xonamni tozalashni kechiktirdim.

words.example: I turned down his offer to cut my hair with kitchen scissors.
words.translation: Oshxona qaychisi bilan sochimni qirqish taklifini rad etdim.

words.example: The missing invitation turned up inside the book I had lent her.
words.translation: Yo‘qolgan taklifnoma unga berib turgan kitobim ichidan topildi.

words.example: We couldn't get rid of the smell of burnt toast until we opened every window.
words.translation: Barcha derazani ochmaguncha kuygan non hididan qutula olmadik.

words.example: We tackled the pile of dishes after a short motivational speech.
words.translation: Qisqa ruhlantiruvchi nutqdan keyin uyulgan idishlarni yuvishga kirishdik.

words.example: I struggled to open the packet while the children offered useless advice.
words.translation: Bolalar foydasiz maslahat berayotganida paketni ochishga qiynaldim.

words.example: Her persistence finally persuaded the whole family to tidy the garage.
words.translation: Uning tinimsiz urinishi nihoyat butun oilani garajni yig‘ishtirishga ko‘ndirdi.

words.example: My first attempt at fixing the shelf produced a smaller shelf.
words.translation: Tokchani tuzatishga birinchi urinishim kichikroq tokcha hosil qildi.

words.example: We succeeded in opening the jar just as nobody wanted jam anymore.
words.translation: Hech kim murabbo istamay qolgan paytda bankani ochishga muvaffaq bo‘ldik.

words.example: I got used to my neighbour's singing, but visitors still look worried.
words.translation: Qo‘shnimning qo‘shiqlariga ko‘nikdim, ammo mehmonlar hamon xavotirli ko‘rinadi.

words.example: I am adjusting to early mornings, one enormous yawn at a time.
words.translation: Har safar katta esnab, erta tonglarga asta-sekin ko‘nikyapman.

words.example: My nephew's imagination turned the sofa into a dangerous volcano.
words.translation: Jiyanimning tasavvuri divanni xavfli vulqonga aylantirdi.

words.example: The speaker lost our attention when a kitten entered the room.
words.translation: Xonaga mushukcha kirganda notiq e’tiborimizni yo‘qotdi.

words.example: The thought of another long speech made me reach for a biscuit.
words.translation: Yana uzun nutq haqidagi o‘y meni pechenyega qo‘l uzatishga undadi.

words.example: The dancing pigeon outside was a serious distraction.
words.translation: Tashqaridagi raqs tushayotgan kaptar qattiq chalg‘itdi.

words.example: His awareness of other people's feelings improved after he became a father.
words.translation: Ota bo‘lganidan keyin u boshqalarning hislarini yaxshiroq anglay boshladi.

words.example: Her belief that every problem needs tea is difficult to argue with.
words.translation: Uning har bir muammoga choy kerak degan ishonchi bilan bahslashish qiyin.

words.example: My expectation of a quiet evening ended when the relatives arrived.
words.translation: Qarindoshlar kelganda sokin oqshom haqidagi umidim tugadi.

words.example: My first impression was that he was serious, until he showed his dinosaur socks.
words.translation: Dinozavrli paypog‘ini ko‘rsatguncha u jiddiy odam degan ilk taassurotim bor edi.

words.example: My assumption that the box contained shoes was destroyed by a loud meow.
words.translation: Qutida tufli bor degan taxminimni baland miyov buzdi.

words.example: I realised I was at the wrong party when nobody recognised me.
words.translation: Hech kim tanimaganda noto‘g‘ri bazmga kelganimni angladim.

words.example: She recognised me despite my new beard and unfortunate hat.
words.translation: Yangi soqolim va beso‘naqay shlyapamga qaramay, u meni tanidi.

words.example: I couldn't recall his name, but I remembered his terrible jokes.
words.translation: Ismini eslay olmadim, ammo bemaza hazillari esimda edi.

words.example: I reflected on my mistake while cleaning jam off the ceiling.
words.translation: Shiftdagi murabboni tozalayotib xatoim haqida mulohaza qildim.

words.example: I wonder why the dog looks guilty whenever we say 'cushion'.
words.translation: Nega «yostiq» deganimizda it aybdordek ko‘rinadi, deb o‘ylayman.

words.example: Imagine explaining this broken vase to someone who already looks annoyed.
words.translation: Bu singan vazani allaqachon jahli chiqqan odamga tushuntirishni tasavvur qil.

words.example: I suppose the dog needs a bath more than I need clean trousers.
words.translation: Menimcha, menga toza shimdan ko‘ra itga cho‘milish ko‘proq kerak.

words.example: I assumed he was the host because he was guarding the cake.
words.translation: Tortni qo‘riqlayotgani uchun uni mezbon deb taxmin qildim.

words.example: I expected a quiet visit, but Grandma had hired a karaoke machine.
words.translation: Sokin mehmondorchilik kutgandim, ammo buvim karaoke qurilmasini ijaraga olgan ekan.

words.example: Nobody noticed my new haircut until I mentioned it six times.
words.translation: Olti marta aytmagunimcha hech kim yangi soch turmagimni payqamadi.

words.example: I was aware of the problem before the soup reached my shoes.
words.translation: Sho‘rva tuflilarimgacha yetmasidan muammoni anglagan edim.

words.example: My absent-minded uncle thanked the cash machine.
words.translation: Xayoli parishon amakim bankomatga rahmat aytdi.

words.example: I daydream about holidays while waiting for my toast.
words.translation: Nonim qizarishini kutib, ta’til haqida xayol suraman.

words.example: My first instinct was to hide the broken cup, but I told the truth.
words.translation: Birinchi ichki turtkim singan piyolani yashirish edi, ammo rostini aytdim.

words.example: My intention was to help, not to glue the drawer shut.
words.translation: Niyatim tortmani yelimlab yopish emas, yordam berish edi.

words.example: I trust her judgement about people, but not about extremely spicy soup.
words.translation: Odamlarni baholashiga ishonaman, ammo juda achchiq sho‘rva masalasida emas.

words.example: Her cheerful personality made even waiting in a queue enjoyable.
words.translation: Uning quvnoq fe’l-atvori hatto navbat kutishni ham yoqimli qildi.

words.example: Sharing the last slice showed more of his character than his long speech.
words.translation: Oxirgi bo‘lakni bo‘lishishi uning xarakterini uzun nutqidan ko‘proq ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: His attitude to cleaning changed when he got his own flat.
words.translation: O‘z uyiga ega bo‘lgach, uning tozalikka munosabati o‘zgardi.

words.example: The children's behaviour improved when Grandma raised one eyebrow.
words.translation: Buvim bitta qoshini ko‘targanda bolalarning xulqi yaxshilandi.

words.example: He showed maturity by apologising before anyone mentioned the broken lamp.
words.translation: Hech kim singan chiroqni aytmasidan uzr so‘rab, u yetukligini ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: It took courage to admit that the terrible cake was mine.
words.translation: Yomon tortni o‘zim pishirganimni tan olish jasorat talab qildi.

words.example: Her honesty helped me realise that my singing needed practice.
words.translation: Uning rostgo‘yligi kuylashim uchun mashq kerakligini anglashimga yordam berdi.

words.example: Moving out gave him independence and a new respect for washing machines.
words.translation: Alohida yashash unga mustaqillik va kir yuvish mashinalariga yangi hurmat berdi.

words.example: With great determination, she untangled the necklace before dinner.
words.translation: Katta qat’iyat bilan u kechki ovqatdan oldin marjon chigalini yozdi.

words.example: His ambition is to make a cake that stands up without support.
words.translation: Uning katta maqsadi tayanchsiz tik turadigan tort tayyorlash.

words.example: My motivation to clean increased when I heard that guests were coming.
words.translation: Mehmon kelishini eshitgach, tozalashga ishtiyoqim oshdi.

words.example: Learning to swim improved her self-esteem more than buying fancy goggles.
words.translation: Suzishni o‘rganish uning o‘zini qadrlashini qimmat ko‘zoynak olishdan ko‘proq oshirdi.

words.example: It takes discipline to stop after one biscuit in this house.
words.translation: Bu uyda bitta pechenyedan keyin to‘xtash uchun intizom kerak.

words.example: My willpower lasted until someone opened the chocolate box.
words.translation: Irodam kimdir shokolad qutisini ochguncha chidadi.

words.example: Honesty is a virtue, though my uncle's comments about haircuts test it.
words.translation: Rostgo‘ylik fazilat, garchi amakimning soch turmagi haqidagi gaplari buni sinasa ham.

words.example: His biggest flaw is promising to help and then forgetting.
words.translation: Uning eng katta kamchiligi yordam va’da qilib, keyin unutishidir.

words.example: She has a gift for making strangers feel welcome.
words.translation: U notanish kishilarni samimiy kutib olishning tabiiy qobiliyatiga ega.

words.example: Not laughing at his enormous hat required real self-control.
words.translation: Uning ulkan shlyapasiga kulmaslik uchun chinakam o‘zini tuta bilish kerak edi.

words.example: The teacher saw potential in my acting, even when I forgot every line.
words.translation: Hamma gapimni unutganimda ham o‘qituvchi aktyorlik salohiyatimni ko‘rdi.

words.example: He matured after moving out and stopped calling Mum about every missing sock.
words.translation: Alohida yashagach u ulg‘ayib, har yo‘qolgan paypoq uchun oyisiga qo‘ng‘iroq qilmay qo‘ydi.

words.example: I learned from my mistake and kept the birthday cake away from the dog.
words.translation: Xatoimdan saboq olib, tug‘ilgan kun tortini itdan uzoqda saqladim.

words.example: She achieved her goal of speaking confidently, even with a noisy microphone.
words.translation: Shovqinli mikrofonga qaramay, u ishonch bilan gapirish maqsadiga erishdi.

words.example: After listening to that long story, you deserve a second slice of cake.
words.translation: O‘sha uzun hikoyani tinglaganingdan keyin ikkinchi bo‘lak tortga loyiqsan.

words.example: Keeping a plant alive requires commitment, as my empty pots prove.
words.translation: Bo‘sh tuvaklarim ko‘rsatganidek, o‘simlikni yashatish qat’iy mas’uliyat talab qiladi.

words.example: I promised to arrive on time and set three alarms.
words.translation: Vaqtida kelishga va’da berib, uchta budilnik qo‘ydim.

words.example: The environment would enjoy our picnic more without the plastic forks.
words.translation: Plastik sanchqilar bo‘lmasa, atrof-muhit piknigimizdan ko‘proq mamnun bo‘lardi.

words.meaning: tirik mavjudotlar va muhit aloqalarini o‘rganish; ekologiya
words.example: Ecology explains why removing one insect can upset a whole garden.
words.translation: Ekologiya bitta hasharotni yo‘qotish butun bog‘dagi muvozanatni nega buzishini tushuntiradi.

words.example: Our pond is a small ecosystem with some extremely noisy residents.
words.translation: Hovuzimiz ayrim juda shovqinli aholisi bo‘lgan kichik ekotizimdir.

words.example: The fallen tree is a habitat, not just an untidy bit of forest.
words.translation: Qulagan daraxt shunchaki o‘rmonning tartibsiz qismi emas, yashash muhitidir.

words.example: Our garden's biodiversity includes several creatures that eat my lettuce.
words.translation: Bog‘imizning biologik xilma-xilligiga salatimni yeydigan bir nechta jonzot ham kiradi.

words.example: Local wildlife treats my vegetable patch as a free restaurant.
words.translation: Mahalliy yovvoyi hayvonlar sabzavot ekkan joyimni bepul oshxona deb biladi.

words.example: We identified five bird species before Dad identified the nearest café.
words.translation: Dadam eng yaqin kafeni topguncha biz beshta qush turini aniqladik.

words.meaning: muayyan hududdagi bir tur vakillari soni
words.example: The rabbit population has increased, and my carrots have noticed.
words.translation: Quyonlar soni ko‘paydi, sabzilarim esa buni sezdi.

words.example: Even a tiny organism can have a surprisingly busy life.
words.translation: Hatto mitti organizmning ham hayoti kutilmaganda juda band bo‘lishi mumkin.

words.example: Thick vegetation has hidden the path and possibly Dad's confidence.
words.translation: Qalin o‘simliklar yo‘lni va, ehtimol, dadamning ishonchini yashirdi.

words.meaning: inson kam aralashgan yovvoyi tabiat hududi
words.example: In the wilderness, my phone is mostly an expensive clock.
words.translation: Yovvoyi tabiat qo‘ynida telefonim asosan qimmat soat vazifasini bajaradi.

words.example: The wetland stores water and gives muddy boots a purpose.
words.translation: Suv-botqoq hudud suvni saqlaydi va loy etiklar kiyishga sabab beradi.

words.example: The woodland behind our estate is quieter than our family kitchen.
words.translation: Turar joyimiz ortidagi daraxtzor oilamiz oshxonasidan tinchroq.

words.example: A rainforest has more layers of leaves than my winter outfit has clothes.
words.translation: Tropik o‘rmondagi barg qatlamlari qishki kiyimim qatlamlaridan ko‘proq.

words.example: The grassland looks empty until a hundred insects introduce themselves.
words.translation: Yuzta hasharot o‘zini tanishtirguncha keng o‘tloq bo‘m-bo‘sh ko‘rinadi.

words.example: We admired the marsh from a path that kept our socks dry.
words.translation: Paypoqlarimizni quruq saqlaydigan yo‘lakdan botqoqlikni tomosha qildik.

words.example: Birds gather at the estuary as if somebody has announced lunch.
words.translation: Daryoning dengizga quyilish joyiga qushlar go‘yo kimdir tushlikni e’lon qilgandek to‘planadi.

words.example: The coastline curves so much that our walk keeps getting longer.
words.translation: Qirg‘oq chizig‘i shunchalik egri-bugriki, sayrimiz uzayaveradi.

words.example: On this peninsula, the sea seems to follow us everywhere.
words.translation: Bu yarimorolda dengiz go‘yo hamma joyda ortimizdan yuradi.

words.example: The dune moved a little, but our picnic blanket moved much faster.
words.translation: Qum tepaligi biroz siljidi, piknik to‘shamamiz esa ancha tezroq uchdi.

words.example: At this altitude, even our snack bags seem slightly swollen.
words.translation: Bu balandlikda hatto gazak paketlarimiz ham biroz shishgandek.

words.example: The rough terrain gave my new boots an immediate interview.
words.translation: Notekis yer yangi etiklarimni darhol sinovdan o‘tkazdi.

words.example: The forest canopy works as a roof with occasional leaks.
words.translation: O‘rmonning yuqori shox qatlami ba’zan suv o‘tkazadigan tom vazifasini bajaradi.

words.example: Something rustled in the undergrowth, and Dad suddenly walked faster.
words.translation: Daraxtlar tagidagi o‘simliklar orasida nimadir shitirladi va dadam birdan tezroq yurdi.

words.example: We planted native flowers, and the local bees approved immediately.
words.translation: Shu hududga xos gullarni ekdik, mahalliy asalarilar darhol ma’qulladi.

words.example: Global warming is a long-term trend, not a reason to trust tomorrow's picnic weather.
words.translation: Global isish uzoq muddatli jarayon, ertangi piknik havosiga ishonish uchun sabab emas.

words.example: The greenhouse effect keeps Earth warm, but adding more gases turns up the heat.
words.translation: Issiqxona effekti Yerni iliq saqlaydi, lekin gazlar ko‘payishi issiqlikni oshiradi.

words.example: Carbon is in my pencil and my body, though only one does homework.
words.translation: Uglerod qalamimda ham, tanamda ham bor, lekin ulardan faqat bittasi uy vazifasini bajaradi.

words.example: The yeast releases carbon dioxide, giving our bread a lift.
words.translation: Xamirturush karbonat angidrid chiqarib, nonimizni ko‘taradi.

words.example: Methane traps heat in the atmosphere, so leaks are more than a waste of gas.
words.translation: Metan atmosferada issiqlikni tutadi, shuning uchun sizib chiqish faqat gaz isrofi emas.

words.example: The emission of smoke from that chimney has cancelled our outdoor lunch.
words.translation: O‘sha mo‘ridan tutun chiqishi ochiq havodagi tushligimizni bekor qildi.

words.example: Taking fewer flights can shrink my carbon footprint without shrinking my shoes.
words.translation: Kamroq samolyotda uchish oyoq kiyimimni kichraytirmay, uglerod izimni kamaytirishi mumkin.

words.example: Earth's atmosphere does a valuable job without sending us a bill.
words.translation: Yer atmosferasi bizga hisob yubormay muhim ish bajaradi.

words.example: Air pollution is one visitor our town would rather not welcome.
words.translation: Havo ifloslanishi shahrimiz kutib olishni istamaydigan mehmondir.

words.example: A pollutant can be invisible, unlike the rubbish on my desk.
words.translation: Ifloslantiruvchi modda stolimdagi axlatdan farqli ravishda ko‘rinmas bo‘lishi mumkin.

words.example: Smog hid the skyline, so our photos feature mostly grey.
words.translation: Iflos tuman shahar manzarasini yashirdi, suratlarimizda asosan kulrang chiqdi.

words.example: Soot covered the old chimney brush like a very dark coat.
words.translation: Qurum eski mo‘ri cho‘tkasini juda qora palto kabi qopladi.

words.example: Acid rain can damage buildings; even stone dislikes some weather.
words.translation: Kislotali yomg‘ir binolarga zarar yetkazishi mumkin, hatto tosh ham ayrim ob-havoni yoqtirmaydi.

words.example: Deforestation leaves animals looking for homes nobody has built.
words.translation: O‘rmonlarning yo‘q qilinishi hayvonlarni hech kim qurmagan uylarni izlashga majbur qiladi.

words.example: Desertification can turn productive land into a place where farming becomes a struggle.
words.translation: Cho‘llanish unumdor yerni dehqonchilik qiyinlashadigan joyga aylantirishi mumkin.

words.example: Erosion has taken part of the path without asking the walkers.
words.translation: Yemirilish piyodalardan so‘ramay yo‘lakning bir qismini olib ketdi.

words.example: After the flood, our football pitch briefly resembled a lake.
words.translation: Suv toshqinidan keyin futbol maydonimiz bir muddat ko‘lga o‘xshadi.

words.example: The wildfire warning was a good reason to cancel our campfire plans.
words.translation: Tabiiy yong‘in haqidagi ogohlantirish gulxan rejamizni bekor qilish uchun yetarli sabab edi.
