words.translation: Qo‘shnilar keksa yashovchiga g‘amxo‘rlikni bo‘lishib, uning ajoyib choy retseptini o‘rgandi.

words.meaning: yordamga yetib bora olmaydiganlarga faol murojaat qilish
words.example: The outreach team visits people who cannot simply walk into an advice centre.
words.translation: Ko‘mak guruhi maslahat markaziga o‘zi bora olmaydigan kishilarni borib ko‘radi.

words.example: Mentoring helped the new volunteer ask questions before inventing creative mistakes.
words.translation: Ustoz ko‘magi yangi ko‘ngilliga ijodiy xatolar o‘ylab topishdan oldin savol berishga yordam berdi.

words.meaning: yolg‘iz kishiga muntazam do‘stona hamrohlik qilish
words.example: The befriending scheme pairs volunteers with people who would welcome regular company.
words.translation: Do‘stona hamrohlik dasturi ko‘ngillilarni muntazam suhbatdosh istaydigan odamlar bilan bog‘laydi.

words.example: Our neighbourhood watch reports concerns without turning every passing cat into a suspect.
words.translation: Mahalla kuzatuvimiz har bir o‘tgan mushukni gumondor qilmay, xavotirli holatlarni bildiradi.

words.example: The flood created unexpected unity among neighbours who had previously argued about parking.
words.translation: Toshqin ilgari mashina qo‘yish ustida tortishgan qo‘shnilar orasida kutilmagan birdamlik yaratdi.

words.example: Cooperation moved the heavy bench faster than six separate opinions.
words.translation: Hamkorlik og‘ir o‘rindiqni oltita alohida fikrdan tezroq ko‘chirdi.

words.example: An alliance of local groups saved the park and gave our meetings a very long guest list.
words.translation: Mahalliy guruhlar ittifoqi bog‘ni saqladi va yig‘ilishlarimizga juda uzun mehmon ro‘yxatini berdi.

words.example: The non-profit café puts its surplus into meals rather than a manager's sports car.
words.translation: Notijorat kafe ortiqcha mablag‘ni rahbarning sport mashinasiga emas, ovqatga sarflaydi.

words.example: Our mutual aid group exchanges practical help, from shopping to rescuing flat-pack furniture.
words.translation: O‘zaro yordam guruhimiz xariddan yig‘ma mebelni qutqarishgacha amaliy ko‘mak almashadi.

words.example: Inclusion means arranging the event so everyone can join, not merely printing a friendly poster.
words.translation: Inklyuziya faqat do‘stona plakat bosish emas, tadbirni hamma qatnasha oladigan qilishdir.

words.example: The ban on loud music made our park's birds easier to hear.
words.translation: Baland musiqa taqiqi bog‘imizdagi qushlarni yaxshiroq eshittirdi.

words.example: The parking fine cost more than the lunch I had rushed to buy.
words.translation: Mashina qo‘yish jarimasi shoshilib olgan tushligimdan qimmat bo‘ldi.

words.example: The council imposed a sanction after repeated dumping, not after one untidy picnic.
words.translation: Kengash bitta tartibsiz piknikdan keyin emas, takroriy chiqindi tashlashdan keyin jazo chorasi qo‘lladi.

words.example: The notice says dumping furniture is an offence, even if the sofa is quite attractive.
words.translation: E’londa divan chiroyli bo‘lsa ham, mebel tashlab ketish huquqbuzarlik ekani yozilgan.

words.example: Consistent enforcement made the cycle lane useful to cyclists again.
words.translation: Qoidalarni izchil amalga oshirish velosiped yo‘lagini yana velosipedchilarga foydali qildi.

words.example: At the checkpoint, staff inspected bags more carefully than I had packed mine.
words.translation: Nazorat joyida xodimlar sumkalarni men o‘zimnikini joylaganimdan diqqatliroq tekshirdi.

words.example: The evacuation drill taught us which door to use without following the crowd blindly.
words.translation: Evakuatsiya mashqi olomonga ko‘r-ko‘rona ergashmay qaysi eshikdan chiqishni o‘rgatdi.

words.example: As a precaution, we secured the loose banner before the wind joined the festival.
words.translation: Ehtiyot chorasi sifatida shamol bayramga qo‘shilmasidan oldin bo‘sh bannerni mahkamladik.

words.example: The trailing cable was a hazard, not an exciting test of balance.
words.translation: Osilib yotgan sim muvozanatning qiziqarli sinovi emas, xavf edi.

words.example: The warning about wet paint arrived just before my curious hand.
words.translation: Ho‘l bo‘yoq ogohlantirishi qiziquvchan qo‘limdan bir lahza oldin yetib keldi.

words.example: Safety at the fair matters more than fitting one extra stall beside the exit.
words.translation: Yarmarkada xavfsizlik chiqish yoniga yana bitta rasta sig‘dirishdan muhimroq.

words.example: Our permit allowed a street event, not an unlimited midnight concert.
words.translation: Ruxsatnomamiz cheksiz tungi konsertga emas, ko‘cha tadbiriga ruxsat berdi.

words.example: The rules prohibit feeding the pigeons, despite their persuasive expressions.
words.translation: Qoidalar kaptarlarning ishontiruvchi yuzlariga qaramay, ularga yem berishni taqiqlaydi.

words.example: We did not trespass just to retrieve a football with poor navigation skills.
words.translation: Yo‘l topishi yomon futbol to‘pini olish uchungina begona hududga ruxsatsiz kirmadik.

words.example: The broken benches were the result of vandalism, not an unusual design choice.
words.translation: Singan o‘rindiqlar noodatiy dizayn emas, vandalizm natijasi edi.

words.example: Volunteers removed graffiti from the sign so visitors could find the library again.
words.translation: Ko‘ngillilar ko‘rsatkichdagi yozuvlarni o‘chirib, mehmonlarga kutubxonani yana topish imkonini berdi.

words.example: The cordon kept spectators away from the damaged wall, including one unusually curious uncle.
words.translation: To‘siq tomoshabinlarni, jumladan juda qiziquvchan bir amakini shikastlangan devordan uzoqda tutdi.

words.example: The committee reopened the discussion after residents supplied a map nobody had seen.
words.translation: Aholi hech kim ko‘rmagan xaritani bergach, qo‘mita muhokamani qayta ochdi.

words.example: The bylaw explains when dogs need leads, even very charming dogs.
words.translation: Mahalliy qoida hatto juda yoqimtoy itlarni ham qachon tasma bilan yuritish kerakligini tushuntiradi.

words.example: The speed limit outside the school is not a suggestion for confident drivers.
words.translation: Maktab oldidagi tezlik chegarasi o‘ziga ishongan haydovchilar uchun shunchaki tavsiya emas.

words.example: Traffic calming made our street less attractive to drivers in a dramatic hurry.
words.translation: Tezlikni kamaytirish choralari ko‘chamizni juda shoshqaloq haydovchilarga kamroq jozibali qildi.

words.example: The temporary curfew meant our evening walk became a tour of the hallway.
words.translation: Vaqtinchalik komendantlik soati oqshom sayrimizni dahliz bo‘ylab sayohatga aylantirdi.

words.example: A second signature is a safeguard against one person's expensive mistake.
words.translation: Ikkinchi imzo bir kishining qimmat xatosiga qarshi himoya chorasi.

words.example: We abide by the noise rules even when the birthday singer feels particularly talented.
words.translation: Tug‘ilgan kun xonandasi o‘zini juda iste’dodli his qilsa ham, shovqin qoidalariga amal qilamiz.

words.example: Please notify the council about the broken streetlight before the moon applies for overtime.
words.translation: Oy ortiqcha ishga ariza bermasidan oldin buzilgan ko‘cha chirog‘i haqida kengashga xabar bering.

words.example: The painting cost more than its subject's house.
words.translation: Rasm unda tasvirlangan odamning uyidan qimmat turdi.

words.example: My portrait has better hair than I do.
words.translation: Portretimning sochi menikidan chiroyliroq.

words.example: This sketch began as a coffee stain.
words.translation: Bu xomaki chizma qahva dog‘idan boshlandi.

words.example: Her drawing made our ordinary shed look royal.
words.translation: Uning rasmi oddiy omborchamizni shohona ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: The sculpture frightened pigeons but impressed visitors.
words.translation: Haykal kabutarlarni qo‘rqitdi, mehmonlarni esa hayratlantirdi.

words.example: The sculptor gave the mayor enormous ears.
words.translation: Haykaltarosh hokimga ulkan quloqlar yasadi.

words.example: The blank canvas looked more confident than me.
words.translation: Bo‘sh mato mendan dadilroq ko‘rinardi.

words.example: My easel stood straighter than my painted tower.
words.translation: Molbertim chizgan minoramdan tikroq turardi.

words.example: My palette looked better than the finished picture.
words.translation: Bo‘yoq taxtacham tayyor rasmdan chiroyliroq ko‘rindi.

words.example: Rain added its own ideas to my watercolour.
words.translation: Yomg‘ir akvarel rasmimga o‘z g‘oyalarini qo‘shdi.

words.example: The ink reached my sleeve before the paper.
words.translation: Siyoh qog‘ozdan oldin yengimga yetdi.

words.example: Charcoal gave my fingers a dramatic new colour.
words.translation: Rasm ko‘miri barmoqlarimga ta’sirli yangi rang berdi.

words.example: Our mural turned a dull wall into a jungle.
words.translation: Devoriy rasmimiz zerikarli devorni o‘rmonga aylantirdi.

words.example: My collage includes last week's shopping list.
words.translation: Kollajimga o‘tgan haftadagi xarid ro‘yxati ham kirgan.

words.example: The abstract painting reminded Dad of burnt toast.

words.meaning: xodimlar ish haqi hisobi va ro‘yxati

words.example: Coffee is our café's most essential import.

words.meaning: katta hajmda bir xil mahsulot ishlab chiqarish

words.example: The custom-made desk fits my room and my long legs.

words.example: The freight included chairs, lamps, and one enormous teapot.
words.translation: Yuk tarkibida kursilar, chiroqlar va bitta ulkan choynak bor edi.

words.translation: Kema yukidan ajoyib yangi apelsin hidi kelardi.

words.translation: Og‘ir kursilardan oldin tortlarni tushiring.

words.example: The barcode was easier to read than my handwriting.

words.example: The fragile vase travelled with more protection than I did.

words.translation: Ehtiyotkor tashish barcha shokolad quyonlarning qulog‘ini butun saqladi.

words.meaning: ish bajarish uchun rasmiy narx taklifi

words.meaning: sotib olish yoki ish bajarish taklifi

words.example: One bidder raised a hand just to ask for water.

words.translation: Ulkan ekran olishga sabab mayda matnni hamma o‘qiy olishi edi.

words.example: Maintain a steady pace rather than working like a frightened squirrel.
words.translation: Qo‘rqqan olmaxondek ishlashdan ko‘ra barqaror sur’atni saqlang.

words.example: Preserve the original meaning when you shorten my unusually long sentence.
words.translation: G‘ayrioddiy uzun gapimni qisqartirganda asl ma’noni saqlang.

words.example: We can retain the useful sections and release the others into retirement.
words.translation: Foydali bo‘limlarni saqlab, qolganlarini nafaqaga chiqarishimiz mumkin.

words.example: We voted to reinstate the old rule after its replacement needed six pages of explanation.
words.translation: Yangi qoida olti sahifa izoh talab qilgach, eskisini tiklashga ovoz berdik.

words.example: New evidence made us reverse our decision about the supposedly brilliant gadget.
words.translation: Yangi dalil go‘yoki ajoyib qurilma haqidagi qarorimizni teskarisiga o‘zgartirishga majbur qildi.

words.example: They plan to reform the process so one request does not need six signatures.
words.translation: Bitta so‘rovga oltita imzo kerak bo‘lmasligi uchun jarayonni isloh qilmoqchilar.

words.example: The feedback helped reshape our argument into something less like a maze.
words.translation: Fikr-mulohazalar dalilimizni labirintga kamroq o‘xshaydigan shaklga keltirishga yordam berdi.

words.example: A promising result can renew enthusiasm even on a wet Monday.
words.translation: Umidli natija hatto yomg‘irli dushanbada ham ishtiyoqni yangilashi mumkin.

words.example: Please extend the deadline, not the list of additional tasks.
words.translation: Qo‘shimcha vazifalar ro‘yxatini emas, muddatni uzaytiring.

words.example: One reliable source can strengthen your argument more than ten exclamation marks.
words.translation: Bitta ishonchli manba dalilingizni o‘nta undov belgisidan ko‘proq kuchaytirishi mumkin.

words.example: Ignoring the awkward facts will weaken your case, however loudly you speak.
words.translation: Qanchalik baland gapirsangiz ham, noqulay faktlarni e’tiborsiz qoldirish dalilingizni zaiflashtiradi.

words.example: We expect the numbers to stabilise once everyone understands the question.
words.translation: Hamma savolni tushungach, raqamlar barqarorlashishini kutyapmiz.

words.example: The two proposals are similar, apart from one having a helicopter budget.
words.translation: Ikkala taklif o‘xshash, faqat birida vertolyot uchun budjet bor.

words.example: A different title will not fix the same old problem.
words.translation: Boshqa sarlavha o‘sha eski muammoni tuzatmaydi.

words.example: Give both ideas equal attention, even if one arrives in a fancier folder.
words.translation: Biri chiroyliroq jildda kelsa ham, ikkala g‘oyaga teng e’tibor bering.

words.example: The supposedly new plan is identical to yesterday's, including the spelling mistake.
words.translation: Go‘yoki yangi reja kechagisi bilan, hatto imlo xatosigacha bir xil.

words.example: This shortcut gives an equivalent result without the twelve extra clicks.
words.translation: Bu qisqa yo‘l o‘n ikki ortiqcha bosishsiz teng natija beradi.

words.example: The results are comparable only if both groups had the same amount of coffee.
words.translation: Natijalarni faqat ikkala guruh bir xil miqdorda qahva ichgan bo‘lsa qiyoslash mumkin.

words.example: These are two distinct issues, despite sharing one extremely long email.
words.translation: Bitta juda uzun xatda bo‘lsa ham, bular ikkita alohida masala.

words.example: A diverse group provides more perspectives than five copies of me.
words.translation: Turli odamlardan iborat guruh mening beshta nusxamdan ko‘proq qarash beradi.

words.example: Absolute certainty is difficult when your evidence is a blurry photograph.
words.translation: Dalilingiz xira surat bo‘lsa, mutlaq ishonch qiyin.

words.example: Her answers are consistent, unlike the office temperature.
words.translation: Uning javoblari ofis haroratidan farqli ravishda izchil.

words.example: The instructions are inconsistent: one page says wait and the next says hurry.
words.translation: Ko‘rsatmalar zid: bir sahifa kuting desa, keyingisi shoshiling deydi.

words.meaning: birga ishlashga yoki mos kelishga yaroqli
words.example: Our aims are compatible, although our preferred meeting times certainly are not.
words.translation: Maqsadlarimiz mos, ammo afzal ko‘rgan yig‘ilish vaqtlarimiz aniq mos emas.

words.example: These two rules are incompatible unless employees can be in two places at once.
words.translation: Xodimlar bir paytda ikki joyda bo‘lolmasa, bu ikki qoida bir-biriga mos emas.

words.example: A superior method should do more than have a longer name.
words.translation: Ustun usul faqat uzunroq nomga ega bo‘lishdan ko‘proq ish qilishi kerak.

words.example: The cheaper version is not automatically inferior, despite its modest box.
words.translation: Oddiy qutisiga qaramay, arzonroq nusxa o‘z-o‘zidan sifatsizroq bo‘lib qolmaydi.

words.example: This is a unique solution, which is not always a compliment.
words.translation: Bu o‘ziga xos yechim, bu esa har doim maqtov emas.

words.example: A common mistake is confusing a colourful chart with a clear one.
words.translation: Rangli diagrammani tushunarli diagramma deb bilish keng tarqalgan xato.

words.example: This is a typical example of solving a small problem with a giant machine.
words.translation: Bu kichik muammoni ulkan uskuna bilan hal qilishning odatiy misoli.

words.example: The unusual result made us check whether the sensor was attached to the cat.
words.translation: Noodatiy natija datchik mushukka ulanganmi deb tekshirishimizga sabab bo‘ldi.

words.example: Explain the idea in ordinary language before inventing three abbreviations.
words.translation: Uchta qisqartma o‘ylab topishdan oldin g‘oyani oddiy tilda tushuntiring.

words.example: Her exceptional memory includes every promise I hoped she had forgotten.
words.translation: Uning ajoyib xotirasi men unutgan deb umid qilgan har bir va’dani ham saqlaydi.

words.example: We returned to our respective tasks after jointly losing the same key.
words.translation: Bir kalitni birgalikda yo‘qotgach, har birimiz o‘z vazifamizga qaytdik.

words.example: Our mutual dislike of long meetings helped us reach agreement quickly.
words.translation: Uzun yig‘ilishlarni ikkovimiz ham yoqtirmasligimiz tez kelishishimizga yordam berdi.

words.example: The teams ran parallel trials and discovered different ways to break the same button.
words.translation: Jamoalar parallel sinovlar o‘tkazib, bir tugmani buzishning turli yo‘llarini topishdi.

words.example: Put each answer beside its corresponding question, not beside your favourite drawing.
words.translation: Har bir javobni sevimli rasmingiz yoniga emas, mos savol yoniga qo‘ying.

words.example: The logical next step is testing the idea, not ordering a statue of its inventor.
words.translation: Keyingi mantiqiy qadam ixtirochiga haykal buyurtma qilish emas, g‘oyani sinash.

words.example: A rational decision is easier after lunch than during a biscuit shortage.
words.translation: Oqilona qaror qabul qilish pechenye tanqisligida emas, tushlikdan keyin osonroq.

words.example: Try to be objective about the design, even though your nephew drew it.
words.translation: Dizaynni jiyaningiz chizgan bo‘lsa ham, xolis bo‘lishga harakat qiling.

words.example: The claim that purple is professional is rather subjective.
words.translation: Binafsha rang professional degan da’vo ancha subyektiv.

words.example: The chairperson stayed neutral during the fierce debate about chair colours.
words.translation: Rais stul ranglari haqidagi qizg‘in bahsda betaraf qoldi.

words.example: The survey may be biased because only pizza lovers received it.
words.translation: So‘rov biryoqlama bo‘lishi mumkin, chunki uni faqat pitsa ishqibozlari olgan.

words.example: A balanced review mentions both the excellent screen and the tragic battery.
words.translation: Xolis taqriz ajoyib ekranni ham, achinarli batareyani ham tilga oladi.

words.example: Her explanation was convincing until the missing file appeared on her desktop.
words.translation: Yo‘qolgan fayl uning ish stolida paydo bo‘lguncha izohi ishonarli edi.

words.example: It seems doubtful that twelve people will fit around this tiny table.
words.translation: O‘n ikki odam bu kichik stol atrofiga sig‘ishi shubhali ko‘rinadi.

words.example: The answer was obvious once someone switched the monitor on.
words.translation: Kimdir monitorni yoqqach, javob ayon bo‘ldi.

words.example: The apparent success disappeared when we noticed the machine was unplugged.
words.translation: Uskuna tokdan uzilganini payqaganimizda ko‘ringan muvaffaqiyat yo‘qqa chiqdi.

words.example: Her relief was evident when the final slide finally appeared.
words.translation: Oxirgi slayd nihoyat paydo bo‘lganda uning yengil tortgani yaqqol sezildi.

words.example: The instructions were explicit: no glitter near the keyboard.
words.translation: Ko‘rsatmalar aniq edi: klaviatura yonida yaltiroq kukun bo‘lmasin.

words.example: There was an implicit agreement that nobody would mention the burnt toast.
words.translation: Kuygan tostni hech kim tilga olmasligi haqida aytilmagan kelishuv bor edi.

words.meaning: ikki xil talqin qilish mumkin bo‘lgan
words.example: The ambiguous title made half the class bring paints instead of essays.
words.translation: Ikki ma’noli sarlavha tufayli sinfning yarmi insho o‘rniga bo‘yoq olib keldi.

words.example: Give a precise time, not sometime after the pigeons wake up.
words.translation: Kabutarlar uyg‘ongandan keyin bir payt emas, aniq vaqt ayting.

words.example: His vague directions included the helpful phrase somewhere over there.
words.translation: Uning noaniq yo‘l ko‘rsatmasida ana o‘sha tarafda degan foydali ibora bor edi.

words.example: Your example is entertaining, but is the tap-dancing hamster relevant?
words.translation: Misolingiz qiziq, ammo raqs tushadigan xomyak mavzuga aloqadormi?

words.example: The colour of my socks is irrelevant to the accuracy of my calculation.
words.translation: Paypog‘im rangi hisobimning aniqligiga aloqasiz.

words.example: That is a valid criticism, even if it arrived on a napkin.
words.translation: Salfetkaga yozilgan bo‘lsa ham, bu asosli tanqid.

words.example: The conclusion is invalid because the two groups answered different questions.
words.translation: Ikki guruh boshqa-boshqa savollarga javob bergani uchun xulosa asossiz.

words.example: The explanation became coherent once the three unrelated dinosaurs were removed.
words.translation: Aloqasiz uchta dinozavr olib tashlangach, izoh izchil bo‘ldi.

words.example: The flawed method counted my second cup as a second person.
words.translation: Nuqsonli usul ikkinchi piyolamni ikkinchi odam deb sanadi.

words.example: A credible source usually offers more than a dramatic headline.
words.translation: Ishonchli manba odatda shov-shuvli sarlavhadan ko‘proq narsa taqdim etadi.

words.example: The misleading chart made a tiny increase look like a mountain.
words.translation: Chalg‘ituvchi diagramma kichik o‘sishni tog‘dek ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: A working alarm is essential if your plan depends on waking up.
words.translation: Rejangiz uyg‘onishga bog‘liq bo‘lsa, ishlaydigan budilnik juda zarur.

words.example: This detail is vital: the meeting is online, not on the roof.
words.translation: Bu tafsilot nihoyatda muhim: yig‘ilish tomda emas, onlayn bo‘ladi.

words.example: The crucial question is whether anyone actually needs this invention.
words.translation: Hal qiluvchi savol — bu ixtiro biror kishiga haqiqatan kerakmi?

words.example: There was a significant improvement when we stopped using invisible ink.
words.translation: Ko‘rinmas siyohdan foydalanishni to‘xtatgach, sezilarli yaxshilanish bo‘ldi.

words.example: A minor spelling error gave our product a rather unfortunate name.
words.translation: Kichik imlo xatosi mahsulotimizga ancha noqulay nom berdi.

words.example: The major difficulty is that nobody knows where the original file lives.
words.translation: Asosiy qiyinchilik asl fayl qayerda yashashini hech kim bilmasligidir.

words.example: The central argument should not hide in a footnote.
words.translation: Asosiy dalil izoh ostiga yashirinmasligi kerak.

words.example: The basic idea fits on a postcard, unlike the explanation.
words.translation: Asosiy g‘oya izohdan farqli ravishda otkritkaga sig‘adi.

words.example: There is a fundamental difference between measuring and hoping.
words.translation: O‘lchash bilan umid qilish o‘rtasida tub farq bor.

words.example: Our primary aim is clarity, not winning a prize for long words.
words.translation: Asosiy maqsadimiz uzun so‘zlar uchun mukofot olish emas, aniqlik.

words.example: The font is a secondary concern when the report contains no facts.
words.translation: Hisobotda fakt bo‘lmasa, shrift ikkinchi darajali masala.

words.example: My initial reaction was confusion, followed by a search for coffee.
words.translation: Dastlabki munosabatim chalkashlik bo‘ldi, undan keyin qahva qidirdim.

words.example: The final version should not be called final again seven times.
words.translation: Yakuniy nusxa yana yetti marta yakuniy deb nomlanmasligi kerak.

words.example: The overall result was good, despite the dramatic collapse of one chart.
words.translation: Bitta diagrammaning keskin buzilishiga qaramay, umumiy natija yaxshi bo‘ldi.

words.example: Give a general overview before describing every screw in the machine.
words.translation: Uskunadagi har bir vintni tasvirlashdan oldin umumiy ma’lumot bering.

words.example: We need a specific example, preferably one that happened outside your imagination.
words.translation: Bizga aniq misol kerak, yaxshisi xayolingizdan tashqarida yuz bergani.

words.example: This particular method works only if nobody eats the counters.
words.translation: Aynan shu usul sanash buyumlarini hech kim yemasa ishlaydi.

words.example: We have broad agreement, except about the date, place, cost, and purpose.
words.translation: Sana, joy, xarajat va maqsaddan tashqari umumiy kelishuvimiz bor.

words.example: The comprehensive guide even explains what to do if the help button fails.
words.translation: Keng qamrovli qo‘llanma hatto yordam tugmasi ishlamasa nima qilishni ham tushuntiradi.

words.example: Our limited evidence does not justify such unlimited confidence.
words.translation: Cheklangan dalilimiz bunday cheksiz ishonchni oqlamaydi.

words.example: One clear paragraph is sufficient; the extra six can rest.
words.translation: Bitta aniq xatboshi yetarli; ortiqcha oltitasi dam olishi mumkin.

words.example: The evidence is insufficient, however impressive the cover looks.
words.translation: Muqova qanchalik ta’sirli ko‘rinsa ham, dalillar yetarli emas.

words.example: The room is adequate for six people, provided nobody brings a grand piano.
words.translation: Hech kim royal olib kelmasa, xona olti kishiga yetarli.

words.example: A pie chart is appropriate here, although an actual pie would be more popular.
words.translation: Bu yerda doiraviy diagramma mos, ammo haqiqiy pirog ko‘proq yoqardi.

words.example: A dancing emoji seemed inappropriate in the serious research summary.
words.translation: Jiddiy tadqiqot xulosasida raqsga tushadigan emoji noo‘rin ko‘rindi.

words.example: The second design is slightly better, mainly because it no longer falls over.
words.translation: Ikkinchi dizayn biroz yaxshiroq, asosan endi ag‘darilmagani uchun.

words.example: The explanation was somewhat clearer after we removed the singing example.
words.translation: Kuylaydigan misolni olib tashlagach, izoh birmuncha ravshanlashdi.

words.example: The report is rather long for something called a quick note.
words.translation: Tezkor qayd deb atalgan narsa uchun hisobot ancha uzun.

words.example: The instructions are fairly clear if you already know how everything works.
words.translation: Hamma narsa qanday ishlashini bilsangiz, ko‘rsatmalar anchagina tushunarli.

words.example: The idea is quite useful once you remove the unnecessary fireworks.
words.translation: Keraksiz mushaklarni olib tashlasangiz, g‘oya ancha foydali.

words.example: The task is relatively simple compared with explaining why we forgot it.
words.translation: Vazifa uni nega unutganimizni tushuntirishga qaraganda nisbatan oson.

words.example: This version is comparatively short at only forty pages.
words.translation: Bu nusxa bor-yo‘g‘i qirq sahifaligi bilan qiyosan qisqa.

words.example: The cost fell considerably when we removed the marble entrance.
words.translation: Marmar kirish qismini olib tashlaganimizda xarajat ancha kamaydi.

words.example: The revised plan is substantially cheaper and contains fewer imaginary machines.
words.translation: Qayta ishlangan reja sezilarli arzonroq va unda kamroq xayoliy uskuna bor.

words.example: People answered significantly faster when the questions stopped rhyming.
words.translation: Savollar qofiyalanmay qo‘ygach, odamlar sezilarli tezroq javob berishdi.

words.example: The problem was largely solved by moving the plug closer to the socket.
words.translation: Muammo asosan vilkani rozetkaga yaqinlashtirish orqali hal qilindi.

words.example: The responses were mostly positive, apart from one complaint about the biscuits.
words.translation: Pechenye haqidagi bitta shikoyatdan tashqari javoblarning aksariyati ijobiy edi.

words.example: The delay was mainly caused by our discussion about avoiding delays.
words.translation: Kechikishga asosan kechikishlardan qochish haqidagi muhokamamiz sabab bo‘ldi.

words.example: The result was partly luck and partly reading the instructions.
words.translation: Natija qisman omad, qisman ko‘rsatmalarni o‘qish tufayli bo‘ldi.

words.example: The question was partially answered before the microphone gave up.
words.translation: Mikrofon taslim bo‘lishidan oldin savolga qisman javob berildi.

words.example: The estimate was entirely wrong, but the handwriting was excellent.
words.translation: Hisob butunlay noto‘g‘ri edi, lekin yozuv ajoyib edi.

words.example: I completely understand the method now that the diagram is the right way up.
words.translation: Chizma to‘g‘ri aylantirilgach, usulni to‘liq tushundim.

words.example: There is absolutely no evidence that my lucky mug improves accuracy.
words.translation: Omadli krujkam aniqlikni oshirishiga mutlaqo dalil yo‘q.

words.example: The two versions are virtually identical, except for a more expensive cover.
words.translation: Qimmatroq muqovadan tashqari ikki nusxa deyarli bir xil.

words.example: The explanation almost made sense until the talking triangle appeared.
words.translation: Gapiradigan uchburchak paydo bo‘lguncha izoh deyarli tushunarli edi.

words.example: Nearly everyone agreed, including the person who had misunderstood the question.
words.translation: Deyarli hamma, jumladan, savolni noto‘g‘ri tushungan odam ham rozi bo‘ldi.

words.example: The conclusion barely fits on the page because the introduction ate all the space.
words.translation: Kirish hamma joyni yeb qo‘ygani uchun xulosa sahifaga zo‘rg‘a sig‘adi.

words.example: One lucky result is hardly enough to announce a scientific revolution.
words.translation: Bitta omadli natija ilmiy inqilob e’lon qilish uchun deyarli yetmaydi.

words.example: I merely asked for an example, not your complete life story.
words.translation: Men shunchaki misol so‘radim, butun hayotingiz hikoyasini emas.

words.example: Strictly speaking, a guess in a suit is still a guess.
words.translation: Aniq aytganda, kostyum kiygan taxmin hamon taxmindir.

words.example: The plan is attractive; however, it requires a building we do not own.
words.translation: Reja jozibali; biroq u bizga tegishli bo‘lmagan binoni talab qiladi.

words.example: The first attempt failed; nevertheless, the team kept its biscuits and its hope.
words.translation: Birinchi urinish muvaffaqiyatsiz bo‘ldi; shunga qaramay, jamoa pechenyesini ham, umidini ham saqladi.

words.example: The evidence was limited; nonetheless, it gave us something better than a hunch.
words.translation: Dalillar cheklangan edi; shunday bo‘lsa-da, ular bizga sezgidan yaxshiroq asos berdi.

words.example: The key is missing; therefore, admiring the door will not get us inside.
words.translation: Kalit yo‘q; shuning uchun eshikka qoyil qolish bizni ichkariga kiritmaydi.

words.example: We shortened the form, thus saving everyone several unnecessary sighs.
words.translation: Shaklni qisqartirdik, shu tariqa hammani bir necha keraksiz xo‘rsinishdan qutqardik.

words.example: Nobody checked the address, hence our unexpected visit to a dance studio.
words.translation: Hech kim manzilni tekshirmadi, shu sababli kutilmaganda raqs studiyasiga bordik.

words.example: The instructions omitted a page; consequently, our shelf had a mysterious extra leg.
words.translation: Ko‘rsatmalarda bir sahifa yo‘q edi; natijada tokchamizning sirli ortiqcha oyog‘i bor edi.

words.example: The budget is smaller, so we must adjust our helicopter plans accordingly.
words.translation: Budjet kichikroq, shuning uchun vertolyot rejalarimizni shunga moslashtirishimiz kerak.

words.example: The method is slow; moreover, it requires three people to hold one ruler.
words.translation: Usul sekin; bundan tashqari, bitta chizg‘ichni ushlash uchun uch kishi kerak.

words.example: The design is affordable; furthermore, it does not need batteries to be a chair.
words.translation: Dizayn hamyonbop; bundan tashqari, stul bo‘lishi uchun batareya kerak emas.

words.example: We lack evidence; besides, your cousin's dream is not a reliable source.
words.translation: Dalilimiz kam; bundan tashqari, amakivachchangizning tushi ishonchli manba emas.

words.example: Label the samples; otherwise, tomorrow's research will become a guessing contest.
words.translation: Namunalarga yorliq qo‘ying; aks holda ertangi tadqiqot topishmoq musobaqasiga aylanadi.

words.example: We could argue for an hour or test the idea instead.
words.translation: Bir soat bahslashishimiz yoki buning o‘rniga g‘oyani sinashimiz mumkin.

words.example: We can write a long report; alternatively, one clear diagram may do.
words.translation: Uzun hisobot yozishimiz mumkin; boshqa yo‘l sifatida bitta aniq chizma yetishi mumkin.

words.example: The first group disliked the noise; similarly, the second group requested earplugs.
words.translation: Birinchi guruh shovqinni yoqtirmadi; xuddi shunday, ikkinchi guruh quloq tiqinlarini so‘radi.

words.example: Her summary was brief; likewise, mine left room for readers to breathe.
words.translation: Uning xulosasi qisqa edi; xuddi shuningdek, menikisi ham o‘quvchilarga nafas olishga joy qoldirdi.

words.example: More detail can help experts; conversely, it may frighten beginners away.
words.translation: Ko‘proq tafsilot mutaxassislarga yordam beradi; aksincha, boshlovchilarni qo‘rqitib yuborishi mumkin.

words.example: The old method needs ten steps, whereas the new one needs two and a biscuit.
words.translation: Eski usulga o‘n qadam kerak, yangisiga esa ikki qadam va bitta pechenye.

words.example: Although the answer is short, finding it took most of my weekend.
words.translation: Javob qisqa bo‘lsa-da, uni topish dam olish kunimning ko‘p qismini oldi.

words.example: Despite the impressive title, the report mostly discusses missing teaspoons.
words.translation: Ta’sirli sarlavhasiga qaramay, hisobot asosan yo‘qolgan choy qoshiqlarini muhokama qiladi.

words.example: We debated the best method; meanwhile, Sara quietly finished the task.
words.translation: Biz eng yaxshi usulni muhokama qildik; shu orada Sara jimgina vazifani tugatdi.

words.example: The error was spotted and subsequently blamed on a very innocent keyboard.
words.translation: Xato aniqlandi va keyin ayb juda begunoh klaviaturaga yuklandi.

words.example: Previously, we stored everything in a folder called find this later.
words.translation: Ilgari hamma narsani keyin top deb nomlangan papkada saqlardik.

words.example: Eventually, the committee agreed that the original idea was perfectly fine.
words.translation: Oxir-oqibat qo‘mita dastlabki g‘oya juda yaxshi bo‘lganiga rozi bo‘ldi.

words.example: Ultimately, a useful answer matters more than an impressive throat-clearing introduction.
words.translation: Oxir-oqibat foydali javob tomoq qirish bilan boshlangan ta’sirli kirishdan muhimroq.

words.example: The scope of the study does not include solving every problem in the universe.
words.translation: Tadqiqot qamroviga koinotdagi har bir muammoni yechish kirmaydi.

words.example: We underestimated the extent of the confusion until someone brought a ladder.
words.translation: Kimdir narvon olib kelguncha chalkashlik ko‘lamini past baholadik.

words.example: The responses cover a wide range, from sensible to wonderfully strange.
words.translation: Javoblar oqilonadan ajoyib g‘alatigacha bo‘lgan keng doirani qamraydi.

words.example: A surprising proportion of the budget went on replacing lost pens.
words.translation: Budjetning hayratlanarli ulushi yo‘qolgan ruchkalarni almashtirishga ketdi.

words.example: The quantity of evidence matters less if all of it comes from one confused person.
words.translation: Barcha dalil bitta chalkash odamdan kelsa, uning miqdori kamroq ahamiyatli.

words.example: The amount of detail should match the question, not your enthusiasm.
words.translation: Tafsilot miqdori ishtiyoqingizga emas, savolga mos bo‘lishi kerak.

words.example: The number of versions grew faster than our understanding of the problem.
words.translation: Nusxalar soni muammoni tushunishimizdan tezroq o‘sdi.

words.example: The regularity of these errors suggests a pattern, not a mischievous keyboard.
words.translation: Bu xatolarning muntazamligi sho‘x klaviaturani emas, bir qonuniyatni ko‘rsatadi.

words.example: The duration of the experiment depended on how long the battery felt cooperative.
words.translation: Tajriba davomiyligi batareya qancha vaqt hamkorlik qilishiga bog‘liq edi.

words.example: We checked the results at each interval, along with the remaining snacks.
words.translation: Har bir vaqt oralig‘ida natijalarni ham, qolgan yeguliklarni ham tekshirdik.

words.example: The sequence matters: open the box before attempting to use the keyboard.
words.translation: Ketma-ketlik muhim: klaviaturani ishlatishdan oldin qutini oching.

words.example: The distribution of tasks was uneven, especially near the person pretending to be busy.
words.translation: Vazifalar notekis taqsimlandi, ayniqsa o‘zini band ko‘rsatgan odam atrofida.

words.example: Some variation is normal, unless every answer is a different planet.
words.translation: Har bir javob boshqa sayyora bo‘lmasa, ma’lum farqlanish tabiiy.

words.example: The diversity of opinions made the discussion useful and the summary difficult.
words.translation: Fikrlar xilma-xilligi muhokamani foydali, xulosani esa qiyin qildi.

words.example: The complexity increased when someone suggested colour-coding the colour codes.
words.translation: Kimdir rang kodlarini ham rang bilan belgilashni taklif qilganda murakkablik oshdi.

words.example: The simplicity of her answer made our enormous diagram look embarrassed.
words.translation: Javobining soddaligi ulkan chizmamizni uyalgandek ko‘rsatdi.

words.example: Clarity improved after we stopped calling everything a thing.
words.translation: Hamma narsani narsa deb atashni to‘xtatgach, ravshanlik oshdi.

words.example: The ambiguity in the invitation explains why I arrived with painting equipment.
words.translation: Taklifnomadagi ikki ma’nolilik nega bo‘yash asboblari bilan kelganimni tushuntiradi.

words.example: Consistency would be easier if the instructions did not change every Tuesday.
words.translation: Ko‘rsatmalar har seshanba o‘zgarmasa, izchillik osonroq bo‘lardi.

words.example: The repeated example gives the essay continuity, although the duck is getting tired.
words.translation: Takrorlanuvchi misol inshoga bog‘liqlik beradi, garchi o‘rdak charchayotgan bo‘lsa ham.

words.example: The stability of the results improved once we stopped moving the sensor.
words.translation: Datchikni ko‘chirishni to‘xtatgach, natijalar barqarorligi yaxshilandi.

words.example: Some flexibility is useful when your perfect plan meets a cancelled bus.
words.translation: Mukammal rejangiz bekor qilingan avtobusga duch kelganda biroz moslashuvchanlik foydali.

words.example: The odds of finishing early improve when we actually begin.
words.translation: Haqiqatan boshlaganimizda erta tugatish ehtimoli oshadi.

words.example: The likelihood of mistakes increases when the deadline approaches and the coffee disappears.
words.translation: Muddat yaqinlashib, qahva tugaganda xato ehtimoli ortadi.

words.example: Consider the possibility that the simple explanation is actually correct.
words.translation: Oddiy izoh haqiqatan to‘g‘ri bo‘lishi mumkinligini hisobga oling.

words.example: One beginner's question gave us more insight than our hour-long discussion.
words.translation: Bitta boshlovchining savoli bir soatlik muhokamadan ko‘proq tushuncha berdi.

words.example: The diagram improved comprehension until someone added fourteen mysterious arrows.
words.translation: Kimdir o‘n to‘rtta sirli strelka qo‘shguncha chizma tushunishni yaxshiladi.

words.example: The colourful cover changed my perception of a very ordinary report.
words.translation: Rangli muqova juda oddiy hisobot haqidagi tasavvurimni o‘zgartirdi.

words.example: Recognition of the error came just after we printed two hundred copies.
words.translation: Xatoni ikki yuz nusxa chop etganimizdan sal keyin tanib oldik.

words.example: The realisation that we had measured the wrong table brought a thoughtful silence.
words.translation: Noto‘g‘ri stolni o‘lchaganimizni anglash o‘ychan sukunat keltirdi.

words.example: We could theorise all afternoon, or we could ask the person who built it.
words.translation: Tushdan keyin davomida taxmin yuritishimiz yoki uni qurgan odamdan so‘rashimiz mumkin.

words.example: Without data, the discussion is mostly speculation wearing a serious expression.
words.translation: Ma’lumotsiz muhokama asosan jiddiy qiyofaga kirgan taxmindir.

words.example: He spoke with certainty until the calculator politely disagreed.
words.translation: Kalkulyator muloyimlik bilan qarshi chiqmaguncha u qat’iy ishonch bilan gapirdi.

words.meaning: fikr yoki rejani qayta o‘ylab ko‘rmoq
words.example: We should rethink the explanation if it needs a second explanation to make sense.
words.translation: Izohni tushunish uchun yana bir izoh kerak bo‘lsa, uni qayta o‘ylab ko‘rishimiz kerak.

words.example: A common misconception is that more slides automatically mean more knowledge.
words.translation: Ko‘proq slayd o‘z-o‘zidan ko‘proq bilim degani keng tarqalgan noto‘g‘ri tushuncha.

words.example: My intuition suggested trouble when the instructions began with good luck.
words.translation: Ko‘rsatmalar omad tilaymiz deb boshlanganda ichki sezgim muammo borligini aytdi.

words.example: Objectivity is difficult when you are judging a cake you baked yourself.
words.translation: O‘zingiz pishirgan tortni baholaganda xolislik qiyin.

words.example: The subjectivity of taste explains our three-hour argument about the logo.
words.translation: Didning subyektivligi logotip haqidagi uch soatlik bahsimizni tushuntiradi.

words.example: My bias towards short reports may be linked to my love of free evenings.
words.translation: Qisqa hisobotlarga yon bosishim bo‘sh oqshomlarni sevishimga bog‘liq bo‘lishi mumkin.

words.example: We reached a consensus that the next discussion should contain fewer discussions.
words.translation: Keyingi muhokamada kamroq muhokama bo‘lishi kerak degan umumiy kelishuvga keldik.

words.example: The proposal caused controversy by suggesting that meetings could happen without biscuits.
words.translation: Yig‘ilishlarni pechenyesiz o‘tkazish taklifi katta bahs tug‘dirdi.

words.example: The dispute concerned the data, although the argument sounded personal to the calculator.
words.translation: Kelishmovchilik ma’lumotlar haqida edi, ammo bahs kalkulyatorga shaxsiydek eshitildi.

words.example: Her criticism was useful: apparently, a conclusion needs more than finally.
words.translation: Uning tanqidi foydali edi: aftidan, xulosaga nihoyat so‘zidan ko‘proq narsa kerak.

words.example: One counterexample ruined his claim that every silent person was asleep.
words.translation: Bitta qarshi misol uning har bir jim odam uxlayapti degan da’vosini buzdi.

words.example: The traffic analogy helped until someone asked where the data parks.
words.translation: Yo‘l harakatiga o‘xshatish kimdir ma’lumotlar qayerda to‘xtashini so‘raguncha yordam berdi.

words.example: The comparison is unfair because one team had a calculator and the other had hope.
words.translation: Bir jamoada kalkulyator, boshqasida umid bo‘lgani uchun taqqoslash adolatsiz.

words.example: My deduction was simple: warm tea meant someone had recently escaped the meeting.
words.translation: Xulosam oddiy edi: iliq choy kimdir yaqinda yig‘ilishdan qochganini anglatardi.

words.example: The final synthesis joined our ideas without preserving every argument about commas.
words.translation: Yakuniy umumlashtirish vergullar haqidagi har bir bahsni saqlamay, g‘oyalarimizni birlashtirdi.

words.example: Calling every new app confusing is a generalisation, though my uncle supports it.
words.translation: Har bir yangi ilovani chalkash deyish umumlashtirishdir, ammo amakim buni qo‘llaydi.

words.example: Fairness remained an abstraction until we had to divide one cake among seven people.
words.translation: Bitta tortni yetti kishiga bo‘lishga to‘g‘ri kelguncha adolat mavhum tushuncha bo‘lib qoldi.

words.example: In this hypothetical example, the printer works on the first attempt.
words.translation: Bu faraziy misolda printer birinchi urinishdayoq ishlaydi.

words.example: The theoretical solution is elegant; the actual cardboard keeps bending.
words.translation: Nazariy yechim nafis, haqiqiy karton esa egilaveradi.

words.example: The plan is feasible if we remove the underwater meeting room.
words.translation: Suvosti yig‘ilish xonasini olib tashlasak, rejani amalga oshirish mumkin.

words.example: A realistic estimate includes time for the printer's mysterious moods.
words.translation: Haqiqiy hisob printerning sirli kayfiyatlari uchun ham vaqtni hisobga oladi.

words.meaning: amalga oshishi qiyin; haqiqatga mos emas
words.example: It is unrealistic to expect silence from a room full of beginners and new gadgets.
words.translation: Boshlovchilar va yangi qurilmalar to‘la xonadan sukunat kutish haqiqatga mos emas.

words.example: The probable explanation is a loose cable, not a computer with feelings.
words.translation: Ehtimoli katta izoh hissiyotli kompyuter emas, bo‘shashgan kabel.

words.example: His explanation was improbable but much more entertaining than the truth.
words.translation: Izohi ehtimoldan yiroq, ammo haqiqatdan ancha qiziqarli edi.

words.example: That is a plausible explanation, unlike yesterday's theory about invisible ducks.
words.translation: Bu kechagi ko‘rinmas o‘rdaklar nazariyasidan farqli ravishda ishonarli izoh.

words.example: The implausible excuse involved a bus, a goat, and a missing spreadsheet.
words.translation: Ishonish qiyin bahonada avtobus, echki va yo‘qolgan elektron jadval bor edi.

words.example: Confusion was inevitable once both buttons were labelled start.
words.translation: Ikkala tugma ham boshlash deb belgilangach, chalkashlik muqarrar edi.

words.example: The delay was avoidable: someone could have checked the address.
words.translation: Kechikishning oldini olish mumkin edi: kimdir manzilni tekshirishi mumkin bo‘lgan.

words.example: Some noise is unavoidable when your experiment involves popping balloons.
words.translation: Tajribangiz shar yorishni o‘z ichiga olsa, biroz shovqinning oldini olib bo‘lmaydi.

words.example: The response was predictable: everyone voted for the shorter survey.
words.translation: Javobni oldindan bilish mumkin edi: hamma qisqaroq so‘rovga ovoz berdi.

words.example: The results are unpredictable when the measuring device is a sleepy volunteer.
words.translation: O‘lchash vositasi uyqusiragan ko‘ngilli bo‘lsa, natijalarni oldindan aytib bo‘lmaydi.

words.example: My agreement is conditional on the session ending before the bakery closes.
words.translation: Roziligim mashg‘ulot novvoyxona yopilmasidan tugashi shartiga bog‘liq.

words.example: The approval was unconditional, which made us check that we had heard correctly.
words.translation: Tasdiq shartsiz edi, shuning uchun to‘g‘ri eshitganimizni tekshirdik.

words.example: The conclusion is dependent on one figure that looks suspiciously like a doodle.
words.translation: Xulosa shubhali ravishda chizgiga o‘xshaydigan bitta raqamga bog‘liq.

words.example: The final exercise is optional, so my pencil has voted against it.
words.translation: Oxirgi mashq ixtiyoriy, shuning uchun qalamim unga qarshi ovoz berdi.

words.example: Attendance is compulsory, but enthusiasm cannot be measured at the door.
words.translation: Qatnashish majburiy, ammo ishtiyoqni eshik oldida o‘lchab bo‘lmaydi.

words.example: The restrictive format leaves room for an answer but hardly for a comma.
words.translation: Qattiq cheklovchi shaklda javobga joy bor, vergulga esa zo‘rg‘a.

words.example: Be selective with examples; readers do not need all thirty versions of your joke.
words.translation: Misollarni tanlab oling; o‘quvchilarga hazilingizning o‘ttizta talqini kerak emas.

words.example: An inclusive discussion gives quiet people a chance before the loudest person returns.
words.translation: Hamma qatnashadigan muhokama eng baland ovozli odam qaytguncha kamgaplarga ham imkon beradi.

words.example: Exclusive access to the data does not make your guesses more accurate.
words.translation: Ma’lumotlardan faqat siz foydalanishingiz taxminlaringizni aniqroq qilmaydi.

words.example: We need a viable solution, not a drawing that requires new laws of physics.
words.translation: Bizga fizikaning yangi qonunlarini talab qiladigan chizma emas, ishlaydigan yechim kerak.

words.example: Our tentative conclusion is that the sensor prefers being switched on.
words.translation: Dastlabki xulosamiz datchik yoqilgan bo‘lishni afzal ko‘rishidir.

words.example: I need to figure out why the simplest question has the longest answer.
words.translation: Eng oddiy savol nega eng uzun javobga ega ekanini tushunib olishim kerak.

words.example: Think through the consequences before promising free coffee forever.
words.translation: Abadiy bepul qahva va’da qilishdan oldin oqibatlarini puxta o‘ylang.

words.example: Let me think over the proposal after my brain returns from lunch.
words.translation: Miyam tushlikdan qaytgach, taklifni yaxshilab o‘ylab olay.

words.example: We should look into the sudden increase in very expensive paperclips.
words.translation: Juda qimmat qisqichlar sonining to‘satdan oshishini tekshirishimiz kerak.

words.example: Go over the figures before presenting our accidental million-pound plan.
words.translation: Tasodifiy million funtlik rejamizni taqdim etishdan oldin raqamlarni qayta ko‘ring.

words.example: We can rule out magic, but we should still check the cable.
words.translation: Sehrni istisno qila olamiz, lekin kabelni baribir tekshirishimiz kerak.

words.example: Narrow down the options before the shortlist becomes a novel.
words.translation: Qisqa ro‘yxat romanga aylanmasidan variantlarni kamaytiring.

words.example: The figures point to a simple explanation that nobody wants to admit.
words.translation: Raqamlar hech kim tan olishni istamaydigan oddiy izohni ko‘rsatadi.

words.example: Round off the discussion with a conclusion, not another exciting question.
words.translation: Muhokamani yana bir qiziqarli savol bilan emas, xulosa bilan yakunlang.

words.example: Set out the reasons clearly, leaving the dramatic thunder out.
words.translation: Dramatik momaqaldiroqni chetga qo‘yib, sabablarni aniq bayon qiling.

words.example: Let us get down to the evidence before the introduction becomes a family history.
words.translation: Kirish oilaviy tarixga aylanmasidan dalillarga jiddiy kirishaylik.

words.example: Flesh out the idea with evidence, not another decorative paragraph.
words.translation: G‘oyani yana bir bezak xatboshi bilan emas, dalillar bilan boyiting.

words.example: We can build on last year's results instead of rediscovering the same stapler.
words.translation: Xuddi o‘sha steplerni qayta kashf qilish o‘rniga o‘tgan yilgi natijalarni rivojlantira olamiz.

words.example: Draw on your experience, including the project that taught you to label everything.
words.translation: Tajribangizdan, jumladan, hamma narsaga yorliq qo‘yishni o‘rgatgan loyihadan foydalaning.

words.example: Can you account for the extra zero without blaming the cat?
words.translation: Mushukni ayblamasdan ortiqcha nolning sababini tushuntira olasizmi?

words.example: Allow for delays, especially when six people share one charger.
words.translation: Ayniqsa olti kishi bitta quvvatlagichdan foydalansa, kechikishlarni hisobga oling.

words.example: The argument may boil down to who gets the comfortable chair.
words.translation: Bahsning mohiyati qulay stul kimga tegishiga borib taqalishi mumkin.

words.example: The decision will come down to cost, not the charm of the brochure.
words.translation: Qaror buklet jozibasiga emas, xarajatga bog‘liq bo‘ladi.

words.example: That conclusion does not follow from finding one cheerful accountant.
words.translation: Bitta quvnoq hisobchini topishdan bunday xulosa kelib chiqmaydi.

words.example: Does this example tie in with the topic, or do you just like penguins?
words.translation: Bu misol mavzuga bog‘lanadimi yoki siz shunchaki pingvinlarni yoqtirasizmi?

words.example: The results bear out our prediction that shorter instructions cause fewer sighs.
words.translation: Natijalar qisqaroq ko‘rsatmalar kamroq xo‘rsinishga sabab bo‘lishi haqidagi taxminimizni tasdiqlaydi.

words.example: His explanation does not add up unless the printer can walk.
words.translation: Printer yura olmasa, uning izohi mantiqan to‘g‘ri chiqmaydi.

words.example: We tried to piece together the events from three emails and a coffee stain.
words.translation: Uchta xat va qahva dog‘idan voqealarni tiklashga urindik.

words.example: What are you trying to get at with this story about a nervous toaster?
words.translation: Asabiy toster haqidagi hikoya bilan aslida nimani demoqchisiz?

words.example: Put forward a solution before we form another committee to find one.
words.translation: Yechim izlash uchun yana qo‘mita tuzmasimizdan bir yechim taklif qiling.

words.example: We can go ahead once someone confirms that this is the right building.
words.translation: Kimdir bu to‘g‘ri bino ekanini tasdiqlagach, boshlashimiz mumkin.

words.example: Let's move on before the first question becomes a three-part documentary.
words.translation: Birinchi savol uch qismli hujjatli filmga aylanmasidan keyingisiga o‘taylik.

words.example: We decided to press on despite the printer's dramatic noises.
words.translation: Printerning dramatik shovqinlariga qaramay davom etishga qaror qildik.

words.example: The team will push ahead with the trial after replacing the sleepy sensor.
words.translation: Jamoa uyqusiragan datchikni almashtirgach, sinovni qat’iyat bilan davom ettiradi.

words.example: I should get on with the report instead of designing its imaginary award.
words.translation: Xayoliy mukofotini loyihalash o‘rniga hisobotni davom ettirishim kerak.

words.example: We need to step up our efforts, not merely the size of our motivational posters.
words.translation: Ruhlantiruvchi plakatlar hajmini emas, harakatlarimizni kuchaytirishimiz kerak.

words.example: I struggle to keep up with changes to a plan called the final plan.
words.translation: Yakuniy reja deb atalgan rejadagi o‘zgarishlarni kuzatishga zo‘rg‘a ulguraman.

words.example: We may fall behind if every small decision needs a grand ceremony.
words.translation: Har bir kichik qarorga katta marosim kerak bo‘lsa, ortda qolishimiz mumkin.

words.example: To get ahead, try learning the software rather than blaming the mouse.
words.translation: Ilgarilash uchun sichqonchani ayblash o‘rniga dasturni o‘rganishga harakat qiling.

words.example: I began to catch on when she replaced the equation with three apples.
words.translation: U tenglamani uchta olma bilan almashtirganda tushuna boshladim.

words.example: Do not take on another project until your desk becomes visible again.
words.translation: Stolingiz yana ko‘rinmaguncha boshqa loyihani zimmangizga olmang.

words.example: Carry out the test before celebrating your completely untested invention.
words.translation: Mutlaqo sinalmagan ixtirongizni nishonlashdan oldin sinovni o‘tkazing.

words.example: Follow up the discussion with action, preferably before everyone forgets it.
words.translation: Hamma unutmasidan muhokamani amaliy ish bilan davom ettiring.

words.example: An elegant plan helps only if we follow through.
words.translation: Nafis reja faqat uni oxiriga yetkazsak yordam beradi.

words.example: It was easy to see through his excuse once we found the empty cake box.
words.translation: Bo‘sh tort qutisini topgach, uning bahonasini anglash oson bo‘ldi.

words.example: Every proposal must go through review, even one with a charming penguin logo.
words.translation: Har bir taklif, hatto yoqimli pingvin logotipi bor bo‘lsa ham, ko‘rib chiqishdan o‘tishi kerak.

words.example: We can get through these forms before the kettle boils if nobody invents new questions.
words.translation: Hech kim yangi savol o‘ylamasa, choynak qaynaguncha shakllarni tugata olamiz.

words.example: We had to start over after discovering that the chart described the wrong year.
words.translation: Diagramma noto‘g‘ri yilni ko‘rsatganini bilib, boshidan boshlashga majbur bo‘ldik.

words.example: Many experts start out asking questions that sound wonderfully basic.
words.translation: Ko‘p mutaxassislar dastlab juda sodda tuyuladigan savollar berishdan boshlaydi.

words.example: We will set about solving the issue once the debate about its name ends.
words.translation: Masalaning nomi haqidagi bahs tugagach, uni hal qilishga kirishamiz.

words.example: Before we embark on another study, let us read the one we already finished.
words.translation: Yana bir tadqiqotga kirishishdan oldin tugatganimizni o‘qiylik.

words.example: We could end up with a simpler system if we resist adding twelve extra features.
words.translation: O‘n ikki qo‘shimcha imkoniyatni qo‘shishga berilmasak, oxirida soddaroq tizimga ega bo‘lishimiz mumkin.

words.example: The discussion began to wind down when even the loudest member checked the clock.
words.translation: Hatto eng baland ovozli a’zo soatga qaragach, muhokama asta-sekin tugay boshladi.

words.example: We will phase out paper forms before they occupy the whole building.
words.translation: Qog‘oz shakllar butun binoni egallamasidan ularni bosqichma-bosqich bekor qilamiz.

words.example: Phase in the new system so Monday does not become a national emergency.
words.translation: Dushanba milliy favqulodda holatga aylanmasligi uchun yangi tizimni bosqichma-bosqich kiriting.

words.example: We will opt for the simple design, despite the gold one's confident sparkle.
words.translation: Oltin nusxaning ishonchli yaltirashiga qaramay, oddiy dizaynni tanlaymiz.

words.example: Can we settle on a date before the calendar needs replacing?
words.translation: Taqvimni almashtirishga to‘g‘ri kelmasidan bir sanaga kelisha olamizmi?

words.example: We wanted a perfect solution but had to settle for one that worked.
words.translation: Mukammal yechim xohladik, ammo ishlaydiganiga rozi bo‘lishga to‘g‘ri keldi.

words.example: I would go for the clearer chart, even if it has fewer exciting arrows.
words.translation: Unda qiziqarli strelkalar kamroq bo‘lsa ham, aniqroq diagrammani tanlardim.

words.example: The panel may rule against the proposal to replace meetings with interpretive dance.
words.translation: Hay’at yig‘ilishlarni ifodali raqs bilan almashtirish taklifiga qarshi qaror chiqarishi mumkin.

words.example: Hold off announcing victory until the machine has actually switched on.
words.translation: Uskuna haqiqatan yoqilmaguncha g‘alaba e’lon qilishni kutib turing.

words.example: Do not hold back useful criticism just because the chart is my favourite colour.
words.translation: Diagramma sevimli rangimda bo‘lgani uchun foydali tanqidni aytishdan tiyilmang.

words.example: We should step back and ask whether anyone needs this complicated solution.
words.translation: Bir chetdan qarab, bu murakkab yechim kimgadir kerakmi deb so‘rashimiz kerak.

words.example: Let me sleep on the proposal rather than approve it before my nap.
words.translation: Mizg‘ishdan oldin tasdiqlagandan ko‘ra taklifni ertagacha o‘ylab ko‘ray.

words.example: The committee cannot sit on this request until the chairs become antiques.
words.translation: Qo‘mita bu so‘rovni stullar qadimiy buyumga aylanguncha cho‘zib yurolmaydi.

words.example: Stick to the question unless you want another accidental history lecture.
words.translation: Yana tasodifiy tarix ma’ruzasi xohlamasangiz, savoldan chetga chiqmang.

words.example: Commit to a realistic deadline, not one invented during a burst of enthusiasm.
words.translation: Ishtiyoq to‘lqinida o‘ylangan emas, haqiqiy muddatni zimmangizga oling.

words.example: He agreed to back down when the evidence arrived on a very large screen.
words.translation: Dalil juda katta ekranda paydo bo‘lgach, u fikridan qaytishga rozi bo‘ldi.

words.example: I will not give in just because your argument comes with free biscuits.
words.translation: Dalilingiz bepul pechenye bilan kelgani uchungina rozi bo‘lmayman.

words.meaning: yordam yoki javob uchun murojaat qilmoq
words.example: We can turn to the data when our opinions start chasing each other in circles.
words.translation: Fikrlarimiz bir-birini aylanib quva boshlaganda ma’lumotlarga murojaat qila olamiz.

words.example: We can fall back on paper notes if the computer chooses another holiday.
words.translation: Kompyuter yana ta’tilni tanlasa, qog‘oz qaydlarga qayta olamiz.

words.example: The report can do without five different photographs of the same button.
words.translation: Hisobot bir tugmaning besh xil suratisiz ham bo‘la oladi.

words.example: We can dispense with the long introduction and get straight to the mystery.
words.translation: Uzun kirishdan voz kechib, darhol sirga o‘tishimiz mumkin.

words.example: Do not pass up the chance to ask a question before the expert escapes.
words.translation: Mutaxassis qochib ketmasidan savol berish imkoniyatini qo‘ldan boy bermang.

words.example: I will take up your offer of help before this spreadsheet grows another page.
words.translation: Bu jadval yana bir sahifa o‘stirmasidan yordamingizni qabul qilaman.

words.example: Saying I was hungry would understate the problem: I ate the menu.
words.translation: Qornim ochligini aytish muammoni kamaytirib ko‘rsatgan bo‘lardi: men menyuni yeb qo‘ydim.

words.example: One partner may pull out if the plan still includes a dancing delivery robot.
words.translation: Rejada hali ham raqsga tushadigan yetkazuvchi robot bo‘lsa, bir hamkor chiqib ketishi mumkin.

words.example: Some volunteers drop out when the short study enters its sixth month.
words.translation: Qisqa tadqiqot oltinchi oyga kirganda ayrim ko‘ngillilar uni tark etadi.

words.example: The editor will sign off the report once we remove the imaginary sources.
words.translation: Xayoliy manbalarni olib tashlagach, muharrir hisobotni yakuniy tasdiqlaydi.

words.example: I can go along with the plan, provided the budget does not assume free electricity.
words.translation: Budjet bepul elektrni nazarda tutmasa, rejaga qo‘shila olaman.

words.example: Break down the problem before it becomes one enormous cloud of worry.
words.translation: Muammo ulkan xavotir bulutiga aylanishidan oldin uni qismlarga ajrating.

words.example: We had to break off the discussion when the alarm started competing with us.
words.translation: Signal biz bilan raqobatlasha boshlaganda muhokamani to‘xtatishga majbur bo‘ldik.

words.example: One simple example helped us break through the confusion.
words.translation: Bitta sodda misol chalkashlikni yengishimizga yordam berdi.

words.example: Trim down the report until its summary no longer needs a bookmark.
words.translation: Qisqacha mazmuniga xatcho‘p kerak bo‘lmay qolguncha hisobotni ixchamlashtiring.

words.example: Cut out the repeated sentences unless repetition is the actual topic.
words.translation: Mavzu takrorlash bo‘lmasa, takrorlangan gaplarni olib tashlang.

words.example: Please do not cut off the speaker just as the explanation starts making sense.
words.translation: Izoh tushunarli bo‘la boshlaganida so‘zlovchining gapini bo‘lmang.

words.example: Fill in the missing dates before history develops several mysterious gaps.
words.translation: Tarixda bir necha sirli bo‘shliq paydo bo‘lmasidan yetishmagan sanalarni to‘ldiring.

words.example: Fill out the form in plain language, not in the style of a royal announcement.
words.translation: Shaklni qirollik e’loni uslubida emas, oddiy tilda to‘ldiring.

words.example: Do not leave out the one fact that makes your confident conclusion doubtful.
words.translation: Ishonchli xulosangizni shubhali qiladigan yagona faktni tashlab ketmang.

words.example: Put aside your favourite explanation and look at the actual numbers.
words.translation: Sevimli izohingizni chetga surib, haqiqiy raqamlarga qarang.

words.example: Lay out your reasoning so readers do not need a detective licence.
words.translation: O‘quvchilarga detektiv litsenziyasi kerak bo‘lmasligi uchun mulohazangizni aniq bayon qiling.

words.example: Map out the stages before stage one becomes permanent.
words.translation: Birinchi bosqich abadiy bo‘lib qolmasidan bosqichlarni rejalashtiring.

words.example: Clear reasoning can mark out a good report more than a shiny cover can.
words.translation: Aniq mulohaza yaxshi hisobotni yaltiroq muqovadan ko‘ra yaxshiroq ajratib ko‘rsatishi mumkin.

words.example: Cross out the irrelevant example before the penguin takes over the essay.
words.translation: Pingvin inshoni egallab olmasidan aloqasiz misolning ustidan chizing.

words.example: Write down the idea before it joins your other brilliant forgotten thoughts.
words.translation: G‘oya boshqa unutilgan ajoyib fikrlaringizga qo‘shilmasidan uni yozib qo‘ying.

words.example: Note down the exact figure rather than something between five and fifty.
words.translation: Besh bilan ellik orasidagi nimadir emas, aniq raqamni qayd qiling.

words.example: Read through the conclusion before giving it the title Final Final Final.
words.translation: Xulosaga Yakuniy Yakuniy Yakuniy deb nom berishdan oldin uni o‘qib chiqing.

words.example: I need to read up on the topic before my confidence gets ahead of my knowledge.
words.translation: Ishonchim bilimimdan o‘zib ketmasidan mavzuni o‘qib o‘rganishim kerak.

words.example: Look up the term before using it to impress the one person who knows it.
words.translation: Atamani biladigan yagona odamni qoyil qoldirish uchun ishlatishdan oldin ma’nosini tekshiring.

words.example: We can look back on the mistake as a lesson, once the embarrassment fades.
words.translation: Xijolat yo‘qolgach, xatoni saboq sifatida eslashimiz mumkin.

words.example: Look ahead before choosing a system that cannot handle next month's work.
words.translation: Keyingi oy ishini ko‘tara olmaydigan tizimni tanlashdan oldin kelajakni hisobga oling.

words.example: Run through the main points before the audience runs out of patience.
words.translation: Tinglovchilar sabri tugamasidan asosiy fikrlarni qisqa ko‘rib chiqing.

words.example: Talk through the method slowly enough for my pencil to keep up.
words.translation: Qalamim ulguradigan darajada sekin qilib usulni bosqichma-bosqich tushuntiring.

words.example: We should talk over the options before naming the project after a planet.
words.translation: Loyihaga sayyora nomini berishdan oldin variantlarni muhokama qilishimiz kerak.

words.example: Could you walk through the example without skipping the bit everybody finds difficult?
words.translation: Hamma qiyin deb biladigan qismini o‘tkazmay misolni qadamma-qadam tushuntira olasizmi?

words.meaning: zarur ravishda talab qilmoq yoki keltirib chiqarmoq
words.example: The change will entail retraining, not merely buying brighter name badges.
words.translation: O‘zgarish shunchaki yorqinroq ism nishonlari emas, qayta o‘qitishni talab qiladi.

words.example: Clear labels enable people to work without becoming part-time detectives.
words.translation: Aniq yorliqlar odamlarga yarim stavkali detektivga aylanmay ishlash imkonini beradi.

words.example: A shared glossary can facilitate discussion and reduce theatrical misunderstandings.
words.translation: Umumiy lug‘at muhokamani osonlashtirib, dramatik tushunmovchiliklarni kamaytirishi mumkin.

words.example: A bold claim will require stronger evidence than your uncle's enthusiastic nod.
words.translation: Dadil da’voga amakining jo‘shqin bosh irg‘ashidan kuchliroq dalil kerak.

words.example: The results depend on accurate measurements, not on how serious we look.
words.translation: Natijalar qanchalik jiddiy ko‘rinishimizga emas, aniq o‘lchovlarga bog‘liq.

words.example: The two accounts differ mainly on who ate the evidence.
words.translation: Ikki bayon asosan dalilni kim yeganida farq qiladi.

words.example: Your explanation should not resemble a maze with no exit.
words.translation: Izohingiz chiqishsiz labirintga o‘xshamasligi kerak.

words.example: How does the dancing robot relate to the question about saving time?
words.translation: Raqsga tushadigan robot vaqt tejash haqidagi savolga qanday bog‘lanadi?

words.example: These figures concern real expenses, including our unexpectedly costly pencils.
words.translation: Bu raqamlar haqiqiy xarajatlarga, jumladan, kutilmaganda qimmatga tushgan qalamlarimizga tegishli.

words.example: I regard a working example as more useful than a spectacular promise.
words.translation: Ishlaydigan misolni ajoyib va’dadan foydaliroq deb hisoblayman.

words.example: Three guesses do not constitute evidence, even if they agree.
words.translation: Uchta taxmin bir-biriga mos kelsa ham, dalil hisoblanmaydi.

words.example: The labels must correspond to the samples, not to whichever name sounds nicest.
words.translation: Yorliqlar eng yoqimli eshitilgan nomga emas, namunalarga mos kelishi kerak.

words.example: We derive the estimate from records, not from a particularly cheerful mood.
words.translation: Hisobni juda quvnoq kayfiyatdan emas, qaydlardan chiqaramiz.

words.example: Obtain permission before transforming the corridor into a research laboratory.
words.translation: Yo‘lakni tadqiqot laboratoriyasiga aylantirishdan oldin ruxsat oling.

words.example: You acquire useful habits through practice, not by buying a more impressive notebook.
words.translation: Foydali odatlarni zo‘rroq daftar sotib olib emas, mashq orqali egallaysiz.

words.example: We can attain better accuracy without asking everyone to hold their breath.
words.translation: Hammadan nafasini ushlab turishni so‘ramay ham yuqoriroq aniqlikka erisha olamiz.

words.example: We could accomplish more if we spent less time naming our task groups.
words.translation: Vazifa guruhlariga nom berishga kamroq vaqt sarflasak, ko‘proq ish bajara olardik.

words.example: The design must fulfil the requirements, including the boring one about fitting through doors.
words.translation: Dizayn talablarga, jumladan, eshikdan sig‘ish haqidagi zerikarli talabga javob berishi kerak.

words.example: Implement the useful suggestion before it disappears into another meeting record.
words.translation: Foydali taklif yana bir bayonnomada yo‘qolmasidan uni joriy eting.

words.example: Perform the calculation before celebrating the astonishing result in your head.
words.translation: Xayolingizdagi hayratlanarli natijani nishonlashdan oldin hisobni bajaring.

words.example: Do not undertake a huge study simply because the title sounds impressive.
words.translation: Faqat sarlavhasi ta’sirli eshitilgani uchun ulkan tadqiqotga kirishmang.

words.example: We should pursue the useful lead rather than the amusing rumour.
words.translation: Qiziqarli mish-mish emas, foydali ma’lumot izidan borishimiz kerak.

words.example: Seek a clearer explanation before assuming the machine dislikes you.
words.translation: Uskuna sizni yoqtirmaydi deb o‘ylashdan oldin aniqroq izoh izlang.

words.example: Ensure the example answers the question rather than starting a new mystery.
words.translation: Misol yangi sir boshlamay, savolga javob berishini ta’minlang.

words.example: The benefits outweigh the drawbacks, although the drawbacks have a louder spokesperson.
words.translation: Afzalliklar kamchiliklardan ustun, ammo kamchiliklarning vakili balandroq gapiradi.

skills.objective: Ot va sifatni ajratish: berilgan uch tekshiruvdan kamida ikkitasini mustaqil bajaraman.

listening.text:
Mina: Hello! Mina. Student.
Lola: Hello! Lola. Teacher.
Mina: A happy student!

questions.prompt: O‘quvchining ismi? Qisqa javob yoki berilgan variantni yozing.
questions.explanation: Matndagi dalil: «Mina». Javob uchun yangi gap tuzish shart emas.

questions.prompt: Student oldidagi sifat? Qisqa javob yoki berilgan variantni yozing.
questions.explanation: Matndagi dalil: «happy». Javob uchun yangi gap tuzish shart emas.

questions.prompt: Teacher oldidagi sifat? Qisqa javob yoki berilgan variantni yozing.
questions.explanation: Matndagi dalil: «kind». Javob uchun yangi gap tuzish shart emas.

speaking.prompt: Juftingizga ism kartasini ko‘rsating. Student, teacher, friend kartalaridan ikkitasini, kind va happy sifatlarini ayting. Tayyor “Hello!” qolipi bilan salomlashing; gap tuzish shart emas.
success: Ot va sifatni ajratish bo‘yicha berilgan vazifa bajarilgan.
Tayyor karta yoki o‘tilgan qolip to‘g‘ri tanlangan; hali o‘tilmagan zamon talab qilinmagan.
Sherik ko‘rsatilgan shaxs, buyum yoki ma’noni to‘g‘ri aniqlagan.

writing.prompt: To‘rtta yorliq yozing: ikki ot, ikki sifat. Keyin namunadan ikki sifat + ot birikmasini ko‘chiring.
writing.model:
student; teacher; kind; happy
a kind teacher
a happy student
success: Topshiriqda so‘ralgan yorliq, gap yoki juftliklar to‘liq.
Ot va sifatni ajratish bo‘yicha kamida ikki to‘g‘ri misol bor.
Imlo va bosh harflar namunaga mos; mustaqil va ko‘chirilgan ish farqlangan.

skills.teacherNote: Ot narsa yoki odam nomi; sifat uning belgisidir. A kind teacher birikmasidagi a hozir tayyor qolip, artikl qoidasi emas. Reading: avval sarlavha va rasm/real buyum, keyin uch savolga matndan dalil. Listening: matnni yashirib ikki marta tabiiy, sekin o‘qing; avval kim/nima, keyin tafsilot. Savolni o‘zbekcha tushuntiring, bir so‘zli javobni qabul qiling. Qiynaluvchiga ikki tanlov va ko‘rsatish imkonini bering; tez ishlovchiga shu shaklda boshqa rasm bering.

skills.objective: Fe’l, olmosh va ravishni tanish: berilgan uch tekshiruvdan kamida ikkitasini mustaqil bajaraman.

walk + slowly
read + quietly

Imlo va bosh harflar namunaga mos; mustaqil va ko‘chirilgan ish farqlangan.
